title: Associate Director - Fraud Prevention
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is a US-headquartered AI consulting and products company with operations in India. We work with financial services organisations across geographies to solve business problems using data, AI and technology. Our teams combine consulting, industry, product and engineering expertise to build practical solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Associate Director as a leader in our AI driven Fraud prevention practice. You will shape the strategy, solutions and delivery of AI-driven fraud detection and prevention for banks, payments companies, lenders, insurers and fintechs.

This is a senior role that combines deep fraud domain expertise, hands-on technical credibility, client leadership and team building. You will own our fraud AI offerings end-to-end, from client conversations and solution design through to models running in production and delivering measurable reductions in fraud losses.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead client engagements end-to-end, from discovery and solution design through model development, deployment and value realisation.
* Be the SME and guide delivery of use cases such as card and payments fraud, application and identity fraud, synthetic identities, account takeover, first-party fraud, authorised push payment (APP) scams and mule account detection but using new age AI techniques including graph-based reasoning and transformer architectures.
* Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for Sirius AI’s Fraud prevention AI offerings, including solution accelerators, reusable assets and product capabilities.
* Guide the team on modelling approaches including supervised and unsupervised machine learning, anomaly detection, graph and network analytics, transformer-based models, behavioural and device signals, agentic AI implementations and real-time scoring.
* Ensure client delivery use cases meet MRM and regulatory specs for explainability, validation and ongoing monitoring.
* Build, mentor and lead a high-performing team of data scientists, AI engineers ML engineers and analysts; set technical standards and contribute to hiring.
* Support business development through proposals, solution demonstrations, proofs of concept and client presentations, and help grow existing accounts.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related quantitative field; a PhD or MBA is a plus.
* 8+ years of experience in data science, analytics or AI, including at least 6 years focused on fraud, financial crime or risk in financial services.
* A proven track record of taking fraud models into production and delivering measurable business impact.
* Deep understanding of fraud typologies, the fraud lifecycle and fraud operations, including alerting, investigation, case management and chargebacks.
* Strong grounding in machine learning (gradient boosting, neural networks, anomaly detection, graph methods) and working proficiency in Python and SQL, with the ability to review and challenge the team’s technical work.
* Familiarity with fraud platforms and data sources such as FICO Falcon, NICE Actimize, Feature space or SAS Fraud Management, and with device, identity and consortium data.
* 3+ years of experience leading teams, and confidence managing senior stakeholders
* Consulting or client-facing experience, including solution selling, pre-sales and engagement management.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

**Good to Have**

* Experience delivering fraud solutions across multiple geographies, such as the US, UK, Europe or SE Asia.
* Hands-on exposure to real-time streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink) and cloud ML platforms

title: Research Analyst - Power Market
description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.
  
  
For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.
  
  
Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.
  
  
By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.
  
  
This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.
  
  
Wood Mackenzie
  
  
Intelligence Connected
  
  
**WoodMac.com**
**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**
**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

The role offers a chance to join Wood Mackenzie’s highly respected Power and Renewables (P&R) Research team, focusing on South Asia power market analysis and modelling. Our P&R team is known for producing market-leading research, delivering integrated, in-depth power curves and market outlooks. We conduct thorough analysis and collaborate across disciplines, combining extensive data with deep knowledge of conventional fuels and renewable supply chains.
  
  
Our models provide valuable insights into the price impacts of policy, economics, and supply chains, offering clear scenario outlooks that help users align with their business risk criteria. With expertise in market dynamics, renewable power supply chains, cost trends, and investments, we support our clients in making informed commercial and strategic decisions in a rapidly changing energy landscape.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Research Analyst to join our team in Gurugram, India. The successful candidate will support the regional Power & Renewables team through market research, policy and regulatory analysis, power market modelling, insights creation, and client support for India and other South Asian power markets.
  
  
As a Research Analyst, you will build a deep understanding of power market dynamics across India and South Asia and contribute across five core areas: conducting market research to track supply, demand, and investment trends; analyzing the policy and regulatory landscape and its impact on market outcomes; running and maintaining our regional power market models to produce technology and price outlooks; translating model outputs and market intelligence into clear, actionable insights for our research reports; and supporting client engagements by responding to queries and presenting findings to clients and industry stakeholders. You will collaborate with a global team of power and renewables experts, work on cutting-edge topics such as battery storage and curtailment forecasting and stay current on market developments to keep our modelling and research at the leading edge.
  
  
This role also offers opportunities to build and maintain relationships with clients and industry experts. Along with industry-leading training and learning opportunities, it has significant career development potential, paving the way for thought leadership and strategic roles in the power and renewables sector.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Intellectual Curiosity & Collaboration:**

* Intellectually curious, collaborative, and highly organized, with a strong attention to detail.
* Focused on delivering exceptional service to clients and committed to our research's continuous growth and improvement.

**Qualification/Experience**

* Work experience of 3-6 years with any - utility, developer, consultancy/research provider, university, think-tank, or another market/investment-focused organization
* Exceptional analytical/quantitative skills, including experience in modelling or commercial analysis in power markets.
* Experience conducting market research or policy and regulatory analysis in the Indian or South Asian power sector is highly desirable.
* Experience in optimisation models (such as Plexos, Aurora, SDDP etc) will be an added advantage
* Comfortable working with large datasets, databases, and APIs, and familiar with tools like Python, SQL, and Power Query to handle and analyse data

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong understanding of power and renewable market dynamics
* Familiarity with the enablers and implications of decarbonization in the energy sector
* Knowledge of key commercial and regulatory frameworks relevant to India and South Asia, such as support/incentive regimes, power purchase agreements, capacity and ancillary markets, transmission and distribution regulations, and energy policy

**Equal Opportunities**
We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

description:

Tech for Operations - Artificial Intelligence (AI)
  
  
**Designation:**
AI/ML Computational Science Analyst
  
  
**Qualifications:**
BE/BTech/BCA
  
  
**Years of Experience:**
1 to 2 years
  
  
**Language - Ability:**
English(International) - Intermediate
  
  
**About Accenture**
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  
  
**What would you do?**
Reinvention Deployment Engineering (RDE) is an approach used by Accenture to reimagine and accelerate the delivery of engineering and R&D solutions. It focuses on combining human expertise with AI-driven agents to enhance innovation velocity, streamline processes, and reduce time to market products and services. RDE emphasizes a value-driven mindset, where humans define objectives and ethical guardrails while AI agents handle scale, speed, and data-driven execution The RDE Engineer – Agentic AI & Integration will design, build, integrate, test and deploy AI-native and Agentic AI solutions for Accenture Operations RDE PODs. The role is intended for multi-skilled engineers with Python and AI/ML as the primary capability, supported by working knowledge across integration, cloud, DevOps, testing, observability, responsible AI and enterprise platforms. The role supports the RDE POD model where engineers are expected to operate close to client problems, contribute across the delivery lifecycle, reduce handoffs, and accelerate client-facing outcomes through compact, T-shaped teams. The hiring approach should therefore prioritize strong primary skill depth plus adjacent skill breadth, rather than narrow single-skill specialization. Must Have Skills
  
  

* Python & Full-Stack Development
* Agentic AI (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, RAG)
* Good Python programming fundamentals including scripting, data structures and Object-Oriented Programming concepts.
* Basic exposure to AI/ML concepts, GenAI, prompt engineering or LLM-enabled applications.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, Git and software development lifecycle basics.
* Ability to write clean code, test outputs, document work, and learn fast in a POD-based delivery model. What are we looking for?
* Skill Area
* Agentic AI Concepts - Deep understanding of AI agent design, reasoning loops, orchestration patterns & multi-agent coordination architectures. Core differentiator; senior levels lead architecture design
* Agentic AI Concepts - Tool calling, function routing, agent memory & state management, autonomous decision-making patterns. Applicable across levels; depth scales with seniority
* LLM & Prompt Engineering - Hands-on with LLMs (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini); prompt engineering, few-shot, chain-of-thought & structured output techniques. Focus on prompt craft
* LLM & Prompt Engineering - RAG pipeline design, vector database integration (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB) & semantic search for enterprise grounding. RAG critical for enterprise-grade AI accuracy
* AI Frameworks - Exposure in LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or CrewAI for production-grade agentic workflow development.
* Programming & APIs - Strong Python skills — async programming, OOP, data structures & scripting for AI pipelines; Java/.NET acceptable. Python strongly preferred for AI workloads
* Programming & APIs - REST/GraphQL API development, microservices design & enterprise application integration patterns - Integration skills essential for enterprise deployment
* Skill Area
* Cloud & DevOps - Azure / AWS / GCP hands-on experience; cloud-native architecture, infrastructure provisioning & managed AI services. AWS preferred for this engagement; cloud-agnostic skills valued
* Cloud & DevOps - Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipeline setup, GitOps & automated deployment practices. CI/CD mandatory
* Security & Responsible AI - Security principles, identity management (OAuth, Azure AD), AI guardrails, bias mitigation & enterprise compliance
* Enterprise Integration - Integrating with enterprise platforms: ServiceNow, Appian, SAP, Salesforce & Microsoft ecosystem (M365, Teams, Power Platform). Platform experience maps directly to client landscape
* Testing & Observability - AI solution testing, LLM output evaluation, observability (tracing, monitoring), performance tuning & cost optimization. Observability critical for production AI agents Secondary Skills
* Exposure to RAG, vector databases, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or CrewAI is preferred.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms, Docker, CI/CD, testing and observability concepts.
* Interest in responsible AI, AI guardrails, enterprise integration and production-readiness practices. Roles and Responsibilities:
* Support development of Python-led AI/ML components, scripts and AI pipeline utilities under guidance from senior engineers.
* Assist in prompt engineering, structured output testing, basic RAG implementation, and validation of LLM responses.
* Participate in API testing, integration validation, documentation, and defect resolution activities.
* Contribute to unit testing, AI output checks, data preparation, debugging, and deployment support.
* Build foundational understanding of Agentic AI workflows, tool calling, orchestration and enterprise integration patterns.

title: Consultant - Actuarial Services
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION | CONSULTANT – ACTUARIAL SERVICES**

**Company Description:**

DHA-1 is a US-headquartered consulting and managed services firm focused exclusively on the global Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance industry. We support insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, brokers, and insurtechs across specialized functions, including underwriting and portfolio operations, actuarial and catastrophe modeling, AI enablement, and technology implementation.

We combine insurance domain knowledge, technical expertise, and dedicated teams to help clients manage complex workflows, improve operational efficiency, and build scalable capabilities.

**Role Description:**

We are seeking a technically skilled and proactive Consultant to join our growing actuarial practice in India.

In this role, you will work on diverse actuarial engagements for global P&C insurers, reinsurers, and MGAs, covering pricing, rating model development, reserving, portfolio analytics, and process automation.

Working alongside senior actuarial professionals, you will own assigned analytical deliverables, develop and validate actuarial models, analyze complex datasets, and collaborate with underwriting, catastrophe modeling, and technology teams.

The role offers an opportunity to work directly on international client engagements while contributing to

the development of DHA-1's actuarial capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Pricing & Rating Plan Support**

* Perform rate adequacy analyses, trend studies, loss cost assessments, and experience-based pricing across P&C lines of business.
* Develop, test, and validate technical pricing models, rating tools, and rating plan components.
* Support rating plan development, bureau benchmarking, and technical documentation for new products, market entries, and program expansions.

**Reserving & Claims Analytics**

* Prepare reserve reviews, loss evaluations, and loss development triangle analyses using established actuarial methodologies.
* Analyze claims development, loss trends, Loss Adjustment Expenses (LAE), and large-loss experience.
* Support reserve adequacy assessments, actuarial reporting, and documentation of key assumptions and findings.

**Portfolio Analytics & Cross-Functional Integration**

* Analyze portfolio performance, profitability, loss ratios, and emerging experience trends to support business decisions.
* Develop portfolio monitoring dashboards, recurring reports, and scenario or sensitivity analyses.
* Collaborate with underwriting, catastrophe modeling, and other teams to integrate actuarial insights into portfolio management.

**Programming & Process Automation**

* Develop and maintain actuarial models, analytical routines, and reporting tools using Excel, Python, R, or SQL.
* Automate recurring data processing, actuarial calculations, validation, and reporting workflows.
* Perform data cleansing, reconciliation, model validation, and documentation to ensure accuracy and consistency.

**Client Delivery & Quality Assurance**

* Own assigned actuarial deliverables, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to agreed requirements.
* Conduct quality checks, validate assumptions and outputs, and maintain clear technical documentation.
* Collaborate with global client teams and senior actuarial professionals to communicate findings, address queries, and support project delivery.

**Qualifications:**

**Experience**

* 3–6 years of hands-on actuarial experience in Property & Casualty / General Insurance.
* Practical experience in pricing, rating model development, reserving, or portfolio analytics.
* Experience supporting US or UK commercial insurance markets is preferred.

**Actuarial Credentials**

* Actively pursuing actuarial designation through IFoA, IAI, CAS, or an equivalent professional body.
* Preferably four or more actuarial examinations cleared. Candidates with fewer examinations and strong relevant experience may also be considered.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, data modeling, and analytical tool development.
* Working proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation, statistical analysis, or automation.
* Experience with SQL, VBA, or actuarial modeling platforms would be an advantage.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Good understanding of P&C pricing principles, rating methodologies, and insurance loss experience.
* Familiarity with reserving methodologies and loss development techniques.
* Exposure to commercial casualty pricing, excess insurance, ILFs, or reinsurance analytics would be an advantage.

**Analytical & Communication Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with attention to accuracy and detail.
* Ability to independently execute analytical assignments and manage competing deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings to global stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate across actuarial, underwriting, CAT modeling, and technology functions.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or another quantitative discipline.

**Join Our Team:**

At DHA-1, you will have the opportunity to work on diverse actuarial engagements for global insurance clients, collaborate with experienced industry professionals, and help grow our actuarial practice.

We offer a collaborative environment that encourages professional development, technical learning, and opportunities to take ownership of meaningful client work.

title: Robotics Reinforcement Learning Engineer (Reinforcement Learning/ Sim2Real)
description:
**About Asiacruit**
At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Robotics Reinforcement Learning Engineer**
to develop and deploy reinforcement learning-based locomotion policies for autonomous quadruped robots.
  
  
In this role, you will train robotic systems to maintain dynamic balance, respond to physical disturbances, and navigate different terrain conditions. You will use physics-based simulation and reinforcement learning to develop robust control policies, then transfer and validate those policies on physical robotic hardware.
  
  
The role combines reinforcement learning, legged robot locomotion, simulation engineering, and real-time deployment, with a strong emphasis on improving reliability when moving from simulation to real-world operation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop reinforcement learning-based locomotion policies using NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim, or comparable simulation platforms.
* Train parallelized locomotion policies across randomized terrain, friction conditions, and dynamic disturbances.
* Develop blind and vision-assisted locomotion approaches for quadruped robots operating in different environments.
* Implement domain randomization across physical parameters, including friction, motor latency, payload variations, and mass distribution.
* Improve Sim-to-Real transfer to ensure learned policies remain stable and effective when deployed on physical robots.
* Implement and optimize reinforcement learning algorithms, including PPO, using Python, PyTorch, and related tools.
* Deploy trained policies using C++, ONNX Runtime, LibTorch, or other suitable inference frameworks.
* Optimize neural policy inference for high-frequency robotic control and low-latency execution.
* Integrate foot-contact estimation, slip detection, and reflex mechanisms to improve stability and reduce the risk of joint damage.
* Test and evaluate locomotion performance in simulation and on physical quadruped platforms.
* Analyze control failures, investigate performance gaps between simulation and hardware, and implement iterative improvements.
* Work closely with robotics controls, simulation, and embedded systems engineers to support integrated robot autonomy.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Control Systems, or a related field.
* Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience in reinforcement learning, robot learning, locomotion control, or autonomous robotics.
* Strong Python programming skills and practical experience with PyTorch.
* Experience training reinforcement learning policies, particularly using PPO or similar algorithms.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim, MuJoCo, or other physics-based robotics simulators.
* Understanding of legged robot dynamics, locomotion control, dynamic balance, or contact-rich robotic systems.
* Practical knowledge of domain randomization and Sim-to-Real transfer techniques.
* Experience with C++ and deploying learned models on robotic hardware or edge platforms.
* Familiarity with ONNX Runtime, LibTorch, or comparable inference frameworks is an advantage.
* Knowledge of contact estimation, slip handling, motor dynamics, or real-time control is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to validate reinforcement learning policies through systematic testing and experimentation.

**Why Join?**

* Work on advanced robotic autonomy and reinforcement learning technologies.
* Develop locomotion policies that enable quadruped robots to handle complex and unpredictable terrain.
* Gain hands-on exposure to simulation-to-hardware deployment and real-world robotics challenges.
* Collaborate with specialists across robot learning, motion control, and embedded systems.
* Contribute to practical R&D projects focused on improving robotic stability, adaptability, and autonomy.

**Work Location & Arrangement**
On-site at the robotics R&D facility in New Delhi, India

title: Growth Associate
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a
**Growth Associate**
to help grow Atlys in the UAE.
  
  
You’ll research the market, figure out what’s working and what isn’t, and help shape and carry out our growth plans for the region. You’ll work closely with the Growth, Marketing and Product teams, and get hands-on with a wide range of problems from day one.
  
  
**The Job**

* Research the UAE market: study travellers, competitors and trends to understand how people in the UAE plan trips and apply for visas.
* Find out what works: track how our campaigns and channels are doing, and pull out clear insights on what to do more of and what to stop.
* Help shape the strategy: turn your research into ideas and plans for growing Atlys in the UAE, and present them to the team.
* Execute on the ground: help launch and run campaigns, partnerships and experiments, and keep things moving across teams.
* Report and follow up: keep simple, regular reports on UAE performance so the team always knows where we stand.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 1–2 years of experience at a high-growth startup, in growth, strategy, business or similar roles.
* Understand the UAE market, or are excited to get deep into it quickly.
* Are curious and research-minded, and enjoy digging into a market to understand what makes people tick.
* Are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets, and can turn data into clear takeaways.
* Are hands-on and reliable: you take ownership, follow through and get things done.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Analyst - Placements
description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Analyst – Placements will support the effective functioning of the Placements

Department through data management, placement analytics, reporting, and process

monitoring via ERP. The role will involve maintaining accurate placement records,

tracking student eligibility and placement progress, analysing placement outcomes,

and preparing management reports to support decision-making.

The position requires a detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive professional who

can work closely with the placement team, students, and internal stakeholders to

ensure smooth and efficient execution of placement activities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

A. Placement Data Management and Analytics

 Maintain and update the placement database, including student profiles,

academic details, CVs, placement status, interview progress, offers, and

joining details.

 Analyse placement data to track key performance indicators such as

placement percentage, average CTC, average fixed compensation, median

CTC, and the number of offers across salary brackets.

 Monitor placement progress against batch-wise targets and highlight gaps,

trends, and areas requiring intervention.

 Maintain accurate records of company-wise hiring, sector-wise placements,

role-wise offers, compensation packages, and recruiter engagement.

 Ensure data integrity, consistency, confidentiality, and timely updation of

placement records.

B. MIS and Management Reporting

Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and periodic placement reports for the

placement leadership and institute management.

 Develop and maintain dashboards, trackers, and analytical reports using MS

Excel and other relevant tools.

 Prepare batch-wise and campus-wise placement summaries, recruiter

reports, and performance reports.

 Generate insights on placement trends, compensation benchmarks, sectoral

hiring patterns, and student placement progress.

 Support the preparation of placement presentations, review documents,

accreditation reports, rankings submissions, and annual placement reports, as

required.

C. Corporate Relations Support

 Maintain and update the corporate database, including company profiles,

recruiter contacts, hiring history, job roles, and compensation details.

 Track recruiter interactions, job descriptions received, hiring requirements,

interview schedules, and recruitment outcomes via ERP.

 Coordinate with the placement team to ensure timely sharing of student

profiles, CVs, shortlists, and other recruitment-related information with

companies.

D. Placement Process Coordination

 Track placement activities from job announcement and student applications

through shortlisting, interviews, offers, and final joining.

 Maintain trackers for student eligibility, applications, interview participation,

selection status, offer acceptance, and joining confirmation.

 Coordinate with the placement team to ensure timely communication of

recruitment schedules, deadlines, and process updates.

 Identify discrepancies or delays in placement data and follow up with relevant

stakeholders for closure.

 Support the smooth execution of placement drives, pre-placement talks,

assessments, interviews, and other recruitment activities.

E. Student Placement Tracking

 Maintain accurate student-wise records of placement readiness, applications,

interview performance, offers, and placement status.

 Track student participation and progress across recruitment processes.

Generate reports on student availability, placement eligibility, offer status, and

pending placement requirements.

 Assist in identifying students requiring additional placement support based on

data and feedback from the placement team.

 Ensure that placement-related student information is handled confidentially

and shared only with authorised stakeholders.

F. Process Improvement and Documentation

 Standardise placement data formats, reporting templates, trackers, and

documentation processes.

 Identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, turnaround time, and

operational efficiency through automation and better data practices.

 Maintain proper documentation of placement processes, recruiter interactions,

and placement outcomes.

 Support data verification, audit requirements, and reconciliation of placement

figures before internal and external reporting.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Analyst – Placements will be evaluated on the following

parameters:

1. Data Accuracy: Accuracy and completeness of student, recruiter, offer, and

placement records.

2. Reporting Timeliness: Submission of placement MIS, dashboards, and

reports within defined timelines.

3. Target Tracking: Timely monitoring and reporting of placement progress

against approved batch-wise targets.

4. Analytical Quality: Quality of insights, trend analysis, exception reporting,

and management information provided.

5. Process Compliance: Adherence to placement data protocols, reporting

formats, and documentation standards.

6. Data Reconciliation: Consistency of placement figures across internal

trackers, dashboards, and official reports.

7. Stakeholder Coordination: Responsiveness and effectiveness in

coordinating with the placement team and relevant stakeholders.

8. Process Improvement: Contribution to improved reporting efficiency,

automation, and standardisation.

**Educational Qualifications:**

 Postgraduate qualification in Business Analytics, Management, Statistics, or a

related field.

6. Experience

 Approximately 10–12 years of relevant experience in MIS, data analytics,

reporting, operations, recruitment operations, or placement administration.

 Experience in an educational institution, business school, recruitment

organisation, or corporate HR function will be preferred.

7. Skills and Competencies

Technical Skills

 Strong proficiency in MS Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions,

conditional formulas, data validation, and dashboard preparation.

 Working knowledge of PowerPoint and professional report preparation.

 Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualisation tools will be an

advantage.

 Ability to work with large datasets, identify inconsistencies, and derive

meaningful insights.

 Familiarity with CRM systems, placement management platforms, or

database management tools is desirable.

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

title: Consultant, Flood Risk
description:
**ERM**
is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As a
**Flood Risk Consultant**
, you will support ERM's global flood risk and water management practice by delivering high-quality Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs), drainage strategies, and hydraulic modelling solutions for infrastructure, energy, and development projects. Working closely with ERM consultants, technical specialists, regulatory authorities, and clients across multiple regions, you will help identify and manage flood-related risks, support planning and environmental approvals, and contribute to resilient, sustainable project design. This role plays a key part in enabling scalable global delivery by providing technically robust assessments, maintaining regulatory compliance, and ensuring projects are delivered efficiently and to the highest quality standards.
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Deliver high-quality Flood Risk Assessments and drainage strategies that support successful planning applications, environmental approvals, and informed decision-making for clients.
* Apply hydrological and hydraulic modelling expertise to identify flood risks, evaluate mitigation measures, and improve the resilience of infrastructure and development projects.
* Produce technically accurate, regulator-ready deliverables that comply with UK and Irish flood risk policies, planning requirements, and industry best practices.
* Support the integration of flood risk, drainage, and water management considerations into Environmental Impact Assessments (EIAs) and wider sustainability projects.
* Collaborate with global ERM teams, regulators, and client stakeholders to resolve technical challenges, maintain project schedules, and achieve successful project outcomes.
* Contribute to technical excellence through quality reviews, knowledge sharing, mentoring of junior team members, and continuous improvement of flood risk assessment methodologies and delivery processes.

**What will you bring?**

* Degree in hydrology, or related discipline.
* Proven experience delivering FRAs for projects including excellent report writing skills.
* Proven experience undertaking peak flow analysis for UK sites using the appropriate UK methodologies (FEH statistical, FEH-RR and/or ReFH2.4).
* Proven experience in hydraulic modelling (e.g. ESRI-TUFLOW / Flood Modeller / HEC-RAS) and drainage system modelling (e.g. InfoWorks ICM).
* Proven experience delivering sustainable drainage system (SuDS) designs (both outline and detailed) for projects.
* Strong knowledge of UK wide (Scotland, England, Wales, Northern Ireland) and Irish flood risk and SuDS related planning policy, regulatory requirements, and local authority requirements.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience technically reviewing others work.
* Experience writing FRA proposals.
* Skilled in using GIS platforms (ArcGIS, QGIS) for spatial analysis.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills & Competencies**

* Data analysis tools (Excel, Python/R for environmental datasets).
* Collaboration tools (MS Office Suite, SharePoint).
* Experience using automation or AI-enabled tools.
* Relevant certifications or advanced qualifications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver FRAs for major infrastructure and development projects, ensuring compliance with planning policy and regulatory requirements.
* Develop outline drainage strategies and designs, including SuDS and preliminary hydraulic calculations.
* Provide technical input to EIAs and planning submissions, integrating flood risk and drainage considerations.
* Manage data collection, peak flow estimation including climate change allowances, hydraulic modelling, interpretation of flood mapping, and recommendations.
* Liaise with regulators (Scottish Environment Protection Agency, Environment Agency, Natural Resource Wales, Lead Local Flood Authorities etc) and clients to ensure FRAs meet regulatory requirements.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to technical quality assurance.

description:

Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

**Job Description**

The Innovation Engineer rapidly turns high-value business opportunities into working Digital & AI solutions. This hands-on role designs, builds, integrates, and tests prototypes, agents, workflows, automations, and applications that can be evaluated with real users before the firm commits to larger-scale investment.

Working closely with Digital Solution Consultants, business subject-matter experts, and enterprise technology partners, the Innovation Engineer owns the technical execution of individual Foundry initiatives, from technical discovery and architecture through prototype development, iteration, feasibility validation, and transition planning. The role balances speed with sound engineering judgment and helps determine whether a concept can be delivered securely, responsibly, and at the appropriate level of scale.

This position also represents a unique opportunity to join as a founding member of our new Digital Innovation Foundry hub in New Delhi. As one of the hub's earliest team members, the Innovation Engineer will have the opportunity to help establish how the team operates, collaborates, and delivers innovative solutions while contributing to the growth of a new strategic capability for the firm.

J.S. Held is continuing to define the development technology stack, cloud patterns, environments, and CI/CD capabilities needed to support innovation at scale. As an early member of the Digital Innovation Foundry, the Innovation Engineer will partner closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, and other technology teams to help shape practical standards, reusable patterns, development environments, and delivery practices. The role requires a builder mindset, strong cloud development experience, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to distinguish rapid experimentation from production-ready engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Rapid Prototyping & Solution Development**

* Build functional prototypes, proofs of concept, agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and lightweight applications that allow opportunities to be tested with real users.

* Document technical assumptions, architecture decisions, dependencies, known limitations, and lessons learned so that decisions are transparent and reusable.

**AI, Agents & Automation Engineering**

* Evaluate solution quality, grounding, accuracy, reliability, performance, cost, and failure modes using test cases appropriate to the use case.
* Build reusable components, connectors, templates, and patterns where they can accelerate multiple initiatives and reduce fragmented point solutions.
* Identify when a low-code, configuration-based, custom-development, or existing-platform approach is most appropriate.

**Cloud, Architecture & Technical Feasibility**

* Design and develop cloud-based solutions in Microsoft Azure.
* Conduct technical discovery and feasibility assessment covering architecture, data, integrations, identity and access, security, privacy, performance, scalability, observability, support, and cost.
* Partner with IT and Enterprise Architecture to define appropriate solution patterns and clarify the boundary between rapid Foundry experimentation and enterprise production delivery.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and constraints early and recommend whether an initiative should proceed, be redesigned, transition to an enterprise team, or stop.
* Contribute technical estimates and delivery options to initiative-level business cases and scale decisions.
* Ensure prototypes use representative data responsibly and do not create unsupported production dependencies or unmanaged technical risk.

**Engineering Foundations & Delivery Practices**

* Partner with IT to help establish the development technology stack, source-control approach, environments, infrastructure patterns, deployment methods, and engineering guardrails for the Foundry.
* Help define and mature CI/CD practices for prototypes and solutions, recognizing that these capabilities are still being established rather than assuming mature pipelines already exist.
* Apply sound software engineering practices including modular design, version control, code review, automated testing, documentation, dependency management, secrets management, and secure configuration.
* Work with IT to define practical development, test, quality-assurance, and production pathways appropriate to solution complexity and risk.
* Implement monitoring, logging, usage telemetry, and cost visibility where appropriate to support evaluation and future supportability.
* Prepare validated solutions for transition by documenting architecture, code, configuration, data flows, deployment needs, operational requirements, and known risks.

**Collaboration, Reuse & Scale**

* Work closely with Digital Solution Consultants and business users throughout discovery, piloting, testing, and iteration rather than treating development as a downstream handoff.
* Collaborate with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Legal, Compliance, and other partners to incorporate enterprise requirements at the appropriate stage.
* Provide initiative-level technical progress, feasibility findings, risks, cost considerations, and recommendations to support portfolio reviews and investment decisions.
* Contribute reusable technical standards, reference implementations, templates, and playbooks to strengthen the Foundry operating model.
* Mentor non-engineering team members on technical possibilities, constraints, and responsible experimentation, and support knowledge transfer to teams that assume ownership of successful solutions.
* · Stay current on relevant AI, cloud, automation, and development capabilities, and evaluate emerging tools based on business fit rather than novelty.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud application development, solution engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, or a related field, including hands-on responsibility for designing and delivering working solutions.

* Strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Python, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with experience building APIs, services, integrations, and user-facing applications.

By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.

Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. title: Team Assistant
description:

title: Product Associate
description:
About the Company

PlaySuper is India's first Gaming Commerce company, pioneering a new way for 500M+ gamers, an audience growing at 19.6% YoY, to shop inside games.

It is a white-label SaaS plugin that integrates into casual and hyper-casual games, transforming in-game coins into real-world value. Players can redeem them for brand coupons, digital services, or even physical products inside fully customizable in-game stores.

For gaming studios, PlaySuper directly solves the industry's toughest challenge, low retention, while also boosting monetisation. For brands, it unlocks a massive high-attention audience that already spends billions on in-game experiences, enabling targeted engagement with measurable ROI. Unlike traditional ads, PlaySuper embeds commerce into gameplay itself, improving recall, conversion, and loyalty.

In under two years, PlaySuper has onboarded 20+ studios, 3,000+ brands, and reached 6M+ DAUs through its partners, backed by $1.6M funding from Jungle Ventures (Chimera), Audacity VC, IAN Capital Fund, 100x.VC, and leaders from Meta, Tata, Dyson, and Amazon.

playsuper.ai

The Role

We are looking for a
**Product Associate**
who thinks in
**funnels, user behaviour, and data**
. You will work directly with the founding and product team on PlaySuper's live commerce surfaces across partner games.

This role is ideal for someone who:

* Is obsessed with why users drop off and what makes them convert
* Can pull their own data instead of waiting for someone else to
* Ships fast, writes clearly, and is comfortable with ambiguity
* Uses AI tools aggressively to move faster

You will not be writing specs in isolation. You will own surfaces that millions of players see.

The role starts as a
**3-month full-time internship**
in Gurgaon and converts to a
**permanent Product Associate**
position on performance.

What You'll Do

* Own specific surfaces of the in-game store: homepage, category pages, product pages, cart, checkout
* Write PRDs, event taxonomies, and analytics specs that engineering can build from directly
* Run your own analysis on funnels, retention, and conversion to find where users leak
* Design and run A/B tests, then defend the results with data
* Work with design to build store experiences that feel native to the game, not bolted on
* Support partner studios with launch readiness, integration checks, and performance reviews
* Build proposals and merchandising strategies for partner games
* Turn open-ended problems into prototypes quickly, using AI and vibe-coding tools

What We're Looking For

* Strong analytical ability, comfortable with SQL and dashboarding tools
* Clear, structured written communication, no fluff
* Genuine interest in gaming, commerce, or rewards-led products
* Ability to prototype ideas independently using AI tools
* High ownership, low ego, fast iteration

Strong Plus (Nice to Have)

* **1-year experience as a Product Associate at a startup or product-led company.**
* **Experience at a consumer internet, e-commerce, gaming, or fintech startup**
* **Familiarity with event-based analytics stacks such as ClickHouse, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Metabase**
* **Prior exposure to loyalty, cashback, rewards, or in-app purchase systems**
* **Shipped side projects, prototypes, or products of your own**

Structure and Location

* **First 3 months:**
  Full-time paid internship. You will own a live surface from day one, not shadow someone else's work.
* **Post 3 months:**
  Conversion to a permanent Product Associate role, based on performance.
* Full-time, in-office, Gurgaon.

title: Commodity Research Analyst - Demand
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Commodity Research Analyst (Demand) will conduct complex trading analytics efforts focused on Grains and Oilseeds Markets with specific focus on the livestock and feed markets. In this role, you will analyse short- and long-term livestock growth trends, margins, inventory, supply and demand fundamentals, industry developments, and government policy changes, with a particular focus on the dairy and poultry sectors in India.
  
  
You will translate livestock market insights into feed-volume forecasts, assess industrialization in the feed sector as a driver of growth, and combine feed-formulation models with industry intelligence to develop dynamic, tradable demand forecasts. The role will support trading, risk management, and asset-utilization decisions across global and local markets.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Develop and execute models and tools to forecast prices, demand, relative value, and global market trends.
* Analyse short- and long-term livestock growth, margins, and inventory, with a focus on the dairy and poultry sectors.
* Translate livestock and feed-formulation insights into dynamic, tradable feed-volume and commodity-demand forecasts, considering feed-sector industrialization.
* Analyse demand, pricing, and supply fundamentals across Corn, wheat, oilseeds, DDGS, and other grain and oilseed by-products.
* Produce weekly supply-and-demand and price updates; assess India’s government policies, industry developments, capacity expansion, and competitive dynamics.
* Partner with traders, commercial teams, analysts, and stakeholders to develop market scenarios, provide actionable insights, support data and technology initiatives, and resolve issues independently.

**Qualifications**
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience, with a minimum of three years of relevant work experience.
* Knowledge of trading, risk management, economics, and commodity supply-and-demand fundamentals, including agricultural commodity markets.
* Strong analytical reasoning and collaboration skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information, derive accurate insights, and build consensus with global teams and local stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree with proficiency in modelling, coding, data science, and big data management, including experience developing supply-and-demand forecasts, price models, scenario analyses, or other trading analytics.
* Knowledge or experience in feed formulation, feed-sector industrialization, particularly in India.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Delhi
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**
Experience: 4-6 Years
  
  
**About the Company:**
Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus)
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona)
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Synthetic Data & Teleoperation Engineer (Robotics)
description:
**About Asiacruit**
At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Synthetic Data & Teleoperation Engineer**
to build simulation environments, synthetic data pipelines, and teleoperation systems that support the development of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and robotic learning.
  
  
You will create realistic virtual environments for diverse security scenarios, develop systems for capturing robotic demonstrations, and manage datasets used to train and evaluate AI models. This role combines robotics simulation, 3D environment development, teleoperation hardware, and data engineering to help bridge the gap between simulated training and real-world robotic applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build synthetic data generation pipelines using NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse for diverse scenarios, including night vision, perimeter breaches, and adverse weather conditions.
* Develop and maintain simulation environments that support robotic perception, planning, and manipulation tasks.
* Design, configure, and maintain VR-based teleoperation systems and hardware setups to capture high-quality demonstration trajectories for imitation learning.
* Integrate teleoperation interfaces and robotics simulation workflows using OpenXR and related technologies.
* Develop and maintain dataset curation, automated labeling, and data processing pipelines for robotic foundation model training.
* Organize and maintain structured, tokenized repositories of robotic demonstrations for training and evaluation.
* Use tools such as Blender and Unreal Engine to develop and refine realistic 3D environments and simulation assets.
* Evaluate simulation realism and identify visual discrepancies between simulated environments and real-world conditions.
* Benchmark and reduce Sim-to-Real domain gaps to improve the reliability of models trained on synthetic data.
* Collaborate with AI researchers and robotics engineers to support VLA model development, imitation learning, and simulation-based experimentation.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Graphics, or a related field.
* Approximately 2–4 years of relevant experience in robotics simulation, synthetic data generation, teleoperation, 3D environment development, or related areas.
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with C++.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or other robotics simulation platforms.
* Understanding of USD (Universal Scene Description) and simulation asset workflows.
* Experience with VR-based teleoperation, OpenXR, or hardware interfaces is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Blender, Unreal Engine, or other 3D content creation tools.
* Understanding of robotic demonstration collection, imitation learning, or robotics dataset preparation.
* Knowledge of synthetic data generation, automated labeling, domain randomization, or Sim-to-Real evaluation is a plus.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to build practical simulation and data pipelines.

**Why Join?**

* Work at the intersection of robotics simulation, synthetic data, and embodied AI.
* Build virtual environments and teleoperation systems that support real-world robotic learning.
* Contribute to the development of advanced AI systems using simulation-driven training and evaluation.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams working on robotics, foundation models, and intelligent perception.

**The Role:**
This is a highly unique opportunity for a Data Scientist to join a new and rapidly growing intraday team. In this role you will partner with our close-knit team of quantitative researchers, data engineers, technologists and data sourcing colleagues to research, engineer, and validate quantitative signals derived from high-frequency equity market data across multiple global markets, while owning the full lifecycle of a signal, forming a hypothesis about what market behavior predicts, engineering it into a feature, validating it with data, and shipping it into a production research platform. This is a research-focused data science role with meaningful hands-on coding and implementing signals within our internal framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Research and engineer features from raw, high-frequency market data, translating market behavior hypotheses into quantitative signals.
* Implement signals within our internal simulation/backtesting framework, iterating between exploratory data analysis and framework-based implementation.
* Validate features through backtesting across historical data, checking behavior across different markets, regimes, and edge cases (e.g., market open/close, low-liquidity periods).
* Collaborate with research and engineering teams to align on implementation approaches, validation standards, and research decisions.
* Explore new and existing data sources to identify candidate signals worth developing further.
* Becoming a domain expert on different deep learning and machine learning applications for high frequency data, analyzing & understanding the underlying dynamics, market microstructure and behaviors within the data.
* Develop insights based on the data and collaborate with the research team to generate tradable
* Developing the utility tools that can further automate the software development, testing and deployment workflow.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Strong academic background – minimum of a bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field.
* Strong data science background, with experience turning noisy, real-world data into validated, well-behaved signals or models.
* Rigorous quantitative programming skills, with the discipline to write accurate, production-quality, and performance aware code, including low-latency implementations where needed. Prior experience with C++ is a plus.
* Working knowledge of financial markets and how trading/market data behaves, or strong aptitude to learn it quickly. Prior market microstructure knowledge and experience with dark pools, trading and exchange data is a plus.
* Practical experience with and theoretical understanding of deep neural networks and other machine learning techniques in high frequency domain is a plus.
* Comfortably making pragmatic modeling tradeoffs under ambiguity while clearly articulating the reasoning behind them with data.
* Exceptional analytical & problem-solving abilities, with a strong attention to detail.

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. **About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:

  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.

The M&E Officer will contribute to these efforts across assigned projects and work closely with program, technical, digital, research, and implementation teams.
  
  

* Strengthen routine monitoring systems, indicator tracking, and data quality across projects.
* Support assessments, analysis, visualization, reporting, and evidence generation for program improvement.
* Promote the use of data and learning for adaptive management and decision-making.

**About The Position**
PATH is seeking a Monitoring & Evaluation Officer to support monitoring, evaluation, learning, and data-use activities across health systems projects. Reporting to the Lead - Learning and Impact, the M&E Officer will support the design and implementation of M&E frameworks, data-collection systems, assessments, data-quality processes, analysis, visualization, reporting, and documentation of learning. The position will work closely with project teams and partners to ensure that timely, reliable, and actionable evidence is available for program management and decision-making.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support the Lead – Learning and Impact in developing and updating the project’s results framework, logframe, MEL plan, indicator reference sheets, data management plans, data dictionaries, and M&E standard operating procedures, with clear definitions, data sources, frequency, responsibilities, and quality standards.
* Help set baselines and targets for key project indicators and track progress against them on a regular basis.
* Design, test, and update data collection tools such as surveys, facility checklists, and interview guides, including digital forms on platforms such as KoBoToolbox or ODK.
* Train state and city teams, field staff, and partners on data collection tools, sampling, informed consent, and data quality.
* Coordinate routine monitoring and periodic assessments, including baseline, midline, and endline data collection across intervention geographies.
* Carry out regular data quality checks, including spot checks, back-checks, and data verification visits; document errors found and corrections made.
* Ensure project data is stored securely and handled in line with PATH’s data protection and research ethics standards; maintain structured, well-documented, and version-controlled datasets with appropriate metadata and access controls.
* Clean, analyse, triangulate, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data; disaggregate findings as appropriate, conduct trend and gap analyses, and maintain progress trackers and dashboards in Excel, Power BI, or similar tools to generate actionable insights for programme teams.
* Support government counterparts at state, district, and city level in analysing and using routine data from HMIS, AB-HWC, and other national portals for planning and review.
