description:
**Principal Analyst, Business Intelligence Service Delivery:**
This role is responsible for leading development and support for the analytics solutions on SAP BW, Azure, Databricks, PBI and BPC. This individual is responsible for leading the business requirement gathering, design technical solutions, implementation, and optimization of solutions.
  
  
This role combines technical expertise with business acumen to ensure efficient and effective IT solutions delivery for analytics operations and automation.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role that requires the use of judgement in applying professional expertise and is expected to work independently with minimal supervision. This Job requires an understanding and application of procedures and concepts of own discipline, attention to detail in making evaluative judgements based on the analysis of information.
  
  
This role requires engaging and supporting global teams and business primarily in the US, good overlap hours required during working
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Design, build, test, and deliver scalable analytics and data solutions across SAP BW, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Power BI, and BPC, ensuring reliability, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Lead end-to-end analytics development and application support, ensuring successful delivery of solutions aligned with business requirements, technical standards, and enterprise data strategy.
* Partner with business, IT, global process governance, and project teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, considering security, scalability, stability, and long-term sustainability.
* Provide technical leadership to internal and vendor development teams, including solution design, hands-on development, code reviews, implementation, troubleshooting, and adherence to engineering best practices.
* Drive operational excellence by overseeing day-to-day application support and maintenance while identifying opportunities to improve system performance, process efficiency, and overall customer experience.
* Lead incident, problem, and root cause management, resolving complex technical issues and implementing corrective and preventive actions to improve application stability and service reliability.
* Transform support operations through automation, AI, self-service, and shift-left approaches, reducing manual effort and continuously improving service effectiveness and user experience.
* Own service excellence and continuous improvement, establishing service roadmaps, proactive monitoring, support procedures, and improvement initiatives based on stakeholder demand and customer feedback.
* Manage onshore/offshore teams and technology vendors, monitoring performance against agreed service expectations and driving accountability for high-quality development, support, and service delivery.
* Ensure strong governance and operational readiness through adherence to release management processes and maintenance of accurate system documentation, requirements, test scripts, knowledge articles, configuration information, and support procedures.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 10-12 years of experience in data and analytics, including designing and developing scalable, high-quality solutions across SAP BW and Microsoft Azure platforms.
* Strong hands-on expertise with SAP BW, Databricks, Power BI, Azure Data Factory (ADF) and ETL technologies such as Informatica; SAP BW certification preferred.
* Strong production/application support experience, with strong capabilities in Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management, including root cause analysis and systematic troubleshooting.
* Proven experience translating business requirements into technical specifications and solutions, covering architecture, data flows, design, development, testing, documentation, deployment, and enhancements.
* Strong understanding of ITIL, SDLC, Agile, and Waterfall methodologies; ITIL Foundation v4 or equivalent certification preferred.
* Experience designing and supporting cross-application integrations involving SAP, Salesforce, and other enterprise platforms, along with exposure to AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot.
* Excellent stakeholder management, collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build strong internal/external relationships and simplify complex technical concepts into actionable plans; MedTech industry experience preferred.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer II, AOP
description:
**Description**
Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. The AOP team is an integral part of this and strives to provide Data and Science Capabilities to fulfill all customer processes in the APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Ops businesses.
  
  
This BIE role sits at a rare intersection and has high growth prospects. On one side, you have cutting-edge ML/OR models making split-second cost saving decisions across Ops network. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside — you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time — that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models.
  
  
The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large-scale, low-latency data flowing through real-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you.
  
  
What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet — they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication — and to own outcomes end-to-end rather than just deliver reports — is what will make you exceptional in this role.
  
  
**About The Team**
The AOP Science Team is the central science team of Amazon APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Operations. We are responsible for creating core science capabilities to scale decision making across domains such as Truck Capacity Optimization, Short-term capacity planning, Network Abuse Detection, Impact analyses, Productivity improvement Models and so on. As a team our goal is to support our customers to make better decisions by leveraging applied statistics, machine learning, OR, deep learning architecture and algorithms. Team owns end-to-end life cycle for science model development which includes data exploration, experimentation, automating near real-time data pipelines, data visualization and model productionization.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Grid Research Associate
description:
**Department:**
Research

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Description**
**About the role:**
Aurora is seeking an Associate to join our India Grid Research team in Gurugram. This is a quantitative and client-facing role at the intersection of power systems, electricity markets and investment analysis.
  
  
You will play a central role in the continued rollout and development of Aurora’s India Grid product, helping developers, investors and lenders understand how transmission build-out, grid congestion, connectivity and curtailment affect renewable projects and investment decisions.
  
  
You will take ownership of analytical workstreams and the delivery of Grid coverage across individual Indian states and regions. This will include analysing transmission infrastructure and connection queues, developing and quality-assuring forward-looking grid and curtailment analysis, and translating complex technical outputs into clear commercial insights.
  
  
We are looking for someone who combines four core strengths:

* **Engineering and grid understanding**
  – a strong understanding of power systems, transmission networks and the physical drivers of congestion and curtailment.
* **Quantitative modelling**
  – the ability to work confidently with complex datasets and modelling frameworks to develop robust forward-looking analysis.
* **Market understanding**
  – an understanding of how generation, demand, storage, transmission and electricity-market dynamics interact, and what these changes mean commercially.
* **Communication**
  – the ability to turn sophisticated technical analysis into clear, compelling insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.

You will work closely with Aurora’s India Research, Grid modelling and Software teams and have the opportunity to develop deep expertise in India’s rapidly evolving power system.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the rollout and ongoing development of Aurora’s Grid analysis across new and/or existing Indian regions, taking responsibility for analytical delivery, quality assurance and ongoing updates.
* Analyse India’s transmission system, including network build-out, connectivity queues, transmission constraints, project commissioning timelines and grid headroom.
* Develop and quality-assure quantitative analysis of congestion and renewable curtailment, assessing how these evolve as generation, storage, demand and transmission capacity change.
* Work closely with Aurora’s Modelling team to translate engineering, power-system and electricity-market assumptions into robust forward-looking analysis.
* Combine grid modelling with electricity-market fundamentals to understand the commercial implications of transmission constraints and curtailment for renewable and storage assets.
* Analyse large and complex datasets using tools such as Python, SQL and Excel, improving analytical processes and identifying opportunities for automation.
* Translate complex modelling results into clear, commercially relevant conclusions, explaining what is happening, why it is happening and what it means for developers, investors and lenders.
* Communicate Aurora’s analysis confidently through client meetings, subscriber calls, webinars, reports and presentations, adapting technical detail to different audiences.
* Work collaboratively across Research, Modelling and Software teams, clearly communicating assumptions, analytical issues and development priorities.
* Support and review the work of Analysts and interns contributing to infrastructure tracking, data collection and validation.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Required attributes:**

* 3-5 years relevant professional experience in power systems, electricity markets, transmission, renewable energy, energy modelling or energy consulting.
* A strong university degree, ideally in electrical engineering, power systems, energy systems, economics, mathematics, physics or another quantitative discipline.
* Strong understanding of power systems and grid fundamentals, including the interaction between generation, demand, transmission and system constraints.
* Strong quantitative and modelling capability, with experience working with complex datasets, models and analytical outputs. Experience using Python, SQL, advanced Excel or power-system modelling software.
* Good understanding of electricity-market fundamentals, with the ability to connect physical grid developments with their implications for renewable and storage projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical analysis into clear, concise and commercially relevant insights.
* Confidence communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences, including clients and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to structure a clear analytical argument, identify the key drivers behind modelling results and communicate the “so what”, rather than simply reporting outputs.
* Demonstrated ability to independently own complex analytical workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs to deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to analytical quality and robust quality assurance.
* Self-starting, intellectually curious and comfortable working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

**Desirable attributes:**

* Familiarity with the Indian power sector, including renewable development, transmission infrastructure and electricity-market arrangements.
* Experience working for a transmission or network organisation, renewable developer, power-market consultancy, utility, system operator, IPP or energy analytics firm.
* Understanding of the commercial considerations facing renewable developers, IPPs, lenders and infrastructure investors.
* Experience working with commercial power system software (PSS/E, Powerworld, etc) and/or doing grid connection studies
* Experience analyzing renewable project connectivity and transmission expansion.
* Experience communicating complex quantitative analysis through client presentations, reports, workshops, webinars or other external-facing formats.
* Master’s degree or PhD in electrical engineering, power systems, energy systems or a related quantitative field.

**What we offer**
Some of the benefits we include are:

* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.
  
  
To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.
  
  
Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

Senior Specialist, Product Management - Commercial Strategy, Pricing & Go-To-Market

* Collaborate with Finance to assess commercial performance, forecasts, and margin implications.

* Interface with GTM stakeholders to ensure front door strategies are grounded in data and market realities.

* Demonstrated experience applying statistical analysis and predictive modelling to support and optimize commercial activities within a product based business
* Strong analytical mindset with exceptional attention to detail.

* Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt insights for technical and executive audiences.

description:

title: Anaplan Model Builder
description:
**Role purpose:-**

The Anaplan Model Builder will design, build, test, deploy and support scalable Anaplan solutions across Finance and the wider business. Reporting to the Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan), the role will translate business requirements into robust models, workflows, dashboards and data structures, while supporting effective platform operation and continuous improvement.

The role will support Anaplan use cases spanning corporate planning, budgeting and forecasting, client and product profitability, cash flow and liquidity forecasting, funding forecasts, management reporting and scenario analysis.

**Key responsibilities:-**

* **Model design and build:**
  Develop modules, lists, hierarchies, calculations, dashboards and user experiences using scalable, maintainable design principles.
* **Requirements and solution design:**
  Work with Finance and business stakeholders to translate planning and reporting needs into functional requirements, model designs, business rules and acceptance criteria.
* **Data and integration:**
  Build and maintain imports, exports, actions and processes; define source-data requirements; validate and reconcile data; investigate load failures with Technology and data teams.
* **Testing and quality:**
  Complete unit testing and support system, integration, regression and user acceptance testing. Reconcile outputs, resolve defects and retain appropriate evidence.
* **Release and change management:**
  Prepare model changes, impact assessments, release documentation and deployment instructions within the agreed environment and governance framework.
* **Platform support:**
  Provide hands-on support for live models, recurring planning cycles, incidents, data issues and performance problems. Maintain and optimise models and identify technical debt.
* **Controls and governance:**
  Maintain roles, selective access, validation controls, documentation, data dictionaries and calculation definitions. Follow access, segregation-of-duties and audit requirements.
* **Adoption and knowledge transfer:**
  Create intuitive user experiences, guides and training materials; support demonstrations and adoption; capture knowledge from delivery partners and build internal capability.

**Key working relationships:-**

Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan); Finance process owners and users; Finance Systems and Technology teams; data and integration teams; external implementation and managed-service partners.

**Key deliverables:-**

* Robust and scalable Anaplan models aligned with approved requirements and architecture.
* Accurate calculations, planning logic, dashboards, workflows and management outputs.
* Reliable data integrations, imports, exports, validations and reconciliations.
* Complete functional, technical, testing, release and operational documentation.
* Stable support for live models and key planning cycles, with timely defect resolution.
* Effective knowledge transfer and reduced reliance on external delivery resources.

**Skills and experience:-**

**Essential**

* Practical experience designing and building Anaplan models in a business environment.
* Strong knowledge of lists, modules, hierarchies, line items, actions, processes and dashboards.
* Experience translating Finance or business requirements into model designs.
* Understanding of multidimensional modelling, data structures and model performance.
* Experience with data imports, exports, transformation, validation and reconciliation.
* Ability to diagnose calculation, data, model and performance issues.
* Experience supporting testing, deployment and live operational models.
* Understanding of planning, budgeting, forecasting or management reporting.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred**

* Anaplan Model Builder certification or equivalent demonstrable experience.
* Experience with FP&A, profitability, unit economics, cash flow or liquidity models.
* Experience integrating Anaplan with ERP, data warehouse or reporting platforms.
* Knowledge of Application Lifecycle Management and controlled deployment.
* Experience in Financial Services or another controlled or regulated environment.
* Understanding of Agile delivery, data governance, access controls and audit requirements.
* Experience working with external implementation or managed-service partners.

**Personal attributes**

* Hands-on, structured and delivery-focused, with strong attention to detail.
* Able to simplify complex calculations and challenge unnecessary complexity.
* Collaborative across Finance and Technology, with clear stakeholder communication.
* Proactive in identifying risks, control gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Pragmatic, dependable and committed to sustainable internal capability.

**Success measures**

* Delivery of assigned developments to agreed scope, quality and priorities.
* Accuracy, reliability, usability and performance of models and outputs.
* Adherence to design, documentation, security and governance standards.
* Successful business testing, adoption and support through planning cycles.
* Reduction in manual activity, defects and dependency on external resources.

**Role boundary**

Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan) owns platform strategy, roadmap, delivery governance, stakeholder alignment, supplier management and overall platform outcomes.
**The Anaplan Model Builder**
owns the detailed design, build, testing, documentation, deployment support and maintenance of assigned solutions. Business process owners approve requirements, assumptions, processes and outputs.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Product Analyst**

**Location**

Gurgaon

**Level**

Analyst

**Experience**

1–3 years in product, business or growth analytics

**About Airtel Finance**

Airtel is building one of India’s most ambitious consumer financial services franchises under the Airtel Finance brand. Airtel already reaches hundreds of millions of customers across the country; the task now is to turn that reach into a financial relationship spanning a customer’s whole financial life across save, pay, borrow, invest and insure use cases. Airtel Finance is the consumer franchise and distribution layer that holds the customer relationship, working with Airtel Payments Bank, Airtel Money Limited and other licensed entities that hold the balance sheet and the regulatory obligations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Funnel Monitoring and Performance Tracking**

* Own and continuously monitor the product funnels across the app and assisted channels, from journey start to KYC completion, account activation and repeat transactions.
* Build and maintain dashboards for acquisition, onboarding, activation, balances and retention.
* Track daily, weekly and monthly KPIs for the product scorecard and flag deviations early.
* Identify and quantify funnel leakage and conversion bottlenecks, including KYC failures and partner-side drop-offs.
* Run root cause analysis to separate customer mix shifts, technical issues, policy changes and partner-side impacts.

**2. Analysis of New Product Initiatives**

* Define instrumentation requirements for every new initiative before it launches.
* Design experiments with clear hypotheses and success metrics, and read out results with a recommendation.
* Build dashboards and quantify the impact of product changes on activation, balances and engagement.

**3. Customer, Cohort and Cross-sell Insight**

* Analyse cohorts to understand activation, balance growth and retention, and what separates customers who stay from those who do not.
* Understand customer voice from app feedback, call centre and field teams, validate it with data and surface the key problem areas.
* Recommend interventions to improve customer experience and funnel efficiency, and track whether they worked.

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in Product Analytics, Business Analytics, Growth Analytics or a related role.
* Strong problem-solving ability and hypothesis-driven thinking.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Proficiency in Excel, Tableau, Mongo, Kibana and other data visualisation tools.
* Working knowledge of experimentation and A/B testing.
* Experience in fintech, banking, digital payments or consumer internet products preferred.
* Ability to translate data into clear, actionable business recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

**What We Offer**

* Scale from day one: products used by millions of customers across India.
* A seat inside a cross-functional POD, with analysis that directly drives product decisions.
* Close proximity to senior leadership, with real influence over the product agenda.

title: Senior Analyst - BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path within BCG's Marketing, Sales & Pricing (MSP) Practice Area, you will deliver on the following responsibilities in-alignment with the client and commercial priorities for the Topic business:
  
  

* Deliver value to clients via individual functional expertise and/or institutionalized knowledge assets (products, tools, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain-specific data and related expertise, etc.)
* You will contribute on cases (client projects) and proposals by contributing relevant analysis and insights and help create strong impact for the client.
* While on these client staffing assignments/ projects you are expected to understand client requirements, business implications and provide in-depth expertise across brand & marketing topics, channel-level understanding to deliver on comprehensive analysis and strategic priorities of the client project.
* You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector working, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops and marketing materials.
* Additionally, as a Senior Analyst in BCG Vantage, you will contribute to developing AI-led assets, agents, Claude Skills as intellectual property for the business. You will further assist in onboarding and training colleagues based on your topic/sector expertise.
* Travel requirements to support client projects, proposals, conversation starters will be minimum 60-80% and may vary across the year
* Liaises with case team leadership and other specialized teams (e.g. BCG X) to bring out the optimal solutions to ensure that requests/projects are delivered in an optimal manner
* Leverage his/her expertise to support project proposals (e.g. outside-in observations, competitive benchmarking, maturity assessment etc) as well as client casework.
* Be responsible for creating and maintaining best-in-class institutional content and knowledge that supports and advances the Digital Marketing topic (e.g. case vignettes, credentials, toolkit evaluations, vendor management, etc).

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Master’s Degree preferred, with demonstrated high academic achievement
* 4-6 years of industry or consulting professional work experience
* Previous experience at a consulting firm, eCommerce, marketing agency firm strongly preferred
* Strong Excel skills required and hands-on experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads
* Understanding of DSP/DMP platforms (Google DoubleClick, DV360 etc.), Mar-Tech, AdTech Platforms, Microsoft Access, and/or Alteryx is a plus
* Prior experience in a start-up environment is desirable
* Flexible, self-motivated, and proactive out-of-the-box and critical thinker
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, fluent written and spoken English
* Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage on the Client Focused path, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up of a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
  
  
With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
  
  
**Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)**

* Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets

**Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)**

* Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients

**Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights)**

* Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data.

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Solving complex client problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions
* Assessing client’s digital marketing strategy, channel level maturity, run in-depth diagnostics and campaign management capabilities.
* Understand the various components and drivers of growth across various stages of the customer journey including – acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and retention.
* Analyze trends (such as traffic, conversion, user engagement, and repeat behavior) and create actionable programs leading to user growth & retention.
* Analyze user journeys to provide actionable insights and recommendations followed by quick experimentation via A|B testing routes on traffic/funnel enhancement to derive immediate impact on KPIs
* Working closely with client teams and agencies to understand strategic objectives and design tests/optimize campaigns to improve digital marketing performance and meet the clients' goals
* Interfacing with BCG case and client teams and reporting on results, in a credible and confident way
* Working collaboratively and effectively in a group dynamic often virtually, proficient in agile ways of working
* Flexibility and bringing a curious and creative mindset, open to new things, and able to propose innovative ideas
* Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity
* Leading projects effectively from start to finish, mobilizing team to deliver on business priorities and commercial impact
* Acting as a highly effective coach and mentor, guiding team members to achieve goals efficiently and effectively
* Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast-paced environment

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Research Analyst - Oil & Chemicals
description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.
  
  
For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.
  
  
Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.
  
  
By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.
  
  
This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.
  
  
Wood Mackenzie
  
  
Intelligence Connected
  
  
**WoodMac.com**
**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**
**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

Wood Mackenzie is the global research, analytics, and consultancy business powering the natural resources industry. For 50 years, we have been providing the quality data, analytics, and insights our customers rely on to inspire their decision making. Our dedicated oil, gas & LNG, power & renewables, chemicals, metals & mining sector teams are located around the world and deliver a variety of projects based on our assessment and valuation of thousands of individual assets, companies, and economic indicators such as market supply, demand, and price trends. We have leading specialists in over 30 locations, serving customers in nearly 80 countries. Together, we inspire and innovate the markets we serve – providing invaluable intelligence to help our customers overcome the toughest challenges, and make strategic decisions that will, ultimately, accelerate the world’s transition to a more sustainable future.
  
  
**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer Committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**WoodMac.com**
**Wood Mackenzie brand video**
**Role Purpose**
We monitor key events and conduct research to produce thought-provoking reports, data models, and presentations. From asset valuation to corporate reports, from market supply-demand research to price-forecasting, and from the regional to the global, our analysis helps shape our customers’ commercial strategies.
  
  
We also support bespoke consulting projects, diving deeper into our data to answer unique questions. We help our Sales team retain and win new business by spending time with customers and answering questions that matter to them. We work closely with colleagues in our Data and Product functions to maintain the quality of our published data and to deliver content via our
**growing Lens platform**
**.**
Through carrying out primary research, responding to customer questions, and presenting to industry stakeholders, you will build relationships and a network of contacts at key operators, national bodies, and other relevant institutions. Over time you will gain specialist knowledge and develop the skills you require to progress your career at Wood Mackenzie.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**
We are looking for an enthusiastic Research Analyst to join our Refined Products and Transport Fuels team. The main focus of the role will be to analyse both long-term and short-term trends in oil product demand. We are seeking a candidate who is passionate about the future of the refined products sector and how it will develop in the coming decades to meet the needs of society in a sustainable manner.
  
  
The successful candidate will join a global team of analysts and industry experts undertaking fundamental research and modelling of all aspects of the oil products value chain. The role offers the opportunity to develop modelling and forecasting skills and comprehensive industry knowledge through regular interaction with other members of the global Oils and Chemicals team. The successful candidate will be required to collaborate closely with cross-functional research teams to develop an integrated view of how oil product and fuels demand is evolving through the energy transition. They will undertake analysis of the key economic, policy, transport and market drivers shaping demand, and provide insightful analysis to our clients through research, presentations, webinars and emails in a timely and professional manner.
  
  
Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the sectors we cover and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie.
  
  

* Research and data gathering – we identify and gather intelligence that feeds our industry expertise. We need inquisitive and passionate people with a keen eye for detail.
* Analysis – we provide market-leading research using this data/intelligence and form opinions for and tell stories to our customers. We need people with natural curiosity with the potential to become experts in their field and with the ability to articulate – both verbally and in writing – clear, insightful analysis.
* Internal engagement – we work with colleagues across the Wood Mackenzie business to deliver a compelling, integrated view of the commodities sector to customers through our cutting-edge products. For this, we need people who are as comfortable working collaboratively as they are independently and who have excellent interpersonal skills.
* External engagement – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand. This requires people with the potential to become industry experts who have intellectual curiosity, passion, and excellent presentation skills.
* Leadership/ Process Improvement – at Wood Mackenzie, we are committed to transforming the way we power our planet. The energy transition is here and this impacts our customer base and how we serve them. We need colleagues with a change mindset, who are flexible, growth-orientated and proactive.

**About You**
You have demonstrable interest and relevant experience in commodity market dynamics, and you want to develop an in-depth understanding of how these markets underpin the natural resources industry and impact our everyday lives. You will have relevant experience as an economist or analyst, skills or knowledge that you can apply to the role, allowing you to contribute to our research from day one. Specific experience in the oil or transport sectors would be an advantage. You are highly numerate, with a high attention to detail and proven analytical and problem-solving skills, enabling you to formulate leading-edge analysis from a variety of data and information. You are focused on continuous improvement and play a key role in implementing better ways of working, including your ability to synthesize solutions/ automations leveraging use of AI.
  
  

* Keen interest in energy demand dynamics - You have a keen interest in understanding how oil product and transport fuels demand is evolving and the economic, policy, transport and market drivers shaping consumption. You can undertake market analysis and contribute to short- and long-term demand forecasts by monitoring market developments, maintaining datasets and analytical models, and developing insightful research and commentary. Working as part of a global team, you will help build an integrated view of how demand will change through the energy transition, contribute to regular research reports and support client enquiries and engagements.
* Analytical mindset and eye for detail - You're comfortable collecting and interpreting data, clearly articulating your findings, and seeking to enhance your knowledge by asking thoughtful questions. You can develop compelling narratives from researched/ available data points to present a strong view of the current market scenario and write insightful commentary on the challenges and opportunities for the refined products . You can maintain and develop data models, methodology and other intellectual property related to the industry. You have experience with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, which helps you present your findings in a visually compelling way.
* Highly adaptive team player - You thrive in a collaborative, commercial and client-centric environment. You will have a proven dedication to meeting the needs of clients and responding to feedback to make service improvements. The way in which you work enables you to build strong, collaborative relationships and influence at all levels. You use this engagement commercially to understand client perspectives and what is important to their business decisions.
* Excellent communication skills - Your strong command of English, both written and spoken, allows you to communicate effectively in the globalised commodity market. You can support with client engagement and showcase the ability to understand and execute client enquiries and ad hoc requests in a timely and professional manner.

**Expectations**

* Growth mindset - taking the initiative to learn new skills, seeking out feedback and actively applying what has been learned in the workplace.
* Change agility - maintaining high performance through disruption and change.
* We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be expected to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment. This is subject to change per company policy.
* This is a full-time role.

**Diversity is at the core of our business**
and we welcome applications from a range of academic or professional backgrounds.
  
  
Hear what our team has to say about working with us: https://www.woodmac.com/careers/our-people/

This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. title: Principal, Tech (GAITech)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced software developer to join our GAI Tech “Strike” team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of the GAI Tech team will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting inter-departmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development which includes AI-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready-to-use applications for developers. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. While the GAI Tech team is a research and development (R&D) group responsible for the development of firmwide GAI tech applications, Strike team is a new sub team, within GAI Tech that will work closely with groups across the firm both to consult on ideas and provide resources to directly implement the highest value projects.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will be working on overseeing the end-to-end development of generative AI applications for the group you are working with. You will work independently, exhibit excellent learning agility to be able to work with a varied set of groups in a time-bound fashion, and showcase excellent judgement in devising and implementing solutions for group-wide needs. You will be expected to exhibit a consultant’s mindset, be able to learn the group’s setup very well, propose the right solutions for their needs, solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the group. You will also be expected to exhibit excellent productivity and demonstrate exceptional and clear communication skills. Lastly, you will be expected to mentor the staff from respective groups to allow for a smooth handover of projects, which will be a key part of the job.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A master’s or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field with 7 to 12 years of relevant industry work experience as a specialist/individual contributor
* Proficiency in Python with exceptional coding and debugging abilities
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities and the capacity to acquire and apply new technologies quickly
* Prior exposure to GAI projects and frameworks
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills along with effective written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* GAI academic qualifications/certifications
* Experience as a tech solution architect

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PrncplGAITechJuly26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

description:
**Title: Analytics Consultant – Web & Mobile (Implementation)**

**Experience: 4+ years in Product Analytics Office**

**Timings: 2 PM to 12 AM IST**

**This role follows a rotational shift aligned with global client requirements.)**

The Role We are seeking an Analytics Consultant – Web & Mobile (Implementation) to deploy and optimise digital analytics solutions using platforms like Heap and Contentsquare. This role focuses on event tracking, implementation, and enabling clients to leverage behavioural data for product, marketing, and growth decisions. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, analytical thinking, and strong client-facing communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities**
1. Technical & Domain Expertise ● Deploy and configure product analytics tools (Contentsquare, Heap) for event tagging, data capture, and KPI alignment ● Integrate analytics SDKs within mobile frameworks (React Native, Flutter, Xamarin) and align with tools like Firebase Analytics or Adjust ● Configure PII masking, API integrations, and data enrichment workflows ● Guide client technical teams in defining tracking requirements using HTML, CSS selectors, and JavaScript for web element mapping ● Implement and validate event tracking to ensure accurate and reliable data capture ● Conduct QA audits using console-based debugging to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness ● Develop detailed tracking plans and implementation documentation ● Analyse web and mobile behavioural data to uncover user patterns and recommend product and marketing optimisations ● Handshaking of data between MarTech tools — A/B testing, CRMs, transaction tools, tag managers, CDPs, marketing attribution tools, in-app guidance, etc. ● Design and implement UTM tracking frameworks and multi-touch attribution models for multi-channel campaigns ● Integrate marketing data sources with analytics platforms for ROI measurement across paid vs. organic acquisition 2. Mobile App Analytics ● Own end-to-end mobile analytics implementation across acquisition, engagement, retention, and user experience — a critical growth area for enterprise clients ● Instrument mobile-specific events (app installs, session start, in-app purchases, push interactions, deep links) and align with attribution SDKs like Adjust, AppsFlyer, or Firebase ● Measure mobile funnels, drop-offs, engagement metrics, retention curves, and cohort behaviour ● Advise clients on mobile metrics frameworks, data governance, and platform-specific nuances (iOS SKAdNetwork, Android privacy sandbox, consent management) ● Partner with client mobile engineering teams on A/B testing strategies and UX optimisation initiatives 3. Client Engagement & Delivery ● Translate business requirements into structured tracking and analytics implementation plans ● Manage end-to-end onboarding and implementation projects within agreed timelines ● Conduct workshops, enablement sessions, and product demonstrations with client teams ● Provide ongoing advisory support to maximise analytics platform value realisation and build long-term client relationships

**Tools & Technologies**
● Analytics: Heap, Contentsquare, GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Adobe Analytics, Webengage, Moengage ● Web: HTML, CSS, JavaScript ● Mobile: React Native, Flutter, Xamarin ● Data warehouse & BI: BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, S3, Tableau, Power BI ● Marketing Tools: AB Tasty, VWO, Salesforce, Hubspot, Segment.io, Shopify, Stripe, appcues, attribute, Firebase, Adjust, Google Tag Manager(GTM). Requirements Essential ● Hands-on implementation experience with one or more analytics platforms: Heap, Contentsquare, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Adobe Analytics, or Google Analytics (GA4/360). ● Experience configuring events, conversions, tracking plans, and data layers. ● Working knowledge of HTML, CSS selectors, and basic JavaScript. ● Experience in instrumenting mobile analytics SDKs. ● Strong understanding of marketing analytics fundamentals (UTM parameters, attribution models, paid vs. organic analysis). ● Familiarity with ETL and BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Power BI, Tableau) for validation and reporting. ● Strong analytical reasoning and ability to translate insights into business recommendations. ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills. ● Ability to collaborate across developers, marketers, and product teams. ● Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments ● Exposure to AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) for accelerating implementation, QA, and documentation Bonus Qualifications ● Experience with session replay and heatmapping tools. ● Familiarity with experimentation platforms (Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, or similar). ● SQL proficiency for advanced data analysis. ● Experience delivering analytics projects for US or European clients. ● Exposure to server-side tracking implementations. ● Knowledge of mobile acquisition and retention metric frameworks. What We’re Looking For Beyond technical capabilities, the ideal candidate demonstrates: ● Strong client empathy and the ability to simplify complex analytics concepts. ● A proactive, solution-oriented mindset. ● Close attention to detail in tracking, validation and documentation. ● Ownership mindset with strong follow-through. ● Curiosity and a continuous learning attitude toward emerging analytics tools and methodologies.

**You’ll Gain in This Role**
● Hands-on experience with leading analytics platforms like Heap and Contentsquare ● Exposure to global clients and complex digital ecosystems ● Opportunity to work across web, mobile, product, and marketing analytics ● Strong consulting + technical implementation skill development ● Fast learning curve in a high-growth analytics environment Why Join Us You will work at the intersection of technology, analytics, and business strategy, helping global clients unlock the value of behavioural data. This role offers hands-on exposure to industry-leading platforms like Heap and Contentsquare, along with opportunities to build deep expertise in implementation, consulting, and digital experience analytics. Scaletrix.AI has helped various companies develop end-to-end solutions by bringing data engineering and data sciences together. title: Associate Manager, Scripting
description:
**Job Description**
**About the team:**
We have Scripting Team in India, based in Gurgaon. This hub is part of our global Operations team, reporting into Operations Director based in the UK office. This team will focus on programming of ad hoc, tracking and syndicated quantitative studies, ensuring that survey instruments are tailored for precision and compliance with industry standards. The team will script and maintain online questionnaires enabling seamless data capture from healthcare professionals, patients, and key stakeholders. By integrating complex logic, customized routing, and validation checks, the team will ensure high-quality, error-free data. Additionally, they will collaborate closely with the analytics and data management teams, facilitating the smooth flow of data for efficient analysis, reporting, and insights generation.
  
  
**Your primary role:**
The Scripting Team lead role will report into The Scripting Senior Manager position. The role will involve help with setting up the scripting function, working with Research and Project Management stakeholders to define the best practice and establish processes for scripting and data processing within the business, as well as managing actual scripting. This will include:
  
  

* Initial set up of the scripting and data processing function, working with a variety of senior stakeholders to understand requirements and suggest improvements.
* Implementation of new processes and policies, including preparing “the best practice” manuals and guides for Research and Project Management staff globally.
* Supporting a transition from an outsourced model to a blended in-house approach.
* Line management of Scripting Executives, including training, mentoring and involvement in recruitment and selection.
* Scripting and programming medium complexity online surveys using the Confirmit platform, incorporating logic, custom routing, and question validation to ensure seamless user experience and data accuracy
* Conducting rigorous testing of surveys before launch, identifying and resolving any programming or logic errors to ensure data integrity and smooth respondent experience
* Cleansing and validating data in the relevant software (SPSS or similar) and process survey data for tabulation
* Managing workloads of the team and delivery across projects
* Liaising with internal clients, advising on best practice, and assisting with problem solving

**About You…**
**Your skills and experience:**

* More than 6 years of experience in a scripting role within a market research agency (ideally healthcare but can be other market research sectors)
* Proficiency in using Confirmit’s scripting platform, including authoring, logic implementation, and deployment
* Solid understanding of scripting languages such as JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for customizing survey functionality and layout
* Experience working with survey data formats (e.g., XML, CSV), as well as knowledge of relational databases and data structure management.
* Understanding of quantitative research methodologies, questionnaire structures, and healthcare market research best practices.
* Demonstrable experience of working with senior and junior team members
* Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
* Excellent analytical and numerical skills
* Strong communication skills, particularly in the ability to explain technical points to non-technical people in an international environment

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**About Inizio Ignte:**
Inzio Ignite a trusted advisor for pharmaceutical and life science companies that turns science into strategy, supporting execution at every stage of the product and patient journey from early commercialization to launch and beyond. Offering market research and insights; strategy; people and transformation consulting; and commercial benchmarking delivered through sector specific connected solutions and intelligence, Inizio Advisory helps create long-term value for clients and their patients.
  
  
*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: Research Associate / Sr Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
description:
Title: Research Associate / Senior Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
  
  
Location: Delhi, India preferred. Applicants must hold Indian citizenship and valid authorization to work in India. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications from OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholders for this role.
  
  
Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.
  
  
Position: Full-time
  
  
Application deadline: Nov 10, 2026, at 5 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
  
  
**About The Role**
Precision Development (PxD) is looking for a Research Associate / Senior Research Associate to join our weather initiative in India. The successful candidate will lead formative research on how AI-based heat forecasts can help agriculture and livestock farmers prepare for and respond to heat. Working closely with PxD and affiliated researchers, they will help define a concrete heat-advisory use case and pilot it with farmers and government partners — testing new ideas and measuring their impact.
  
  
The role calls for someone who is curious about how farmers make decisions under climate risk, comfortable moving between fieldwork and data, and who understands how digital technology is adopted and scaled within government.
  
  
If you're passionate about turning advances in AI weather forecasting into practical, evidence-based services for farmers, and committed to driving positive change in the agricultural sector, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
We're hiring for this role at either the Research Associate or Senior Research Associate level. The specific level will be determined based on the candidate's years of experience, demonstrated seniority, and scope of past responsibilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are outlined below.
  
  
Formative Research
  
  

* Design and conduct formative research (qualitative interviews, focus group discussions, rapid surveys) with crop and livestock farmers to understand how extreme heat affects their livelihoods, decisions, and coping strategies
* Map farmers' current sources of weather information, the timing and lead time they need, and the actions they could take in response to a heat forecast.
* Engage with government agencies, meteorological departments, extension systems, and livestock/veterinary services to understand existing heat early-warning systems and gaps
* Review literature and existing evidence on heat-stress impacts and heat early-warning interventions in agriculture and livestock
* Synthesize findings into clear research briefs and presentations for internal teams and partners.

Use Case Definition & Design
  
  

* Translate formative research insights into a well-defined use case for AI-based heat forecasts, specifying target users, decisions supported, forecast variables, lead times, and thresholds
* Work with data science and forecasting partners to assess the skill and suitability of AI-based heat forecast products for the target geographies
* Co-design heat advisory content and delivery channels with farmers, agronomists, and livestock experts

Data & Analysis
  
  

* Design and program survey instruments (SurveyCTO/ODK)
* Oversee data collection quality, including field visits, back-checks, and high-frequency checks
* Analyze pilot data on farmer engagement, comprehension, trust, behavior change, and early outcomes
* Clean, merge, and analyze weather, forecast, survey, and administrative data (Stata, R, or Python)
* Assess the relationship between heat exposure and agricultural and livestock outcomes using existing data where available
* Monitor forecast performance against observed weather data and flag issues to technical partners
* Contribute to dashboards and data pipelines supporting PxD's weather initiative, as needed

What You'll Bring
  
  

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, development studies, statistics, environmental/climate science, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience conducting field research in LMIC settings, including qualitative methods (interviews, FGDs) and quantitative surveys
* Strong understanding of economics and econometrics, and familiarity with randomized evaluations
* Excellent knowledge of Stata, R, Python, or similar software for data analysis
* Demonstrated experience using SurveyCTO/ODK or a similar program for survey design
* Understanding of research ethics for human subjects in the social sciences
* Interest in climate adaptation, weather and climate services, or digital agriculture; familiarity with weather/forecast data or heat-stress impacts on crops or livestock is a strong plus
* Ability to translate research insights into practical product or service design, working with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent organizational skills, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively
* Fluency in English with strong oral and written communication skills; knowledge of Hindi or another Indian language is a plus
* Ability to work under time pressure and solve problems creatively
* Willingness to travel frequently to project sites and conduct fieldwork, including during summer months

How to Apply
  
  
To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications may be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 5 pm IST.
  
  
In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

title: Senior Analyst, Lending Models
description:
**About Allica Bank**
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
  
  
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
  
  
**Department Description**
The Modelling team sits within the Credit Portfolio Management (CPM) function and is at the heart of building the measurement and decisioning models behind Allica’s lending products. The team builds and owns the bank’s IFRS9 model estate (including PD, LGD, SICR and economic response models), the statistical and machine learning models and credit policy rules used for automated underwriting, and the credit-linked GenAI solutions used to automate processes.
  
  
**Role Description**
This role will be part of the team building, implementing, monitoring and optimising two sets of models: the IFRS9 impairment models that measure our credit risk and support accurate reporting to auditors and investors, and the decisioning models and policy rules behind automated lending, which are critical to delivering fast, consistent and well-controlled credit decisions and a better customer journey as the bank grows.
  
  
The role requires the technical ability and practical mindset to take models and decisioning changes from initial problem definition through data identification, cleansing and analysis to model development, implementation and ongoing monitoring. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between structured model development and fast-paced ad-hoc analysis, working closely with Finance, Credit Risk, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data, Engineering, Capital Markets and Model Risk colleagues. They will communicate complex concepts clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise and work with third-party suppliers where required. We are looking for a hands-on modeller who can turn data into reliable, scalable solutions, and help make data a key strength for the bank.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**

* Take a hands-on role in the design, build, implementation and continuous refinement of the bank’s credit risk models, spanning the full suite of IFRS9 impairment models (PD, LGD, SICR and economic response) and the statistical and machine learning models that support automated lending decisions.
* Develop and deploy models in Python across the full model lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model fitting, validation, implementation and ongoing performance assessment.
* Perform ad-hoc analysis to optimise credit policy rules and decisioning flows, using rule-firing, decision and outcome data to identify redundant, overlapping or mis-calibrated rules.
* Produce regular monitoring, covering population stability, discriminatory power, calibration, and segment and vintage performance, as well as decision rates and alignment with underwriting outcomes for decisioning models.
* Recalibrate or redevelop models as portfolio experience matures, comparing predicted and actual outcomes and adjusting model scaling, score cut-offs or policy thresholds where evidence of drift or mis-calibration exists.
* Lead root-cause investigations into model, rule or decisioning-flow underperformance by tracing issues through decision logs, data lineage, feature calculations, production pipelines and implementation logic.
* Build well-controlled, reproducible modelling processes and drive improvements to the data, tooling and infrastructure required for future model development and deployment.
* Document models, rules, assumptions, limitations and changes to a high standard, supporting governance, independent review and validation, and stakeholder review.
* Work closely with Credit Risk, Finance, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data and Engineering teams to track model requirements and translate business needs into practical solutions, while complying with all mandatory policies and maintaining a strong internal control environment.

**Personal Attributes & Experience**

* You have at least 5 years’ hands-on risk modelling experience, applying statistical modelling techniques such as logistic and linear regression, as well as machine learning models, to solve practical business problems.
* You are comfortable with large data sets, and data extraction and manipulation using Excel, SQL, Python & BI tools.
* You have a proven track record with Python coding, and are comfortable using GenAI tools to increase coding productivity.
* You have a good understanding of IFRS9, credit and lending concepts, preferably in commercial lending.
* You are driven, self-motivated and passionate about building great solutions for the bank.
* You can work independently and are flexible to adapt quickly to changing priorities within a very dynamic environment.
* You work well with stakeholders across the business, and collaboratively within the team.
* You have strong skills in writing technical documents as well as business-focused documents to get buy-in from various stakeholders.
* Experience of implementation of models into software applications is highly desirable.

Prior experience in this area matters for this role. If you believe you are a strong fit for the role, but don’t quite meet one of the requirements above – if you think you can suitably overcome that, then please apply anyway.
  
  
**Working at Allica Bank**
At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
  
  
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:
  
  

* Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities
* Options for flexible working
* Regular social activities
* Pension contributions
* Discretionary bonus scheme
* Private health cover
* Life assurance
* Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

**Don’t tick every box?**
Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!
  
  
**Flexible working**
We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.
  
  
**Diversity**
We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Assistant Manager -Flight Operations Engineer
description:
**Brief About The Role/ Team/ Candidate Requirement**
The role supports the airline’s operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and environmental performance through a combination of data analytics, performance engineering, and CORSIA compliance activities. The position is responsible for generating actionable reports and dashboards from fuel and operational efficiency platforms such as SkyBreathe, Skywise, and AIMS, enabling continuous monitoring of fuel burn, operational performance, and efficiency trends. These insights support data-driven decision-making across Flight Operations, Performance Engineering, and Fuel Management teams.
  
  
The role works closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including Flight Operations, Performance Engineering, Fuel Management, Finance, Sustainability/ESG, A key component of the role involves managing CORSIA-related activities, including the calculation of annual offsetting requirements as per CAR/ICAO guidelines, preparation of Annual Emissions Reports (AER), and maintenance of comprehensive compliance records. This includes emissions data, third-party verification reports, and offset purchase and cancellation documentation, ensuring full audit readiness and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**

* BE / B.Tech - Computer science / AI &ML / Aeronautics or
* BSc - Math / Physics / Statistics
* Data scientist / Data analyst
* Minimum 4 years

**Skill set**

* Python / SQL
* POWER BI / Tableau
* QGIS / ARC GIS / Terrain Mapping
* Data Visualization and Reporting
* Sound knowledge of MS office tools Including power point for presentation

**Key Competencies**

* Dashboards, Reports, hand on experience on BI Application
* Knowledge of A/C Performance and Air regulations and aeronautical charts aspects.
* Knowledge of AIMS / JOC / Rostering system.

**Job responsibility**
**Fuel Efficiency & Operational Performance Monitoring**
Monitor and analyze fuel consumption, operational performance, and efficiency trends across the airline network.
  
  
Utilize platforms such as SkyBreathe, Skywise, AIMS, and other operational databases to generate actionable insights.
  
  
Develop and maintain operational dashboards, KPIs, and management reports to support data-driven decision making.
  
  
**Data Analytics & Reporting**
Create, automate, and maintain performance reports and business intelligence dashboards.
  
  
Analyze flight operations data to identify trends, anomalies, and improvement opportunities.
  
  
Support strategic initiatives through data modeling and operational analytics.
  
  
**CORSIA Compliance Management**
Act as a focal point for CORSIA compliance activities and emissions reporting.
  
  
Calculate annual CORSIA offsetting requirements in accordance with ICAO and DGCA/CAR requirements.
  
  
Prepare and submit Annual Emissions Reports (AER) and supporting regulatory documentation.
  
  
Ensure accurate monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV) of fuel burn and emissions data.

Maintain complete and accurate records of emissions data, offset purchases, and offset cancellation certificates.
  
  
Coordinate with internal and external verifiers during audits and compliance reviews.
  
  
Perform data quality checks, validation, and reconciliation of emissions and fuel consumption records.
