Collaborate with Flight Operations, Performance Engineering, Fuel Management, Finance, ESG/Sustainability, Digital, and Regulatory teams.
  
  
Provide data and compliance support for management reviews, audits, and regulatory submissions.
  
  
Monitor airline environmental performance indicators and carbon efficiency metrics.
  
  
Benchmark operational efficiency and sustainability performance against established targets.

description:

**How You Will Contribute**

* Build the evaluation framework used to determine whether an AI application is fit to go live, covering component, trajectory and end-to-end outcome measurement, with defined pass thresholds integrated into the delivery pipeline.
* Work directly with business subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and convert them into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Design and calibrate automated judging, validating it against human review so that reported scores are meaningful and defensible.
* Own repeatable adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, guardrail bypass and data leakage, and rerun the suite after every material model or prompt change.
* Implement runtime safety controls, including content filtering, sensitive-data redaction, tool permissions, spend caps and circuit breakers.
* Instrument applications so quality, latency, tokens and model cost are observable per request, application and tenant.
* Own model-cost optimisation through routing, caching and prompt efficiency, using evaluation evidence to demonstrate when a lower-cost model is sufficient.
* Monitor production quality and drift, maintain a failure taxonomy, and feed observed failures back into benchmark datasets.
* Validate model upgrades before cutover so vendor model changes do not degrade client-facing systems.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in software, data or AI/ML engineering, with strong Python capability and hands-on experience building production-grade agentic or LLM applications for real users using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, tool calling and retrieval.
* Demonstrable experience designing AI evaluations and measuring retrieval quality, including defining measures and scoring methods, assessing groundedness and relevance, diagnosing failures, distinguishing genuine regressions from noise, and running online evaluations over sampled production traces.
* Practical experience implementing model-safety controls and adversarial testing, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, data leakage, filtering, redaction, guardrails, spend limits and loop controls.
* Experience accessing and deploying models across multiple providers, understanding cost, latency and capability trade-offs, and working with self-hosted or open-weight models, fine-tuning, distillation or prompt optimisation.
* Consulting or client-facing delivery experience, including the ability to work with non-technical subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and translate their judgement into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Hands-on OpenTelemetry instrumentation for nested, multi-step agents, including tool-call spans, session and conversation tracing, trace-context propagation across asynchronous workers and queues, and correlation IDs through background processing.
* Experience with LLM observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases Weave; integration with platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Grafana or Datadog; and structured telemetry for token usage, latency and cost by request, application and tenant.

Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather

managing risks throughout the project.

realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with

computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which

solutions, technologies, and industries.

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to

customer needs
  
  

* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project

delivery

migration strategies
  
  

* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging

technologies

reusable artifacts

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering or Math
* 5+ years of practical work applying ML to solve complex problems for large-scale applications experience
* 8+ years of processing data with a massively parallel technology (such as Redshift, Teradata, Netezza, Spark or Hadoop based big data solution) experience
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, C#, JavaScript, Python, Ruby or Perl
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
* 7+ years of IT platform implementation in a technical and analytical role experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or equivalent in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field, or experience with AWS Solutions, including EC2, S3, Redshift, EMR (or Hadoop)
* Experience using managed ML/AI solutions

title: Research Analyst - Quantitative Research
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai / Delhi NCR

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

**Company:**
Flickly

**About Flickly**

Flickly is an AI-powered quantitative research platform that delivers decision-ready consumer insights in 72 hours, across markets, languages, and audience segments. Going beyond response collection, Flickly helps brands turn consumer data into actionable insights that inform business decisions. We work with D2C brands, growing businesses, and enterprise teams across concept testing, pricing research, packaging evaluation, brand studies, and category deep-dives.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**Research Associate - Quantitative Research**
to join our research team and take ownership of key deliverables across the research lifecycle, from understanding client briefs and designing questionnaires to analysing data and developing actionable insights.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong analytical thinking with a solid understanding of quantitative research fundamentals. You will work closely with the research manager, founder, and cross-functional teams on live client projects, ensuring that research is methodologically sound, data is accurate, and findings translate into clear business recommendations.

The ideal candidate has experience working on quantitative research projects, is comfortable handling data independently, and can take a structured approach to solving research problems in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Research Design & Project Execution**

* Understand client briefs, research objectives, and the business decisions the study is intended to inform.
* Work across concept testing, pricing studies, brand tracking, packaging evaluation, creative testing, usage and attitude studies, and category research.
* Manage assigned project deliverables and timelines, escalating risks and dependencies proactively.

**2. Quantitative Data Analysis & Insights**

* Build analysis tables, cross-tabulations, and relevant data cuts.
* Identify meaningful patterns, consumer segments, behavioural differences, and relationships within the data.
* Translate analytical findings into clear, evidence-backed insights and actionable business recommendations.

**What We're Looking For**

* 1–2 years of experience in quantitative market research, consumer insights, strategy consulting, or a related analytical role.
* Understanding of questionnaire design, sampling, survey methodologies, and research bias.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and draw evidence-based conclusions.
* Proficiency in Excel, including pivot tables, lookup functions, cross-tabulations, and data validation.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint and the ability to present research findings clearly and effectively.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to translate consumer insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage deliverables, meet deadlines, and flag issues proactively.
* A structured, problem-solving mindset and the ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Work Location & Model**

Flickly operates as a digital-first organisation, with this role following a
**hybrid work model**
. Candidates should be based in Mumbai or Delhi NCR and be comfortable working both remotely and from the office as required.

title: Business Administration (MBA) - AI Content Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
What if your MBA — your hard-won expertise in corporate finance, market strategy, and business operations — could directly shape how AI advises executives and drives decisions for millions of businesses around the world?
  
  
We're looking for MBA-qualified professionals to work with Alignerr, partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. You'll stress-test AI reasoning on the toughest business problems, author gold-standard solutions, and ensure these models are truly ready to function as sophisticated partners for executive decision-making.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No prior AI experience needed — just deep business expertise and a sharp analytical mind.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Complex Business Challenges — Craft advanced business cases and quantitative problems spanning DCF valuation, market entry strategy, operations bottlenecks, cap table modeling, and more
* Author Ground-Truth Solutions — Produce rigorous, step-by-step responses complete with financial statements, strategic frameworks (4Ps, 5Cs, Porter's Five Forces), and executive-level rationales that serve as the "golden standard" for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated business plans, financial forecasts, and case study analyses for logical consistency, mathematical accuracy, and professional-grade quality
* Sharpen AI Reasoning — Identify and document logical flaws in AI reasoning — such as ignoring sunk costs, miscalculating WACC, or failing to account for macroeconomic variables — and provide structured, actionable feedback

**Who You Are**

* Holder of a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from an accredited institution
* Strong foundational knowledge across at least two core business disciplines: Finance, Marketing, Operations, or Strategic Management
* Skilled at synthesizing complex data into clear, executive-style analysis and recommendations
* Precise and methodical — you catch errors in financial formulas, data interpretation, and business logic
* Comfortable working independently and asynchronously on your own schedule
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategy

title: Lead Operations Researcher
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Praxas AI is the AI-native decision layer for supply chains. We sit on top of the ERP a company already runs and continuously re-optimize what to make, stock, buy and ship as conditions change helping four primary departments: sourcing, inventory, production planning and logistics. When a supplier slips or a rush order lands, Praxas recommends the response (accelerate a PO, delay a production run, adjust safety stock), and our agents carry it out with Human-on-the-loop approval, , with the long term goal shifting to Human-in-the-loop approval.

**The Opportunity**

We're hiring our first Operations Research Engineer to own the math behind every Praxas decision. You'll build the optimization engine for production planning first, then inventory, sourcing and logistics.

This is a hands-on build role, not academic research or consulting. You'll turn messy factory realities (capacities, changeovers, bills of materials, late suppliers) into models that run on real customer data and re-plan continuously. You'll move between a planner's desk on a factory floor, a solver log and a whiteboard with our engineers without losing the thread.

Our principle is simple: the solver decides, the AI explains and acts. You own the solver. You'll work directly with the founders, our AI and data engineers, and the planners who use what you build every day.

**What You Will Do**

**Build the decision engine**

• Model real plants: capacities, routings, bills of materials, changeovers, labor, material availability and due dates.

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling problems (lot sizing, sequencing, capacity allocation) that minimize lost sales and cost.

• Pick the right method for each problem: mixed-integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics or decomposition.

• Keep solve times fast enough to re-plan on demand for plants with hundreds of products.

• Design models that are configured per customer (industry, production type, demand pattern), not rewritten per customer.

**Make re-optimization continuous and trustworthy**

• Build rolling-horizon re-planning that reacts to new orders, delays and breakdowns without reshuffling the whole plan.

• Use time fences, frozen windows and change penalties so planners can trust the schedule.

• Turn the trade-off between optimality and stability into a setting planners understand.

• Model uncertainty in demand, lead times and yields with stochastic or robust approaches.

**Extend into inventory optimization and forecasting**

• Build inventory optimization: safety stock, reorder points, service-level targets and multi-location policies.

• Use probabilistic forecasts (ranges, not single numbers) as optimizer inputs, working with our forecasting engine.

• Backtest every model against customer history before it touches a live plan.

Ship with customers and the team

• Work directly with planners and plant heads at our design partners to validate constraints and results.

• Feed our AI agents the decisions they act on: delay a production run, expedite a PO, adjust safety stock.

• Tell our data engineers exactly what data each model needs, and how to handle missing or messy inputs.

• Define and track the metrics that prove value: lost sales avoided, inventory freed, on-time-in-full and machine utilization.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In the first 90 days**

• Ship v1 of the production planning model, running on real data from our first design partners.

• Set a baseline for each partner: current lost sales, utilization, changeover time and plan versus actual.

• Agree solve-time and plan-stability targets with the team, and meet them on partner data.

• Document every model's formulation, assumptions and parameters so others can extend it.

**Within 6–12 months**

• Run continuous re-optimization in production for every customer, with stability controls planners trust.

• Deliver results customers sign off on: fewer lost sales, less excess inventory and better on-time-in-full.

• Connect inventory optimization and probabilistic forecasts to production planning in one engine.

• Build reusable model templates by production type (job shop, batch, assembly, continuous) to cut implementation time.

• Own the operations research roadmap, and help hire and mentor as the team grows.

**Who You Are**

**Required**

• Operations research and advanced modeling: design and implement advanced analytical models using techniques such as mixed-integer linear programming, discrete event simulation, Monte Carlo simulation, stochastic modeling and decision analysis under uncertainty.

• Experience building optimization or planning models that real operations ran on, beyond academic work.

• Strong formulation skills in mixed-integer and/or constraint programming.

• Experience with optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, etc.).

• Experience with simulation tools such as AnyLogic, Simio, Arena or similar.

• Working knowledge of production planning: master scheduling, MRP, capacity planning, lot sizing and sequencing.

• Solid probability and statistics, including demand uncertainty and safety stock math.

• Production-quality Python and comfortable SQL.

• Advanced degree (MS or PhD preferred) in operations research, industrial engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, data science or a related quantitative field.

**Preferred**

• Experience at a supply chain planning software company (such as o9 Solutions, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, SAP IBP or Coupa), or on an in-house planning or OR team at a manufacturer, retailer or 3PL.

• Rolling-horizon planning and schedule-stability methods used in production systems.

• Inventory optimization: service-level targets, (s, S) and (R, S) policies, multi-echelon networks.

• Forecasting for intermittent or lumpy demand (Croston, SBA, TSB) and probabilistic forecasts.

• Heuristics, metaheuristics or decomposition for large problem instances.

• Experience with simulation tools such as AnyLogic, Simio, Arena or similar.

• Process industries (chemicals, food, CPG): batches, shelf life, sequence-dependent cleaning.

• Experience with Indian mid-market manufacturers or their ERPs (Tally, SAP Business One).

• APICS CPIM or CSCP certification.

• Experience pairing optimization with LLM or agent systems.

• Familiarity with Silver, Pyke and Thomas, Inventory and Production Management in Supply Chains, the foundation of our engine.

**What We Offer**

• A founding-team role where you own the core IP the company is built on.

• Competitive salary plus meaningful ESOPs.

• Real customer data from day one, and a direct line to the founders.

• The chance to define how a new generation of supply chain software makes decisions.

title: Biostatistician
description:
**Company Description**
AlzaSyno Life Sciences is a Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing end-to-end services to pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical device, and Ayurvedic organizations. The company delivers expertise across clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, medical writing, and regulatory affairs, supporting studies from Phase 1 to Phase 4. Teams design and manage clinical trials, ensure regulatory compliance, and oversee accurate data collection, validation, and analysis. AlzaSyno Life Sciences also prepares documentation for regulatory submissions and acts as a liaison with global regulatory authorities, helping clients navigate complex approval pathways efficiently.
  
**Role Description**
The Biostatistician role at AlzaSyno Life Sciences is a full-time, on-site position based in Gurugram. The Biostatistician will design statistical analysis plans for clinical trials across multiple phases and therapeutic areas, ensuring appropriate methodologies are selected and applied. Day-to-day responsibilities include performing statistical analyses, conducting survival and other advanced analyses, validating datasets, and interpreting results to support clinical and regulatory decisions. The role involves preparing statistical sections of clinical study reports, contributing to regulatory submission packages, and collaborating closely with clinical operations, data management, and medical writing teams. The Biostatistician will also participate in protocol development, sample size calculations, and ongoing review of study data for quality and consistency.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Statistics, including clinical trial methodology and study design.
* Proficiency in Statistical Programming and Statistical Software (e.g., SAS, R, or equivalent).
* Demonstrated Analytical Skills for interpreting complex clinical data and generating meaningful insights.
* Experience with Survival Analysis and other advanced biostatistical techniques.
* Master’s degree or higher in Biostatistics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Experience in biostatistics within a CRO, pharmaceutical, or clinical research environment is preferred.
* Ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams and communicate statistical concepts clearly to non-specialists.
* Attention to detail, strong documentation skills, and commitment to regulatory and data integrity standards.

title: Risk Analyst
description:
We are looking for an experienced Folk with strong Commercial and Small Business Credit Risk expertise to lead client engagements across credit strategy, underwriting, portfolio management and risk analytics. This is a hands-on leadership role. The individual will lead client conversations and delivery teams while remaining sufficiently close to the analytics to independently challenge hypotheses, review methodologies, interrogate data, validate recommendations and, when required, perform hands-on analysis.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial & Small Business Credit Risk Engagement

* Lead problem definition, analytical approach, workplan, quality review and executive-level recommendations.
* Support acquisition and underwriting, credit policy and risk strategy, risk-based pricing, credit limits and exposure management, portfolio monitoring, early-warning strategies, delinquency and collections, and concentration risk.
* Work across commercial/business loans, term loans, working-capital lending, lines of credit, merchant financing and business cards.

2. Drive Analytical Problem Solving

* Translate ambiguous business and credit-risk problems into structured analytical hypotheses.
* Perform or guide portfolio segmentation, vintage/cohort analysis, delinquency and roll-rate analysis, loss analysis and risk-driver assessment.
* Evaluate underwriting criteria using bureau, financial, transaction/cash-flow and alternative data.
* Assess opportunities for automated underwriting and decisioning.
* Develop recommendations around approval rates, losses, profitability and portfolio growth.
* Guide the design of early-warning indicators and portfolio monitoring frameworks.

3. Credit Strategy & Portfolio Management

* Review and optimize eligibility, score cut-offs, exposure limits, pricing and line-assignment strategies.
* Conduct segment, industry and concentration-risk analysis.
* Identify emerging risk patterns and translate findings into policy interventions.
* Balance portfolio growth with credit losses, profitability and risk appetite.
* Develop champion/challenger strategies and structured test-and-learn frameworks.

4. Hands-on Technical Leadership

* Hands on experience with SQL and Python
* Independently conducting exploratory analysis when needed.
* Reviewing model and strategy outputs and identifying analytical gaps.
* Challenging statistical assumptions and business conclusions.
* Developing executive-ready analytical storylines from raw results.
* Providing hands-on support during critical delivery phases.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; Master’s preferred.
* 4 plus years of relevant experience, with meaningful experience in Commercial, SME or Small Business Credit Risk.
* Experience in banking, financial services, fintech or credit-risk consulting/analytics.
* Demonstrated experience leading credit-risk analytics engagements or major workstreams.
* Strong understanding of commercial/SMB underwriting and portfolio management.

title: Senior Associate - Value at Risk

This involves calculating and analysing risk metrics, back-testing the model performance, assessing the impact on regulatory capital for new products, businesses and trading strategies, and performing regulatory capital calculations.

title: BI&A Services Director
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Enterprise Services (ES) was established in 2022 to provide efficient, resilient, and scalable services to support the evolving needs and complexities of a more digital BCG. ES brings together business-critical operations - such as Business Intelligence & Analytics, Procurement & Payables, Global Finance Operations, and Executive Support Services - alongside specialist expertise including Real Estate, Travel, and Meetings & Events. United by a common service mindset, ES enables every BCGer to focus on the work that matters most by giving time and energy back through streamlined, reliable service delivery. In doing so, ES creates cost advantage and strengthens BCG’s market differentiation, while reducing risk through consistent controls and business continuity. Through scalable platforms and globally integrated ways of working across our strategic core global hubs, Enterprise Services enhances agility and helps unlock the potential of those who advance the world.
  
  
The Business Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A) Hub is the centralized global reporting and analytics capability within Enterprise Services that aims to build world-class information & analytics capability for BCG, bringing powerful insights at the fingertips of our decision makers. The hub has been scaled to serve 90+ senior stakeholders across multiple business units, with scope expanding beyond finance into Enterprise Services and other non-finance functions. The team partners with senior leadership across BCG's business segments, senior finance management, and local, regional, and global finance colleagues
  
  
As the Director, BI&A Services, you will lead the
**delivery and engagement with a set of senior stakeholders and their teams across Finance, Enterprise Services and other functions**
. In partnership with the Senior Director, BI&A Services, you will play a pivotal role in building, stabilizing, and scaling the vertical by defining its vision, strategic priorities, operating model, and long-term roadmap, while continuously evolving the function to maximize BI&A's impact across the organization.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted thought partner to functional leadership, bringing strategic insights, innovative methodologies, and data-driven perspectives to shape functional strategies, manage business risks, and address evolving business needs. You will build and manage strong relationships with senior stakeholders, effectively communicate strategic plans and recommendations, influence enterprise decision-making, and contribute to global initiatives by bringing a holistic, big-picture perspective.
  
  
You will be a strong advocate for change and for embracing technology for good, drawing on your experience and confidence to introduce new ways of thinking and to further sharpen analytics capabilities across the functions you serve. You will lead cross-functional partnerships and communications across BI&A, BCG Global Services, and the global functions in scope.
  
  
In addition, you will lead a high-performing team of BI&A professionals, directly managing Managers and Team Leads while fostering a collaborative, value-driven culture. You will be responsible for developing talent, building organizational capability, driving performance excellence, and creating an environment of continuous learning, innovation, and accountability.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Analytics, or a related discipline preferred; CA or equivalent professional qualification welcome
* 15+ years of relevant finance experience
* Very strong problem solving & analytical skills
* Excellent communication skills; written and verbal
* Flexible to work across time zones
* Proven ability to work effectively in a global environment with people at all levels, preferably in a professional services organization
* Experience in people management
* Strong knowledge of financials statements including P&L, Balance Sheet, etc.
* Experience in using Gen AI (OpenAI, ChatGPT etc.) for personal and team productivity

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a member of the Business Intelligence Team, you will interact extensively with a diverse range of stakeholders from across the business, both geographically and functionally. This includes, but is not limited to
  
  

* Global Function Heads and senior leadership across Practice Areas, BCG X Finance, Enterprise Services, & other Global Functions.
* BI&A Services Senior Director and peer Directors across the BI&A Hub

Additional info
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
**Functional & Technical Expertise**

* Strong business analytics expertise with deep experience in business intelligence, data analytics, management reporting, and performance insights across multiple functional domains, including Finance.
* Navigating ambiguity and complexity by translating data into actionable insights and compelling business narratives.
* Structuring hypotheses, designing rigorous analytical approaches, developing scalable data models, and solving complex, undefined business problems.
* Strong proficiency with modern BI, reporting, and visualization tools, with a continuous learning mindset and eagerness to adopt emerging technologies.

**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving**

* Bringing a strategic, enterprise-wide perspective to business challenges and opportunities.
* Anticipating long-term implications, evaluating trade-offs, and developing sustainable solutions and mitigation strategies.
* Simplifying complex problems and enabling clear, data-driven decision-making

**Communication, Collaboration & Influence**

* Building trusted relationships and effectively influencing senior stakeholders across functions, geographies, and time zones.
* Communicating complex analyses and strategic recommendations with clarity and impact.
* Collaborating effectively across teams while fostering an inclusive, high-performing environment through coaching and mentorship.

**People Leadership**

* Leading, developing, and inspiring teams of managers, team leads, and analytics professionals.
* Creating a culture of curiosity, continuous learning, innovation, and accountability through active coaching and talent development.
* Leading by example and fostering a strong, values-driven team culture focused on excellence and business impact.

**Program & Change Leadership**

* Driving complex cross-functional programs and organizational change initiatives from strategy through execution.
* Navigating changing priorities and stakeholder needs while maintaining focus on outcomes and execution excellence.
* Challenging the status quo and championing new ways of working, leveraging technology and analytics to drive meaningful transformation.

**Execution Excellence**

* Thriving in a fast-paced, intellectually rigorous, and service-oriented environment.
* Demonstrating strong organizational, planning, and process management skills while effectively balancing multiple priorities.
* Driving multiple workstreams to successful completion through strong prioritization, execution discipline, and stakeholder alignment.
* Experience working in Agile environments or a willingness to adopt Agile ways of working.

*"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*

**Tax Policy Vertical at the ICPP, Ashoka University**
, bringing together Ashoka's academic and interdisciplinary strengths with a strong focus on real-world policy questions.

The Vertical aims to build an independent, long-term research and policy platform focused on
**how India can strengthen tax administration, compliance and institutional design while supporting investment, productivity, formalisation and growth**
. Its work will combine rigorous research, evidence generation, international benchmarking and implementable policy design, with engagement across the policy cycle.

The Vertical will initially focus on
**tax administration and compliance across all taxes**
, while building distinctive datasets, research capacity and institutional partnerships over time. It will serve as a
**research institution, policy sounding board and convening platform**
, with independence and freedom from commercial or success-based advisory work at its core.

**About the Role**

The Tax Policy Vertical at the Indian Council for Public Policy (ICPP), Ashoka University, is establishing India's leading independent centre for research on taxation, tax administration and public finance. The centre aims to generate rigorous evidence, inform policy reforms, strengthen state capacity, and contribute to India's long-term economic growth agenda under
*Viksit Bharat 2047*
.

We are looking for a highly motivated Research Associate with 2–3 years of experience in economics, public policy, public finance, or related fields to support research, policy analysis and stakeholder engagement across direct taxes, indirect taxes, tax administration and institutional reforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Research & Policy Analysis**

* Conduct quantitative and qualitative research on taxation, public finance and economic policy.
* Analyse datasets relating to taxation, investment, compliance costs, litigation and economic growth.
* Analyse tax laws, administrative processes and institutional reforms in India and internationally.
* Undertake literature reviews, comparative policy studies and international benchmarking.
* Support development of policy papers, issue briefs, working papers and discussion notes.

**Policy Development**

* Support formulation of evidence-based policy recommendations.
* Assist in developing long-term reform frameworks on tax policy and administration.
* Contribute to research on tax competitiveness, investment climate and ease of doing business.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Support consultations with government officials, academia, industry, multilateral organisations and civil society.
* Prepare background notes, meeting briefs and consultation summaries.
* Assist in organising policy roundtables, workshops and conferences.

**Knowledge & Communication**

* Prepare presentations, policy decks and research summaries for senior policymakers.
* Monitor domestic and global developments in taxation and public finance.
* Contribute to blogs, newsletters and knowledge products.

**Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy or related discipline.
* 2–3 years of experience in:
* Public policy research organisations/Think tanks
* Economic/Strategy/public sector consulting
* Excellent analytical and research skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of India's federal tax system, fiscal policy and public finance.
* Experience working with government datasets and policy reports.
* Quantitative skills (Excel required; familiarity with Stata, R or Python preferred).
* Excellent writing and presentation skills.
* Ability to synthesise complex evidence into clear policy recommendations.
* Strong project management and stakeholder coordination abilities.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**PURPOSE**

The Revenue Manager is responsible for driving total hotel revenue and profitability through strategic pricing, inventory management, demand forecasting, and market intelligence. The role focuses on maximising revenue across Rooms, Suites, Food & Beverage outlets, Banqueting and Events, and other ancillary revenue streams while preserving unit's luxury positioning and guest experience standards.

The incumbent will lead the hotel’s revenue management strategy by analysing market demand, competitor performance, booking trends, and distribution channels to optimise occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), Revenue per Available Room (RevPAR). Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, Finance, and Operations, the Revenue Manager will support data-driven commercial decisions that enhance market share, profitability, and long-term business growth.

**KEY ORGANISATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

**Reports To:**
Director of Sales & Marketing

**Direct Reports:**
Revenue Executive(s), Reservations Associate

**Interacts With:**

**External**

* Online Travel Agencies (OTAs)
* Corporate Travel Partners
* Revenue Management Consultants
* Market Benchmarking and Distribution Partners (STR, RateGain, etc.)

**Internal**

* General Manager
* Director of Sales & Marketing
* Reservations Team
* Front Office
* Finance
* Food & Beverage
* Banquets & Events
* Marketing
* IT
* Hotel Operations Teams

**Revenue Strategy & Optimisation**

* Develop and execute revenue management strategies to maximise ADR, RevPAR, occupancy and profitability.
* Monitor booking pace, pickup trends, market demand and competitor pricing to implement dynamic pricing strategies.
* Manage room inventory, room category availability, restrictions, controls, and overbooking strategies where appropriate.
* Optimise revenue opportunities across transient, corporate, wholesale, group and MICE segments.
* Collaborate with Sales and Events teams to evaluate group business opportunities and displacement analyses.
* Oversee banquet and event space inventory utilisation to maximise revenue contribution from Meetings, Conferences, Weddings and Social Events.
* Ensure optimal rate positioning across all direct and indirect distribution channels.

**Forecasting, Analytics & Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly and annual revenue forecasts for Rooms and total hotel revenue.
* Produce rolling forecasts by segment, channel to support strategic planning and budgeting.
* Monitor and analyse key performance indicators including ADR, RevPAR, Market Penetration Index (MPI), Revenue Generation Index (RGI) and occupancy performance.
* Provide actionable revenue insights through market trend analysis and business intelligence reporting.
* Support annual budgeting, strategic planning and long-range forecasting processes.
* Utilise STR, RateGain and internal reporting tools to identify opportunities and market risks.

**Distribution & Channel Management**

* Maintain rate parity and inventory accuracy across all distribution channels.
* Monitor OTA performance, direct booking trends, channel costs and contribution margins.
* Manage rate loading, promotions, packages and strategic offers through PMS, CRS and channel management platforms.
* Evaluate distribution partnerships and recommend initiatives to improve revenue and profitability.

**Commercial Collaboration**

* Lead weekly Revenue Strategy Meetings to review pace, forecast accuracy, market demand and business mix.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing teams to align promotional activities with demand forecasts.
* Support commercial decision-making through pricing recommendations and revenue impact assessments.
* Work closely with Operations to ensure revenue strategies are aligned with guest expectations and service standards.

**Leadership & People Development**

* Drive a revenue-focused culture throughout the hotel by promoting commercial awareness across departments.
* Coach and mentor revenue and reservations team members.
* Facilitate training on revenue management principles, forecasting methodologies, Best Available Rate (BAR) strategies, and distribution management.
* Establish performance objectives and development plans for team members.

**Work Experience**

* Minimum 5-7 years of experience in Revenue Management within luxury hotels.
* Prior experience with luxury city hotels, luxury lifestyle hotels, or leading hospitality brands preferred.
* Proven track record in driving ADR, RevPAR and total revenue growth.

description:
**Purpose**

The CEEW’s sustainable water programme informs policy-making for the sustainable development of water resources and their effective management through research in the areas of: circular water economy for urban resilience; climate risk-informed water security planning; climate-adaptive water governance; and water accounting-based planning.

For its sustainable water programme, CEEW seeks to hire a Research Analyst with a good understanding of India’s water sector. An ideal candidate should have a thorough understanding of urban water management issues and challenges, especially considering the climate variability and change, and the current policy discourse (supply and demand management, and used water treatment, recycling, and reuse) for addressing them. The candidate should have prior experience working in the used water management and circular economy sectors.

Along with a policy research orientation, the candidate should possess strong data analysis skills and support the organisation in accessing various existing secondary data sets, such as those from the Census of India, Urban Local Bodies, Central and State Pollution Control Boards, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Ministry of Jal Shakti, India WRIS or any other data sets available in the public domain. The candidate should have proficiency in using statistical tools. Hands-on experience with geo-spatial tools and experience of working in projects involving the engagement of urban local bodies will be desirable.

**Job Duties and Accountabilities**

**Research:**

* Assist in the development of city-level TUW reuse plans.
* Conduct primary surveys, including sampling, design and questionnaire development, and undertake field visits to collect data and information related to water supply and demand across different sectors within the city or specific region.
* Analyse primary and secondary water-related datasets using statistical tools to estimate the city water balance, assess the existing used water management scenario, and identify TUW reuse avenues.
* Conduct a financial assessment using various budget estimation techniques to assess the financial viability of the proposed city-level treated used water reuse plan
* Conduct life cycle cost assessments of used water treatment technologies
* Assist in writing high-quality research reports

* Travel to project sites, if required, to monitor field surveys, conduct interviews or collect data for different research projects
* Any other assistance that may be required

**Selection Criteria**

**Education and Experience:**

* Master’s degree in environmental sciences/management/planning, water resources management, urban planning/management, hydrology, public policy or a related field
* Prior experience in working with urban local bodies, used water treatment technologies and reuse solutions, and the economics of used water resource management.
* Proven evidence of conducting effective stakeholder engagement.
* 1–2 years of work experience

**Skills:**

* Competent in collecting and analysing data
* Good report writing skills
* Good data visualisation skills
* Competent in using MS Office application suite
* Proficiency in RS/GIS will be an added advantage

**Personality:**

* Willingness to learn new skills in research and project management
* Ability to adapt and deliver work under tight deadlines in a professional environment
* Striving for rigour in research and quality in work output
* Ability to work in an interdisciplinary and multicultural environment

Competitive compensation – commensurate with the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.

CEEW is an equal opportunity employer, and the selection process does not discriminate based on age, gender, caste, ethnicity, religion, or sexuality. Female candidates are encouraged to apply.

title: Independent Consultant, Market Shaping - Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health. We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead (Pb) exposure is a silent yet devastating global health crisis, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Research from UNICEF and other partners estimates that 1 in 2 children in LMICs have elevated blood lead levels, contributing neurological damage, reduced cognitive development, and a variety of health impacts.
  
  
Lead exposure in India arises from multiple sources, with leaded decorative paints and used lead-acid batteries (ULABs) representing the two most significant. Despite a regulatory limit of 90 ppm for lead in decorative paints, widespread non-compliance among SME manufacturers means lead chromate pigments continue to enter the paint supply chain. ULABs are the single largest source of secondary lead in India, with approximately 1.1 million metric tonnes generated annually across the automotive, telecom, inverter, and UPS sectors; informal recycling of spent batteries releases lead into surrounding communities, disproportionately affecting children.
  
  
WJCF has launched a new Lead Exposure Program, building on its proven market shaping capabilities and experience partnering with governments to address large-scale and cross-sectoral health challenges. Program priorities include
  
  

* Devising and implementing strategies to support paint SME manufacturers in transitioning from lead inputs to safer and sustainable alternatives (organic pigments)
* Scoping gaps and intervention areas for market-shaping opportunities across the lead exposure program, spanning diagnostics (pXRF), treatment (chelating agents), and source-side mitigation (plastics, other sources)

The incumbent will support across multiple market shaping workstreams as detailed below.
  
  
Position Details
  
  
We are seeking an analytically rigorous and entrepreneurial individual to support the design, implementation, and monitoring of WJCF’s market shaping interventions. The role involves market assessment, value chain analysis, stakeholder interviews, policy analysis, and financial modelling. It spans government, private sector, and civil society actors, and sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, environmental health, and government engagement.
  
  

* Location New Delhi, with domestic travel to pilot states.
* Duration Up to 6 months, extendable based on performance
* Market Strategies to Transition Paint SMEs to Safer Alternatives

**Transition to Lead-Free Paints**

* Support the scoping and implementation of targeted pilot interventions to enable industry transition to lead-free paints, including addressing SME barriers to transition, supply chain solutions, and related market-shaping measures.

**Pilot Planning & Design**

* Develop detailed pilot blueprints for selected interventions implementation plans, resource requirements, partnerships, budgets, timelines, risk assessments, and mitigation strategies.
* The intervention hypotheses under consideration are

+ Aggregate raw material demand Test the feasibility of aggregating demand from medium-sized paint manufacturers to secure lower-cost lead-free inputs and incentivize greater reformulation of paints to lead-free alternatives.
+ Leverage institutional procurement Identify high-volume institutional paint buyers and work with them to adopt lead-free procurement commitments, creating demand-side pressure for manufacturers to reformulate their products.

* Prepare implementation toolkits and support materials for roll-out as needed.

**Exploring Lead-Free Pigment Transitions in Non-Paint Sources**

* Mapping lead and lead-free pigment supply chains, assess switching barriers, and evaluate the feasibility of lead-free alternatives in other sources (plastics, turmeric)
* Identify opportunities and support concept to proposal writing, including defining and prioritizing intervention areas.
* Market Shaping for Portable XRF (pXRF)

**Accelerate access to affordable pXRF for research and routine government environmental testing**

* Conduct a supplier and distribution landscape of pXRF devices
* Assess device availability and pricing across suppliers
* Map demand with stakeholders, including current pXRF use and unmet needs
* Understand procurement pathways and regulatory frameworks
* Assess end-user needs to evaluate product-market fit
* Market shaping for Chelating Agents

**Enable access to affordable oral chelation therapy**

* Expanding access to chelation drugs through improved sourcing and procurement to reduce costs and enable addition in essential drug lists
* Assessing alternative formulations or delivery approaches that could improve affordability and feasibility in low-resource settings
* Cross-cutting

**Stakeholder Engagement and Reporting**

* Support proposal development, including concept notes, funding proposals, and progress reports.
* Support stakeholder management across donor, government, private sector, and civil society partners.
* Maintain programme tracking tools and contribute to milestone monitoring.
* Scope can potentially evolve basis developing understanding of the above lead exposure program areas
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, economics, public policy, or a related field; a postgraduate degree is preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience with a strong analytical focus, such as market assessment, supply chain analysis, commercial strategy, or policy analysis. Strategy consulting experience is preferred.
* Experience in primary research, such as stakeholder interviews, value chain mapping, or market assessments in complex, multi-stakeholder settings.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, and comfort building unit economics or financial models.
* Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to identify and pursue high-impact opportunities in complex, uncertain, and changing environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce high-quality reports, briefs, and presentations for government, donors, and technical audiences.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to work independently, lead workstreams end-to-end, and to propose and carry out new initiatives.

***Last Date to Apply 21 November, 2026***

title: Senior Technical Consultant, India Safe Water (EAII Advisors)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
  
  
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here:
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
The consultant will examine two related but distinct areas:
  
  
(i) the MVS landscape, including its scale, infrastructure characteristics, operating models and existing water-treatment arrangements; and
  
  
(ii) the electrochlorinator landscape, including technologies, existing deployments, economics and potential use cases across rural water systems
  
  
The goal of this consultancy is two fold:
  
  

* Develop a detailed understanding of the MVS landscape, including its scale, major scheme archetypes, infrastructure and operating characteristics, existing treatment arrangements, and resulting gaps or opportunities for safe-water interventions particularly in Evidence Action's priority states (AP, Bihar, Odisha, Rajasthan)
* Assess the EC market and determine the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs could represent a viable rural chlorination solution - addressing ECs' fit within a broader rural chlorination technology option including tablet-based dozers and other chlorination options

The final output should help Evidence Action decide whether, where and how to invest in ECs and/or other technologies to meet the water treatment needs of MVS in rural India. This would include analysis on the minimum technical, operational, financial and institutional conditions required for this type of intervention. Specific workstreams include:
  
  
**Estimating MVS Market Size and Identifying Key Market Segments**

* Conduct landscape analysis to estimate the total rural population served by MVS; verify estimates for EvAc priority states (AP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Odisha) via qualitative interviews and/or field visits as necessary
* Building on the analysis above, analyze the MVS infrastructure landscape to determine major market segments; identify key elements of each market segment that have relevance to water treatment, including system size/capacity, number of villages/population served, source and infrastructure configuration, existing treatment arrangements, and operating/O&M models; estimate the size of major market segments in EvAc priority states

**Analysis of Water Treatment Solutions Relevant to MVS, Including ECs**

* Conduct landscape analysis to map water treatment solutions already in place to serve MVS across rural India; document best practices and key learnings from implementation to date; including functionality, operational and O&M considerations where evidence is available
* Develop a market analysis documenting currently available water treatment solutions that would meet the needs of MVS systems (whether they are being implemented currently or not). While estimates for all of rural India would be useful, a focus on Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha and Rajasthan is a priority
* Develop a comparison model to assess key attributes of each water treatment solution, including cost, consumable requirements, maintenance requirements and implementation track record. Separately, develop a deeper analysis of the EC market, documenting currently available and late-stage EC models, suppliers, existing deployments, performance, costs and operational requirements across relevant rural water-system use cases, including but not limited to MVS
* Develop analysis to identify the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs are likely to be viable or non-viable across different rural water-system configurations, and identify the use cases where ECs appear most promising

**Recommendations for Strategic Intervention Pathways in EA ISW Priority States**

* Using findings from all analysis areas described above, develop summary recommendations for EvAc on potential opportunities within the MVS landscape and on whether, where and how ECs could expand EA's rural chlorination technology options, including scale-up pathways, with a focus on EA ISW priority geographies. A recommendation to defer, limit, or not pursue ECs will be considered valid if supported by the evidence
* Recommendations should explicitly state which MVS segments and/or EC use cases, geographies, delivery models and risk controls are strategic for further testing or scale-up

**Requirements**

* 15+ years of experience with a focus on strategy, market shaping and/or management consulting; existing experience in the water/WASH sector preferred, but not required
* Experience assessing water-treatment technologies, including technical fit, costs, maintenance and operating requirements; chlorination/EC experience preferred
* Strong relationships or credibility with government, WASH institutions, implementers and sector experts in India
* No existing commercial relationship with any of the EC vendors being evaluated
* Experience communicating technical material to non-technical audiences, including donors, boards, or senior leadership

**Position Location**
**This is a 6-month consultancy engagement,**
with the possibility of extension based on organizational needs.
  
  
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.
  
  
**Consultancy Fees:**
Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
  
  
**All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.**

title: Research Scientist
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for an
**Research Scientist**
to push the boundaries of what AI systems can actually do.
  
  
Not someone who simply integrates existing models or builds another wrapper around an LLM. We're looking for someone who can identify why today's AI systems fail, develop new methods to overcome those limitations, and turn research breakthroughs into real-world capabilities.
  
  
You'll work on some of the hardest problems in applied AI: building autonomous agents that can plan, reason, execute complex tasks and recover from failures; improving model intelligence through reinforcement learning and post-training; and developing systems that can make reliable decisions in unpredictable environments.
  
  
We're looking for someone who doesn't just ask how to use the best available model, but how to make AI fundamentally better at solving problems it struggles with today.
  
  
**The Job**

* Push the boundaries of agentic AI. Research and develop new approaches that enable AI agents to independently plan, reason, use tools, execute complex tasks, adapt to unfamiliar environments and recover from failures.
* Advance reinforcement learning and model training. Experiment with RL, fine-tuning, post-training techniques and model architectures to improve reasoning, decision-making and autonomous behaviour beyond what existing models can achieve.
* Develop new methods for reasoning and multimodal intelligence. Investigate why models struggle with complex, multi-step problems and unstructured inputs, and design new algorithms and techniques to improve their capabilities.
* Design rigorous experiments and AI evaluations. Build benchmarks, evaluation frameworks and experimental methodologies to measure model intelligence, reliability, generalisation and failure modes. Use findings to drive meaningful improvements.
* Take original research from first principles to production. Identify unsolved problems, formulate hypotheses, build and test new approaches, and collaborate with Research Engineers to translate breakthroughs into scalable AI systems with measurable real-world impact.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have a PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience conducting original AI research.
* Have a strong track record of original research, demonstrated through publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL or EMNLP, impactful open-source contributions, or meaningful advances in production AI systems.
* Have deep expertise in one or more areas such as agentic AI, reinforcement learning, LLM reasoning, post-training, multimodal learning, model architectures or AI evaluations.
* Are highly proficient in Python and PyTorch, with hands-on experience designing experiments, training and fine-tuning models, building evaluation frameworks and independently implementing research ideas.
* Are intellectually curious, comfortable challenging existing approaches and excited by unsolved problems. You combine scientific rigour with strong engineering instincts and care about taking original research from experimentation to real-world impact.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Sr Principal, Analyst (Semiconductor Memory – NAND Flash/DRAM)
description:
**About this Role:**
Analysts create must-have insights for our clients through published research and client interaction. You will meet with clients every day: on the phone, in a videoconference, from the stage at a Gartner event, or face-to-face during a sales support visit. In every interaction, you will help clients overcome their challenges and perform better.
  
  
As part of Gartner’s Emerging Market Dynamics Group, you will equip leaders in the semiconductor memory industry with indispensable insights, advice, and tools to achieve their mission-critical priorities and build the successful organizations of tomorrow. You will own the authoritative quantitative view of the global DRAM, HBM and NAND Flash markets and convert supply, demand, pricing and technology signals into decision-useful market intelligence.
  
  
**What You’ll do:**

* Develop and maintain global DRAM, HBM and NAND supply-demand forecasts, including bit growth, wafer capacity, utilization, yields, inventories and pricing.
* Track supplier capacity, capex, technology transitions and competitive positioning across Samsung, SK hynix, Micron, Kioxia, SanDisk and emerging suppliers.
* Forecast market size, revenue, units/bits, ASPs and supplier market share by major memory segment.
* Quantify demand across AI/data center, enterprise storage, PCs, smartphones, automotive and other major applications.
* Track DRAM technology transitions including DDR5, LPDDR and HBM generations, capacity allocation and HBM production economics.
* Track NAND transitions including layer scaling, TLC/QLC mix, enterprise SSD adoption, client SSD and embedded/mobile applications.
* Analyze memory cycles, inventory corrections, pricing inflections and structural supply-demand changes.
* Maintain quarterly market trackers, forecast models, source databases and scenario analysis.
* Provide evidence-based written responses and support VP/market-intelligence-level client conversations.
* Partner with analysts covering AI accelerators, foundry, advanced packaging and storage to quantify cross-market dependencies.
* Identify early indicators that could invalidate the current forecast and proactively revise assumptions and outlooks.
* Actively participate in appropriate Gartner global research communities for formal and in-formal knowledge sharing sessions.

**Core Quantitative Coverage :**
You are capable of modeling and forecasting:
  
  

* DRAM / HBM: wafer capacity and utilization, bit output and bit growth, die density and technology-node transitions, HBM stacks, capacity and GB/device, DDR/LPDDR/HBM mix, supplier market share, contract and spot pricing, revenue and ASP, and AI-server and accelerator-driven memory demand.
* NAND Flash: wafer capacity and utilization, bits/wafer and layer transitions, TLC/QLC mix, bit supply and demand, supplier market share, pricing and revenue, enterprise/client SSD units and capacity, mobile/embedded NAND, and AI-storage demand including RAG, KV-cache and checkpointing use cases.
* Research Boundaries: This role owns the semiconductor memory-market quantitative truth layer. It does not own broad AI accelerator strategy, semiconductor foundry strategy, advanced packaging market strategy, server/storage-system architecture, or the general semiconductor equipment coverage. However, the analyst must quantify how developments in these adjacent markets affect memory demand, supply and economics.

**Job Requirements :**
**What You Will Need**

* Educational Qualification:
* BE/BTech from Grade A engineering colleges with specialization in Electronics, or Semiconductors, or software engineering.
* Graduate + MBA (Marketing or Ops) from leading A & B-schools is desirable.
* Work experience:
* 7-10+ years minimum experience in semiconductor memory, market intelligence, product planning, business planning, forecasting or industry research.
* Domain knowledge/Business Acumen:
* Deep expertise in DRAM and/or NAND Flash, with the ability to develop credible coverage across both.
* Strong understanding of memory manufacturing economics, technology migration, supplier capacity and pricing cycles.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain quantitative market models and forecasts.
* Experience with memory suppliers, semiconductor market-research firms, OEMs/hyperscalers or relevant supply-chain organizations preferred.
* Awareness of the major issues across the IT, technology, semiconductor and electronics industry affecting software technologies and competitive landscape, and an eagerness to learn more.
* MS Office Tools:
* Ability to design, develop and maintain large Excel models for market share analysis and forecasting, and strong working knowledge of other MS Office tools such as Word and Power Point for writing and presenting analysis.
* Project management skills:
* Ability to manage time, keep projects on schedule and resolve issues and deliver all client deliverables in a timely manner.
* Communication skills:
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex market data into clear implications.
* Written: A strong writing ability is mandatory. Writing efforts will require stating/staking positions, justifying those positions with facts and providing actionable analysis and recommendations.
* Oral: Skills to converse on telephone, face to face, and on-stage, with the ability to explain complex concepts concisely.
* Problem Solving:
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to think creatively, independently, and efficiently to diagnose and contextualize issues, exhibit critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities, including working on estimation problems and provide insightful and original analysis.
* Interpersonal skills:
* Ability to communicate, engage, and develop cordial professional relationships with analysts, key initiative leaders, team managers, and clients with a compelling and enthusiastic attitude that drives clients to action and guides them to success.
* Strong client presence and ability to relate to a variety of company and personality types is a must - ability to represent Gartner research, methodology and strategies at multiple levels (Board, C-Level, Business Unit and Operational) and multiple client organization types (End User Client, Investors, Technology and Service Providers, Resellers, Channel Partners).
* Ability to organize effectively, drive for results, collaborate productively, coach and develop colleagues where required – provide constructive feedback to peers as well as be receptive to feedback from peers.
* Complete ownership mindset, professional maturity and intellectual curiosity, ability to embrace change and act with integrity, and follow internal processes and policies, including, HR, IT and Finance.

**Who you are :**
To thrive in this role, it helps if you are obsessed with your topic! Gartner analysts are correctly viewed as
**THE**
experts. This means that:
  
  

* You know your technologies, markets, vendors, trends, management practices, etc., well and be able to see the forest and the trees.
* You are an excellent collaborator with the ability to quickly build rapport and gain client trust.
* You are a confident presenter with a high level of executive presence (prior experience with speaking engagements is a plus).
* You are an analytical thinker with the ability to process information quickly and make actionable recommendations.
* You are willing to challenge conventional norms and views.

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
