title: Head of Quantitative Research & Algorithmic Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**

Univest is seeking a
**Head of Quantitative Research & Algorithmic Engineering**
to architect, build, and scale our next-generation automated trading and wealth management infrastructure. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of systematic strategies in Indian derivatives (NSE Equities, Index & Stock Options/Futures)—from mathematical model design and backtesting to building low-latency, production-grade Python/C++ execution engines and broker API integrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy Research & Quantitative Modeling:**

* Design, validate, and deploy high-alpha systematic strategies (options arbitrage, dynamic delta-hedging, mean-reversion, trend-following, and statistical arbitrage) for Indian F&O markets.
* Model volatility surfaces, Option Greeks, order-book dynamics, and market microstructure to build robust edge cases.
* Conduct rigorous backtesting, walk-forward validation, and stress-testing (Probability of Backtest Overfitting, Monte Carlo simulations) to eliminate curve-fitting.

**Algorithmic Execution & Infrastructure Engineering:**

* Architect and program scalable, cloud-native server-side execution systems in
  **Python and C++**
  interfacing with broker APIs, OMS/EMS, and FIX protocols.
* Optimize execution algorithms to minimize market impact, slippage, and latencies across multi-broker retail setups.
* Build automated pre-trade and post-trade risk management engines handling real-time position limits, dynamic margin utilization, and drawdown controls.

**Leadership & Scale:**

* Own the strategy deployment roadmap across retail and high-net-worth portfolio tiers.
* Oversee data pipelines (tick-level/L2/L3 order book data), infrastructure, and strategy monitoring systems.

**Requirements**

* **Quantitative Depth:**
  Proven mastery of option pricing models (Black-Scholes, IV surfaces), stochastic calculus, statistical arbitrage, and risk metrics (VaR, Sharpe/Sortino, max drawdown controls).
* **Hands-on Production Code:**
  100% mandatory expertise in Python and/or modern C++ (C++17/20) for building backend trading engines, data pipelines, and API integrations.
* **Indian Derivatives Experience:**
  Deep, hands-on experience trading or engineering strategies specifically for NSE Index & Stock Options / Futures (Nifty, BankNifty, Stock Derivatives).
* Execution & Microstructure: Practical experience with broker APIs, OMS/EMS architectures, FIX protocol, or low-latency execution routing.

company: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies - IFRC
description:
Organizational Context
  
  
The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) is the world’s largest humanitarian organization, with a network of 191-member National Societies (NSs). The overall aim of IFRC is “to inspire, encourage, facilitate, and promote at all times all forms of humanitarian activities by NSs with a view to preventing and alleviating human suffering and thereby contributing to the maintenance and promotion of human dignity and peace in the world.” IFRC works to meet the needs and improve the lives of vulnerable people before, during and after disasters, health emergencies and other crises.
  
  
IFRC is part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement (Movement), together with its member National Societies and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The work of IFRC is guided by the following fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, neutrality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality.
  
  
IFRC is led by its Secretary General, and has its Headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland. The Headquarters are organized into four main Divisions: (i) National Society Development and Coordination; (ii) Humanitarian Diplomacy and Digitalization; (iii) Legal, Governance Support and Accountability; and (iv) People and Strategy.
  
  
IFRC has five regional offices in Africa, Asia Pacific, Middle East and North Africa, Europe, and the Americas. IFRC also has country cluster delegations and country delegations throughout the world. Together, the Geneva Headquarters and the field structure (regional, cluster and country) comprise the IFRC Secretariat.
  
  
IFRC has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment and other forms of harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, and lack of integrity (including but not limited to financial misconduct). IFRC also adheres to strict child safeguarding principles.
  
  
The Evaluation function is part of the Executive Office within the People and Strategy Division. It strengthens organizational accountability and learning by coordinating the IFRC Evaluation Framework and annual evaluation plan, promoting quality standards, maintaining evaluation knowledge systems, and supporting follow-up on evaluation recommendations and management responses.
  
  
Based in New Delhi, the Intern, Evaluations – Strategic Planning and Communications supports the global Evaluation Unit across headquarters, regional offices, delegations, and National Societies. The internship combines evaluation support with data management, evidence synthesis, digital innovation, knowledge management, and strategic communication.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Intern, Evaluations – Strategic Planning and Communications supports the Evaluation Unit in organizing and analysing evaluation information, maintaining portfolio data and knowledge systems, and preparing clear, accessible products that promote the use of evaluation evidence across the IFRC network.
  
  
Under the supervision of the Coordinator, Evaluations, the intern contributes to desk reviews, data quality checks, dashboards, evidence synthesis, dissemination, and communication products. The role also supports responsible testing and documentation of digital and AI-enabled approaches, with human verification and compliance with IFRC policies.

* Assist with evaluation planning and coordination materials, including trackers, evidence matrices, stakeholder lists, meeting records, and dissemination plans.
* Support the consolidation of evaluation findings, lessons, recommendations, management responses, and follow-up actions.
* Data Management and Quality Assurance
* Maintain and update evaluation databases, portfolio trackers, document repositories, and relevant results-based management information.
* Review records and datasets for completeness, consistency, accuracy, version control, and compliance with agreed editorial, branding, accessibility, and information-management standards.
* Clean, organize, code, and document quantitative and qualitative information for analysis and reporting.
* Dashboards, Analytics and Digital Innovation

* Knowledge Management and Strategic Communications

* Draft and format executive-ready reports, evaluation briefs, knowledge notes, presentations, infographics, web content, and multimedia or explainer products for different audiences.
* Support communication planning and, where relevant, use web analytics to assess the reach and use of evaluation and RBM content.
* Dissemination, Coordination and Team Support

* Liaise with colleagues in headquarters, regional offices, delegations, and National Societies to obtain and validate information required for evaluation and learning products.
* Contribute to team planning and continuous improvement, and undertake other evaluation, knowledge-management, or communication tasks agreed with the supervisor.

**Job Duties And Responsibilities (continued)**

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Intelligence Connected

**WoodMac.com**

**Role Purpose**
We monitor key events and conduct research to produce thought-provoking reports, data models, and presentations. From asset valuation to corporate reports, from market supply-demand research to price-forecasting, and from the regional to the global, our analysis helps shape our customers’ commercial strategies.
  
  
We also support bespoke consulting projects, diving deeper into our data to answer unique questions. **.**

Over time you will gain specialist knowledge and develop the skills you require to progress your career at Wood Mackenzie.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**
We are looking for a Research Associate to join our team and cover Metals and Mining (M&M) research practice within the Commodities Global Analyst Team, based in Gurugram or Mumbai, India. As a member of our Metals and Mining team, you will contribute to our Iron Ore and Steel asset/cost research.
  
  
Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the sectors we cover and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie.
  
  

* Research and data gathering – we identify and gather intelligence that feeds our industry expertise. We need inquisitive and passionate people with a keen eye for detail. Read and analyse company reports to find mine-level operational and cost datasets.
* Analysis – we provide market-leading research using this data/intelligence and form opinions for and tell stories to our customers. We need people with natural curiosity with the potential to become experts in their field and with the ability to articulate – both verbally and in writing – clear, insightful analysis.
* Internal engagement – we work with global colleagues across the Wood Mackenzie business to deliver a compelling, integrated view of the commodities sector to customers through our cutting-edge products. * External engagement – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand. * Leadership/ Improvement – at Wood Mackenzie, we are committed to transforming the way we power our planet. The energy transition is here, and this impacts our customer base and how we serve them. We need colleagues with a change mindset, who are flexible, growth-orientated and proactive.

You are passionate about the dynamics of the metals and mining assets, with a particular interest in iron ore and steel. You bring relevant experience, skills, or knowledge that will allow you to contribute meaningfully from day one. Your curiosity and analytical mindset will help deepen our understanding of iron ore and steel assets and strengthen our global research coverage.
  
  

* Asset Analysis - as someone with an interest in steel and iron ore sector dynamics, you want to understand how these mining assets impact the natural resources industry. You will analyse mine production, reserves, cost and operational outlook trends across global assets. Your insights will contribute to regular research publications and working as part of a global team. This will include conducting asset valuations, updating asset reports, cost curves, cost models, and pricing analysis for iron ore and steel assets.
* Data Interpretation & Insight Generation - You possess an analytical mindset and a keen eye for detail. You are comfortable working with large datasets, interpreting trends, and articulating findings clearly in asset reports. You will contribute to the development and maintenance of datasets, data models, methodologies and other intellectual property supporting our M&M research and products. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint is essential for presenting your analysis in a visually engaging manner.
* Collaboration & Adaptability - You will be expected to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively across geographically dispersed teams. As you develop in the role, you will build deeper expertise across metals & mining assets and markets while strengthening your capabilities in research, data analysis, modelling, market intelligence, written and verbal communication, and client engagement.
* Communication & Client Engagement - The role will also involve supporting client engagement by responding to client enquiries and ad hoc requests, participating in client discussions and presentations, and helping communicate Wood Mackenzie’s views and insights to customers and prospects. Through research trips, industry events and client interactions, you will develop an understanding of the key topics and challenges facing the metals & mining industry and incorporate these perspectives into our research.

title: Director
description:
**Head of Survey Research Center of Excellence**

**Role purpose**

Own the strategic direction, quality, and commercial value of Everest Group’s survey-based research – across 100+ surveys a year spanning internally executed studies, outsourced enterprise research, sponsored studies, and standing/tracker programs. This is an expert advisory individual contributor leadership role: the CoE Lead sets methodology and design standards, shapes what is asked and why, and represents Everest Group’s research rigor to clients – while utilizing the survey support team for programming and fielding and coordinating vendors for outsourced work.

The CoE Lead is the firm’s internal authority on “what’s the right way to answer this question with data” – advising analysts on methodology and sample design the way a principal researcher would.

**Key accountabilities**

**1. Methodological leadership and AI-enabled survey design**

* Advise analysts and research leaders on research design: which methodology fits a given business question, and how to structure hypotheses before a survey is built
* Advise on sample size and sampling requirements needed to reliably answer the research question at hand, balancing statistical rigor against cost and timeline
* Champion and evaluate generative AI tools and methods to accelerate and improve survey drafting, question design, and instrument refinement – building this into how the firm develops surveys at scale, not just approving individual instruments
* Set the quality bar for questionnaire design and respondent experience firmwide, including reviewing and coaching analysts finalizing surveys to ensure adherence to best practice before launch

**2. Vendor and research-partner strategy**

* Own the relationships with market research and panel vendors, negotiating for quality, coverage, and cost efficiency across a large volume of engagements
* Continuously evaluate vendor performance and steer volume toward partners who deliver the most value

**3. A standing research asset, not just one-off projects**

* Build and own an annual plan of repeated/tracker surveys that forms an independent research backbone for the firm – a proprietary data asset that compounds year over year, distinct from ad hoc project-driven survey work
* Drive cross-utilization of survey data and insights across studies – actively identify where one survey’s data can inform, benchmark, or extend another, rather than letting each survey live in isolation
* Build the centralized inventory (question banks, templates, historical results) as infrastructure for that reuse, not as an end in itself

**4. Client-facing expertise and deliverables**

* Join client calls as the firm’s survey and market-research expert, credentialing Everest Group’s methodology and rigor directly to clients and ensuring it’s represented well in how findings are presented
* Represent survey methodology in proposals and client discussions where research design is being scrutinized or sold
* Design new formats for survey-based client deliverables – not just raw data exports, but packaged, interactive ways for clients to explore the data as a leave-behind (e.g., a lightweight interactive viewer alongside the underlying dataset)

**Required experience**

* 12-15+ years in market research, survey methodology, or research strategy, including experience leading a function or practice, not just executing research personally
* Deep expertise in questionnaire design, sampling methodology, and research design – able to advise credibly, not just execute
* Track record managing vendor/panel relationships at scale and negotiating for value
* Experience presenting research methodology directly to clients or senior stakeholders
* Familiarity with applying AI/automation to research workflows
* Tools fluency (Qualtrics, Alchemer, or similar) is a plus for credibility with the survey support team, but hands-on survey coding is not the job

**Role profile**

This is a leadership role with some hands-on work, not an individual-contributor execution role. The CoE Lead operates through influence and standards-setting – utilizing the survey support team and external vendors for execution – while acting as the firm’s external face for survey research quality. Success looks like: a well-run, cost-efficient survey engine running in the background, a distinctive proprietary tracker-survey asset building year over year, and client relationships where this person is seen as a credentialed expert, not a project coordinator.

title: Supply Chain Solutions Manager
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Every company runs on an ERP. Very few get good decisions out of it. That's where Praxas comes in.

Praxas AI is an AI-native supply chain platform that works as a decision layer on top of the systems a company already has. We pull in scattered data from ERPs, spreadsheets and email, turn it into a single, trusted picture, and use optimization models and AI agents to recommend what to produce, stock, buy and ship. Plans keep re-optimizing as orders, capacity and supply change, and planners stay in control by approving every action.

What we stand for is simple: no rip-and-replace, no multi-year implementations, and no multi-million-dollar planning suites. We're building planning software that's fast to deploy, easy to use and priced for mid-sized companies.

We're starting with production planning for manufacturers, because that's where our first clients feel the most pain. Inventory, sourcing and shipping come next, followed by industries such as CPG, retail, chemicals and logistics. Our first manufacturing partners are already sharing their data and building the product with us. Built in India, for the world.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with our clients and turn their messiest supply chain problems into optimized plans running in production.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a traditional consulting, project management or customer success position. You'll sit with planners and plant heads to understand how the business really runs, formulate the right mathematical model, write production-quality code, connect our platform to their ERP, and stay until the plan is trusted and used every day. You'll move between a factory floor, a solver, an ERP database and a conversation with the owner without losing the thread.

Our clients' data lives in SAP, Tally, custom ERPs, spreadsheets and inboxes, and it's rarely clean. The work is never turnkey. You'll own hard implementation problems through to resolution, and turn what you learn in the field into reusable connectors, models and playbooks that make the next deployment faster.

You'll work directly with the founders and our engineering team. As one of our first hires, you'll help define how Praxas is built, deployed and sold.

**What You Will Do**

Deliver supply chain solutions

• Embed with clients from discovery through go-live, stabilization and handover

• Map each client's production, inventory, sourcing and logistics processes, and the data behind them

• Translate business goals and ambiguous requirements into clear models, milestones and working software

• Own the outcomes clients care about: fewer lost sales, better on-time-in-full delivery, higher inventory turns and working capital released

Model and optimize

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling, inventory and safety stock, demand forecasting and supply planning problems

• Use linear and mixed-integer programming, constraint programming and heuristics, with solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX or OR-Tools

• Build models that re-optimize continuously as orders, capacity and supply change

• Validate models against real client data, test them on past periods, and explain trade-offs clearly to planners

Engineer in the client environment

• Write production-quality code in Python and SQL

• Build and maintain ERP connectors for SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics and custom databases, using APIs, OData and direct SQL

• Build data pipelines and data-quality checks, and reconcile Praxas numbers with the client's own reports

• Deploy and troubleshoot client environments on AWS, working within each client's IT and security controls

• Integrate AI agents into planning workflows, with human approval at every step

Build client capability

• Run workshops, design reviews and hands-on training for planners, purchase teams and plant heads

• Build trust in the system's recommendations so clients act on them every day

• Communicate trade-offs and risks clearly to planners, managers and owners

• Keep scope disciplined and make realistic technical commitments

Make the product better

• Turn recurring client needs into product features, reusable connectors and deployment templates

• Cut implementation time with every deployment

• Write clear documentation: data maps, model specs, runbooks and decision logs

**What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days**

• Build a working knowledge of the Praxas data model, planning engine and deployment setup

• Take one client from data access to a production plan running on their live data, with numbers that match their own reports

• Build or strengthen at least one reusable ERP connector

• Write documentation that makes the next client onboarding faster

**Within 6–12 months**

• Lead several client deployments end to end, from discovery to daily use

• Cut onboarding time from weeks to days

• Show measurable impact at your clients, such as fewer lost sales, lower inventory and better on-time delivery

• Turn field lessons into product features, connectors and playbooks the whole team uses

Who You Are

Required

• 3–8 years building or implementing supply chain planning solutions, at a platform such as o9, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis or SAP IBP, at an implementation partner, or in a similar role

• Exceptional coding ability: you write production-quality Python and SQL, and you're comfortable with APIs, data pipelines and cloud deployment

• Strong operations research and mathematical modelling: linear and mixed-integer programming, scheduling, heuristics, forecasting and inventory theory

• Hands-on experience with AI and machine learning, including building with large language models and AI agents and applying them to planning problems

• Hands-on experience integrating with ERPs such as SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle or custom systems

• Deep understanding of at least two of production planning and scheduling, demand planning, inventory planning, S&OP, procurement and logistics

• Proven client-facing skills: you can run a workshop, gather requirements and explain a model to someone who isn't technical

• Comfortable working on factory floors and travelling to client sites

Nice to have

• Experience in manufacturing, which is extremely beneficial

• A degree in operations research, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics

• Time at a startup or on an early product team

Compensation and Equity

• Competitive salary, with raises tied to company milestones

• Meaningful equity through ESOPs, vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, so you own part of what you help build

• Early-team ownership: a real say in the product, the way we deploy it and the culture we build

**How to Apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to admin@praxas.ai with the subject line "Forward Deployed Engineer – Supply Chain". Include a short note on a model or integration you built, and what changed for the client because of it.

title: Category Development Analyst
description:

For over 50 years, we’ve been helping Aussie families find those little wins. Who makes it all happen? Our team. They’re our biggest asset, the heart of everything we do. From new ideas to big energy and genuine care, they bring it every day, on every shift, at every shelf and in every customer moment.

That Purpose fuels our ambition to explore new ideas, make brave commitments, and innovate better ways to meet the food and everyday needs of more than 24 million customers every week.

title: Founder's Office (Intern)
description:
**About the Role**

As an Intern in the Founder’s Office at EaseMyTrip, you will work closely with the Founder and senior leadership team to support strategic initiatives, AI-driven projects, business performance tracking, and cross-functional coordination across the organization. Your role involves assisting in data analysis, preparing presentations, monitoring key business metrics, and contributing to AI-led transformation initiatives. You will gain direct exposure to leadership decision-making, investor communication, new business evaluations, and growth strategy across flights, hotels, buses, holidays, and emerging verticals. This position is ideal for a high-potential individual looking to develop strong strategic, analytical, and AI-driven problem-solving skills in a fast-paced travel-tech environment.

**Role & Responsibilities**

1. Business Performance Tracking: Assist in building and updating dashboards tracking GMV, revenue, margins, CAC, repeat rates, conversion rates, and vertical-wise profitability.
2. Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyze business data, prepare structured reports, and highlight insights to support leadership decision-making.
3. AI & Automation Initiatives: Identify repetitive workflows and support implementation of AI tools and automation solutions to improve productivity and operational efficiency.
4. AI Use Case Research: Research and evaluate practical AI applications in pricing, personalization, customer service automation, fraud detection, and marketing optimization.
5. Presentation & Deck Preparation: Support preparation of investor decks, board materials, AI transformation updates, and internal strategy presentations.
6. Strategic & Competitive Research: Conduct structured research on competitors, industry trends, global travel-tech AI adoption, and new growth opportunities.
7. Financial Modeling Support: Assist in building basic financial models, scenario analysis, and profitability assessments for new initiatives.
8. Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with marketing, product, tech, finance, and operations teams to track progress on key strategic and AI initiatives.
9. Performance Review Support: Prepare monthly and quarterly performance summaries with data-backed insights for leadership discussions.
10. Meeting & Execution Follow-Ups: Document key discussion points from leadership meetings and track action items to ensure timely execution.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

1. Strong Academic Background: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Business, or related fields.
2. Analytical & Quantitative Skills: Strong comfort with Excel and data analysis; familiarity with SQL, Python, or analytics tools is a plus.
3. Interest in AI & Digital Transformation: Curiosity about artificial intelligence, automation tools, and technology-led business optimization.
4. Structured Thinking Ability: Capable of breaking down complex problems into clear, logical frameworks.
5. Business Acumen: Basic understanding of unit economics, digital growth metrics, and financial performance indicators.
6. Presentation Skills: Ability to create clean, structured PowerPoint presentations with clear storytelling.
7. High Ownership & Initiative: Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
8. Strong Communication Skills: Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to summarize complex information simply.
9. Attention to Detail: Disciplined in tracking numbers, action items, and documentation accuracy.
10. Confidentiality & Integrity: Trusted to handle sensitive business and financial information responsibly.

description:

Team Description
  
  
MongoDB seeks an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join Enterprise Architecture on a focused team dedicated to AI experimentation. You'll partner with teams across the organization, including Internal Engineering, to explore, prototype, and validate emerging AI capabilities before they become formal roadmap priorities.
  
  
Our ideal candidate:
  
  

* Has 6+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Deep experience with at least one modern programming language (Python, Typescript, Go, Rust, etc.)
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to independently solve complex engineering problems
* Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and disciplines
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity, scoping and running experiments when the right approach isn't known yet
* Hands-on experience prototyping with LLMs or agentic systems (evals, fine-tuning, RAG, tool use, orchestration frameworks)
* Has the ability to iterate fast, specially in the case where requirements are not clear
* Keeps up with emerging AI tooling and models, not just what's already mainstream
* Collaborative, detail-oriented, and passionate about building reliable, usable software

Bonus Round:
  
  

* Experience building and maintaining full-stack applications, from front-end UIs to backend API to data pipelines
* Experience designing systems or services used by other engineers or teams
* Knowledge of any of the following technologies: Tanstack Start, Next.js, FastAPI, React
* Experience with model evaluation frameworks, vector databases, or agent orchestration tooling (e.g., LangGraph)
* Familiarity with transformer architecture and model internals
* Familiarity with containerized applications, Kubernetes, and ability to design CI/CD pipelines

Position Expectations:
  
  

* Design and run experiments that test emerging AI capabilities against real internal use cases, before they're formally prioritized. Condense the learnings of those experiments and document them so that the knowledge can be used across the org.
* Build lightweight prototypes to validate or kill ideas quickly
* Stay current on new AI tooling and models, and turn relevant developments into concrete internal proof points
* Partner with product, platform, and internal engineering teams to hand off validated capabilities once they're ready to move from experiment to production
* Maintain technical rigor and clear documentation of findings, even for work that doesn't ship
* Identify and communicate risks, unknowns, and open questions clearly to stakeholders

Success Measures:
  
  

* In three months, have run and documented at least one AI capability experiment, with a clear recommendation on whether and how to pursue it further
* In three months, demonstrate the ability to move quickly from idea to working prototype
* In six months, have influenced the org's roadmap or tooling direction by surfacing a capability two to three steps ahead of current need, backed by evidence from your experimentation

**Job Description & Summary:**

 
  

PwC India is seeking an experienced Credit Risk Quantitative Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in model development or validation, with a focus on credit risk management. This role requires expertise in IFRS 9, CECL, and other key areas relevant to credit risk. The successful candidate will contribute to the development and validation of credit risk models, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and best practices.
 
  
  

**Responsibilities:**

 
  

 
  

Develop and/or validate credit risk models, including Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), and Exposure at Default (EAD) models.
 
  

· Ensure compliance with IFRS 9, CECL, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
 
  

· Conduct quantitative analysis and stress testing to assess model performance and risk exposure.
 
  

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data, refine model assumptions, and improve model accuracy.
 
  

· Document model development and validation processes, including methodologies, assumptions, and findings.
 
  

· Provide insights and recommendations to improve credit risk management practices and strategies.
 
  

· Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory changes, and advancements in quantitative modeling techniques.
 
  

· Participate in internal and external audits, addressing any findings related to credit risk models.

· Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field.

· Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with a solid understanding of statistical and mathematical modeling.
 
  

· Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, SAS, or MATLAB.
 
  

· Familiarity with data management tools and techniques, including SQL and data visualization platforms.
 
  

· Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Clinical Business Intelligence Manager
description:
**Clinical Business Intelligence Manager (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your deep expertise in healthcare analytics could directly influence how AI understands and reasons about clinical data? We're looking for an experienced Clinical Business Intelligence Manager to lead analytics work that sits at the intersection of healthcare intelligence and cutting-edge AI development.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for senior professionals who know how to turn complex clinical and operational data into decisions that matter. You'll bring your healthcare BI leadership experience to a team working on some of the most advanced AI projects in the industry.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and mentor a business intelligence team in building dashboards, reports, and analytics that support clinical and operational decision-making
* Design, maintain, and optimize BI infrastructure — including data models, SQL queries, and reporting pipelines — ensuring accuracy, reliability, and performance
* Analyze clinical, operational, and performance data to uncover meaningful trends and surface insights that support leadership decisions
* Translate complex healthcare datasets into clear, trusted outputs that drive improvements in care delivery and organizational efficiency
* Apply your domain expertise to evaluate, quality-check, and improve AI-generated outputs related to clinical analytics and healthcare data reasoning

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in healthcare or clinical analytics, business intelligence, or data management within regulated environments
* Proven track record designing and managing BI systems — including dashboards, reporting pipelines, and data models
* Comfortable working with clinical, operational, and administrative datasets and understanding their real-world implications
* Strong communicator who can translate technical findings into meaningful narratives for both clinical and operational stakeholders
* Self-directed and reliable — you deliver quality work independently without hand-holding

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation systems
* Familiarity with AI tools, LLM outputs, or AI training workflows
* Background in health informatics, population health, or value-based care analytics
* Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI platforms

**Why Join Us**

* Work alongside world-leading AI research labs on genuinely cutting-edge projects
* Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
* Freelance autonomy with the substance of meaningful, high-impact work
* Gain direct exposure to advanced large language models and how they're trained and evaluated
* Contribute clinical intelligence expertise to AI systems that will shape how healthcare data is understood at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

description:
**Health Informatics Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
We're looking for experienced Health Informatics Analysts to bring their clinical data expertise to cutting-edge AI development. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep knowledge of EHR systems, healthcare workflows, and data analysis will directly shape how AI understands and navigates the healthcare domain.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to apply your professional background in a flexible, remote freelance capacity while contributing to AI that could transform how healthcare information is processed and understood.

**What You'll Do**

* Analyze and interpret healthcare and EHR data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement

**Why Join Us**

* Work on meaningful AI projects with top-tier research labs and teams
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Put your specialized healthcare expertise to work in a high-impact, emerging field
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: AI Benchmark & Red-Teaming Specialist
description: About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.Role Overview:We are seeking an analytical researcher and red-teaming specialist to build evidence-based web-research benchmark tasks that reliably expose weaknesses in state-of-the-art (SOTA) AI models (e.g., Claude Opus 5 Max). In this role, you will discover hard-to-surface facts, build precise research tasks around them, test them directly against leading LLMs, and diagnose the exact failure mechanisms in the model's search and reasoning paths.Your work will directly shape AI evaluation frameworks, ensuring next-generation frontier models are tested against rigorous, non-trivial real-world research scenarios.Job Requirements:Core Experience: 1+ years in investigative research, fact-checking, AI benchmark task authoring, red-teaming, or technical QA review.Benchmark Familiarity: Proven experience authoring, testing, or reviewing tasks for AI benchmarks such as GAIA, BrowseComp, SimpleQA, SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, or Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE).Analytical & OSINT Skills: Intermediate-to-advanced web search and Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) skills; ability to navigate academic archives, local records, or obscure databases.Model Trajectory Debugging: Strong analytical capability to inspect model reasoning chains, search logs, and source selection to diagnose root causes of failure.Precision Writing: Ability to author clear, unambiguous benchmark prompts with bulletproof, primary-sourced answer keys.Job Responsibilities:Obscure Fact Discovery: Deeply research niche topics to identify factual ground truths that cannot be surfaced via simple, direct search queries.Source Verification: Rigorously verify facts against primary or highly credible sources, cross-check for contradictory evidence, and document exact source URLs.Task Construction: Draft clear, answerable benchmark tasks designed specifically to expose structural weaknesses in model research strategies.Red-Teaming & Model Testing: Execute tasks against designated SOTA models to confirm they reliably trigger intended model failures.Failure Diagnosis & Debugging: Trace model run logs, search trajectories, and intermediate outputs to pinpoint exactly where and why the model failed (distinguishing genuine model limitations from ambiguous prompts).Pattern Scaling & Review: Apply validated "model-breaking" research patterns across new domains and, for strong performers, review tasks authored by peer trainers. Strong Plus (Preferred Qualifications)Bachelor or higher degree from relevant engineering domain is a must for this position.Prior experience specifically designing prompt-injection or reasoning-trap tasks that break SOTA models.Advanced OSINT capabilities or published investigative/academic research demonstrating deep source verification.Niche domain expertise in areas rich with hard-to-find records (e.g., local government filings, regional sports history, legal archives, historical patents).Experience serving as a lead reviewer, benchmark auditor, or quality owner on AI evaluation projects.Offer Details:Commitments Required: Upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.Engagement type: ContractorEngagement Length: upto 4 weeksEvaluation Process:Candidates will be require to submit a Job Interest Form & assessment.Talents finalized in assessment will go through assessment, review & will proceed further accordingly.

title: Data Scientist III, Analytics
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Data Scientist III, Analytics**
As a Data Scientist III, Analytics, you will independently lead analytical work that shapes decisions, improves performance, and scales better customer and business outcomes. You will combine technical expertise with business judgment to frame complex problems, develop robust analyses, and communicate clear recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  
  
**Introduction to the Team**
The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.
  
  
This role sits within our analytics organization and supports post-booking servicing experiences. You will use data, experimentation, and analytical thinking to improve traveler outcomes, inform product decisions, and deliver measurable business impact in partnership with product, analytics, and leadership stakeholders.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead analytical projects or small work-streams from problem definition through recommendation, delivering insights that influence product and business decisions
* Extract, combine, and transform data from multiple sources to build reliable datasets for analysis, experimentation, and modeling
* Apply statistical methods, including regression, analysis of variance, hypothesis testing, and experiment design, to evaluate impact and solve business problems
* Use Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, R, or similar tools to analyze large datasets, develop scalable analytical approaches, and create clear visualisations
* Partner with subject matter experts and stakeholders to refine business questions, define success measures, and translate findings into practical recommendations
* Document analytical work, share reproducible code, and provide guidance and feedback that helps strengthen the analytics community

**Experience And Qualifications**

* You have a bachelor's degree, master's degree, or doctorate in mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics, engineering, or related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience
* You have 5+ years of experience in a data analytics or data science role, delivering insights and recommendations that drove measurable change or performance improvement across multiple projects
* You have advanced experience using SQL, Python, R, or similar tools for data analysis, data structuring, transformation, and visualisation
* You have experience selecting measurement approaches for different business questions, including before-and-after analysis, causal inference, multivariate testing, or adaptive experimentation
* You have a strong grounding in statistical concepts and can apply experimentation, regression, and exploratory analysis to business questions
* You communicate analytical findings clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise and translate data into actionable recommendations
* You are comfortable working independently, managing priorities, and collaborating across functions to move analytical work forward
* You have experience working with large, complex datasets and understand challenges related to data quality, performance, and scalability
* You have working knowledge of machine learning concepts, including supervised learning methods such as linear regression, logistic regression, and clustering
* You create effective visualisations that prioritise clarity, accessibility, and audience needs
* You value iterative delivery, reproducibility, and knowledge sharing through documentation, dashboards, and reusable analytical workflows
* You have experience mentoring teammates, providing thoughtful feedback, and helping build analytical capability across a team

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
  
  
**Important notice**
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

Gurugram

The role will focus on tracking market performance, benchmarking competitive positioning, identifying growth opportunities across trading segments, and translating data-driven insights into actionable business interventions.

  **, Commerce, Economics, Retail Management or a related discipline**
  .

:

title: Quantitative Researcher - Experienced Hires (India)
description:
Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets. 

As a Quantitative Researcher you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models. While we are open to researchers in any asset class we are currently focusing on roles in equities, futures, commodities, and event driven research.

* Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals
* Parse and analyze large datasets to identify actionable alpha signals and develop strategies for systematic trading
* Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance
* Continuously innovate and improve existing models by integrating new data sources and advanced techniques to boost performance and scalability
* Collaborate closely with a team of experienced quantitative researchers to conduct experiments, backtest hypotheses, and refine strategies through rigorous simulations and data analysis

**Requirements**

* BS/MS/PhD degree in any stem field
* 2+ years in a systematic trading environment
* Passion for machine learning
* Fluent with programming languages like Python
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary plus bonus based on individual and company performance
* Collaborative, Casual, and friendly work environment
* Health insurance premiums fully covered for you and your dependents
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* Weekly company meals

Trexquant is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**Position Summary**

The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. The CRM Team enables this pursuit by enhancing the platform, processes, analytics, and user experience that support effective commercial decision-making.

Under the direction of the CRM Senior Manager, the
**Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation**
owns core workstreams within the team, driving projects and initiatives across CRM optimization, innovation, analytics, and automation. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end-to-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**

* Leads a team of data analysts, who are utilizing their advanced technical skills to support complex end user requests that require data to be visualized from multiple sources
* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross-functional collaboration.

  

**Invests comprehensively in continuous development of programs**

* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.

  

**People Management**

* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity
* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.
* Responsible for overseeing the quality of output of the team members. Identifies areas for operational improvement. Proactively resolve problems and escalate issues to the senior leadership, as necessary.
* Leads team in accordance with Bain’s operating principles encouraging optimum performance and an unwavering focus on results. Maintains transparent two-way communication.

Preferred

**Experience**

* Project management experience is desired, and a formal certification will be an added advantage
* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems

Preferred

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
**Data Science Lead – Churn & Retention Analytics | Microsoft Fabric / Azure ML**

**Location**
: Gurugram, Haryana, India (overlap with US Central Time required)

**Company**
: Neurogent.ai

**Employment Type**
: Full-time (Hybrid)

**Seniority**
: Senior / Lead

**Experience**
: 7+ years

**ABOUT NEUROGENT.AI:-**

Neurogent.ai builds agentic AI solutions, including AI agents, chatbots, and voice assistants, alongside data and ML platforms that automate workflows and improve customer experience across banking, healthcare, insurance, financial services, and multi-location consumer businesses.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:-**

We are looking for a senior,
**hands-on Data Science Lead specializing in Churn & Retention Analytics**
to join our delivery team working with a leading US early-education and childcare provider serving approximately 130,000 children across a workforce of 20,000 staff.

The client is building its
**data science capability on Microsoft Fabric**
, with student and family churn as the first approved use case.

The objective is to identify families at risk of withdrawal
**4–8 weeks before they leave,**
giving center directors enough time to intervene and improve retention.

Families often show early warning signs, such as declining attendance, reduced schedules, or changes in billing behavior. Your role will be to turn these signals into a reliable, explainable churn model that operations teams trust and use every week.

You will own the use case end-to-end, from defining churn and engineering features to building, deploying, and monitoring a production model that scores every active enrollment weekly.

This is both a technical leadership and business consulting role. You will work directly with US-based business leaders, the client's data science and IT teams, our onshore colleagues, and data engineers.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:-**

**1. Churn Analysis & Predictive Modeling**

• Define churn with business stakeholders, including withdrawal criteria, observation and prediction windows, and preventable versus unavoidable exits.

• Engineer behavioral features from attendance, enrollment, schedule changes, tenure, sibling status, age relative to kindergarten eligibility, and payment or billing patterns.

• Build and validate tabular churn models using XGBoost, LightGBM, gradient boosting, survival analysis, or time-to-event modeling.

• Calibrate risk scores and generate actionable risk rankings at the center level.

• Use SHAP and other explainability techniques to communicate why a family is flagged and recommend appropriate retention actions.

**2. Business Consulting & Stakeholder Management**

• Collaborate with US-based operations leaders, regional teams, corporate data science, and executive stakeholders to define business problems and success metrics.

• Translate model outputs into clear business insights, retention playbooks, and revenue-impact estimates.

• Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders in a business-friendly manner.

• Challenge assumptions and requirements when necessary to ensure the solution drives measurable business outcomes.

**3. Data Quality & Feature Engineering**

• Partner with data engineering teams to integrate attendance, CRM, enrollment, and billing data into OneLake.

• Implement data-quality checks to identify source-system outages, missing attendance records, and other issues that could generate misleading churn signals.

• Establish safeguards to prevent model scoring when critical data-quality conditions are not met.

• Build reusable, versioned feature tables using Delta Lake to support future use cases, including teacher attrition.

**4. MLOps & Productionization – Microsoft Fabric / Azure**

• Develop and deploy ML solutions using Microsoft Fabric Notebooks, Python/R, Fabric Data Factory, OneLake Delta tables, and MLflow.

• Implement experiment tracking, model registry, versioning, and rollback mechanisms.

• Build reliable weekly batch-scoring pipelines for all active enrollments.

• Deliver ranked at-risk enrollment data to business users through Power BI dashboards using Direct Lake.

• Implement Dev/Test/Prod environments, Fabric deployment pipelines, and Azure DevOps CI/CD with approval gates.

• Manage secrets and dependencies using Azure Key Vault and pinned package environments.

• Establish monitoring for model drift, missing predictions, and data-quality failures, with alerts through Azure Monitor or Power Automate.

**5. Measurement & Experimentation**

• Design holdout and matched-control approaches to measure the effectiveness of retention outreach.

• Help distinguish genuine churn reduction from model accuracy alone.

• Contribute to experimentation initiatives involving matched control centers, difference-in-differences, effect sizes, and confidence intervals.

**6. Technical Leadership**

• Establish standards for reproducibility, code reviews, model reviews, documentation, and explainability.

• Mentor data scientists and engineers while collaborating with distributed client and delivery teams.

• Extend learnings from churn modeling to future use cases, including teacher attrition, occupancy and enrollment forecasting, and lead-to-enrollment scoring.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:-**

•
**7+ years of experience in data science or applied machine learning**
, including ownership of end-to-end ML outcomes in a senior or lead role.

• Proven
**hands-on experience in churn and retention analytics**
, including building and deploying models tied to measurable business results.

•
**Strong Azure data and ML experience is mandatory,**
with production ML delivery using Azure Machine Learning and/or Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory/Fabric Data Factory, and MLflow-style model lifecycle management.

• Advanced Python skills, including pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, and libraries such as lifelines or scikit-survival.

• Advanced SQL skills and working proficiency in R.

• Strong statistical foundations in survival analysis, model calibration, hypothesis testing, experimental design, and causal inference fundamentals.

• Practical MLOps experience covering Git, CI/CD for ML, batch-scoring pipelines, model monitoring, and drift detection.

• Experience delivering model outputs to business users through Power BI.

• Excellent communication skills and direct experience working with US-based clients and presenting to senior business stakeholders.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across distributed, cross-functional teams with regular US Central Time overlap.

**NICE TO HAVE:-**

• Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience with OneLake, Lakehouse/Delta, Fabric Notebooks, deployment pipelines, and Direct Lake.

• Domain experience in childcare, education, healthcare, subscription businesses, or multi-location consumer services.

• Experience with workforce attrition modeling, time-series forecasting (Prophet/ARIMA), or lead scoring.

• Familiarity with quasi-experimental methods, including Dynamic Time Warping matching, difference-in-differences, and synthetic controls.

• Experience handling sensitive or child-related personal data under privacy regulations such as COPPA.

• Exposure to Databricks, AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure ML online endpoints.

• Consulting or professional services delivery experience.

• Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100), or Azure AI Engineer.

**WHY JOIN NEUROGENT.AI?**

•
**Own a high-impact enterprise ML use case**
: Lead a flagship churn prediction program with a clear, measurable business objective.

•
**Build from the ground up**
: Help establish a scalable data science and ML foundation on Microsoft Fabric.

•
**Influence business outcomes**
: Turn predictive insights into practical interventions that help improve family retention.

•
**Shape the roadmap**
: Extend your work into future applications such as teacher attrition, enrollment forecasting, and lead scoring.

•
**Take real ownership**
: Work in an AI-first environment with direct client exposure, technical leadership, and opportunities to influence product and delivery decisions.

**Interested in building ML solutions that deliver measurable business impact?**

Apply to join Neurogent.ai and help transform enterprise data into actionable decisions.

description:

Strong hands-on experience with

.

* Performance optimization and architectural trade-offs

**converting business requirements into detailed, scalable technical designs and implementing them independently**

Strong practical knowledge of
**microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous workflows, and event-driven system architecture**
.

Hands-on expertise with:

Understanding of
**worker concurrency, queue-based processing, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, failure recovery, observability, and cloud cost optimization**
.

Deep expertise across every AWS service is not required.

* LLM integration, prompt engineering, and context management.

* Document classification, table/form extraction, and structured JSON outputs.

* Multi-stage AI processing pipelines and model orchestration.
* Token optimization, AI latency management, and cost reduction.

**reliable AI features beyond simply making LLM API calls**
.

**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
systems, including:

* Document ingestion, chunking, and embeddings
* Vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, and metadata filtering
* Retrieval optimization, reranking, and context construction
* Response grounding and RAG evaluation

Working knowledge of
**AI agents, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, state management, and contextual memory**
.

**LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks**
is preferred.

Experience Required

  .
* Strong full-stack development experience, particularly in backend engineering.
* Strong system design, microservices, and scalable architecture knowledge.
* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS Lambda and Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **AI/LLM integration, OCR, and RAG**
  .
* Ability to independently design, implement, and own complex technical modules.

**hands-on engineer and strong system thinker**

description:

This is not a purely research or machine-learning role—here, you will see your work come to life in production environments, making a direct impact on how our customers operate and succeed.

At Topsoe, you will join a vibrant, forward-thinking environment where your ideas and expertise are valued. This is your chance to combine data science and Python development with real operational ownership, working on products that make a difference for customers around the world. You will collaborate with talented colleagues, learn from industry leaders, and have the freedom to innovate and grow. We offer continuous learning, professional development, and the satisfaction of seeing your work drive real-world impact. Join us and be part of a team that is shaping the future of sustainable technology.

You will become part of a close-knit data science group of around six dedicated professionals who have built Clearview from the ground up. title: Data Scientist
description:
**Description**
**The opportunity**
ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU.
  
  
You will be the first data scientist in our India team. At first, you will meet specialist teams, identify valuable use cases and build focused proofs of concept that demonstrate what data science and AI can do. As these relationships mature, you will help develop our ability to deliver data science and AI solutions across client projects, working with the wider data science team from discovery through implementation. Knowledge of energy would help, initiative, technical breadth and the ability to earn trust across disciplines are central to the role.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Meet colleagues across practice areas to understand their work, identify specific use cases and agree what a useful result would look like.
* Initially, scope and demonstrate focused proofs of concept, choosing suitable methods from statistical analysis and forecasting to machine learning and language models.
* Explain methods, limitations and potential value clearly to specialists and nontechnical colleagues. Use their feedback to improve the solution and build confidence in the team’s services.
* Assess data quality, feasibility, privacy and delivery needs, and define the evidence needed to take a prototype further.
* As demand grows, design and deliver data science and AI solutions across projects with the wider team, from modelling and evaluation to integration, documentation and adoption. Contribute to proposals and client presentations.
* Establish reusable ways of working and help turn early demonstrations into a sustainable pipeline of well-defined client work.

**What You Will Bring**

* Hands-on experience in Python for analysis and modelling, including common data and machine learning libraries, ability to use SQL to extract, join and check data.
* Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning, including regression or classification, forecasting, validation, baseline comparisons and appropriate performance measures.
* Practical familiarity with using large language models in analysis or prototyping, including prompting, checking outputs against evidence and recognising privacy, accuracy and reliability risks.
* Experience preparing imperfect data, building reproducible analyses and writing maintainable code with version control and testing.
* Ability to take an ambiguous question from discovery to a working demonstration, explain assumptions and uncertainty, and judge whether a solution is worth developing for operational use.
* Confidence working independently and engaging stakeholders across teams, clear written and spoken English for technical and nontechnical audiences.
* A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field.

**Useful Additional Experience**

* Experience in energy, utilities, climate or environmental policy, particularly applied analysis with domain experts.
* Experience in consulting, public policy research or client-facing delivery, familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines or deployment.
* Experience building AI agents or applications that connect language models to data and tools, such as retrieval-based systems. We can train someone with strong core skills.

**How We Work**
As the first data scientist in our India team, you will have the opportunity to shape how our established data science and AI services grow there. You will work alongside colleagues with a wide range of technical and subject expertise, tackle varied client challenges, and see promising ideas develop into project work. We will support your career development with ongoing training and opportunities to deepen both your technical and consulting skills.
  
  
**Bot and Third-Party Applications**
Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.
  
  
**Working at ICF**
ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.
  
  
**Candidate AI Usage Policy**
At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair and equitable interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodations that involve the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.

title: Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert, GxD hub
description:
**Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert, GxD hub**

**Engagement Type:**

Consultancy

**Location: New Delhi**

**LEAD’s**
**Gender x Digital (GxD) hub**
**is seeking a Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert to support a large-scale government programme focused on digital skilling and AI capability building. The role combines inclusion strategy, data systems, and stakeholder coordination, with a focus on developing and operationalising frameworks, establishing inclusion metrics and monitoring systems, and building a coherent evidence base on programme inclusion.**
**About LEAD at Krea University**

LEAD
is an action-oriented research centre of IFMR Society (a not-for-profit society registered under the Societies Act), leverages the power of research, innovation and co-creation to solve complex and pressing challenges in development. LEAD specialises in developing in-depth granular understanding of socio-economic contexts and harnessing actionable insights that have a wide range of applications in industry, policy, and academia. LEAD is a collaborative hub that brings experts from diverse disciplines and sectors together to develop innovative solutions by harnessing innovation, technology and analytics.

**About GxD hub**

The
Gender x Digital hub (GxD hub)
is a cross-disciplinary platform dedicated to advancing meaningful digital connectivity among women and girls in India. GxD hub is an initiative of LEAD at Krea University (IFMR). Our mission is to address critical intersections between gender and digital through rigorous research, impactful engagement with stakeholders, and ecosystem development. Our work is rooted in a deep commitment to develop gender intentional and overall inclusive digital platforms in the country.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert to support a large-scale government programme focused on digital skilling and AI capability building. The candidate will sit at the intersection of inclusion strategy, data systems, and stakeholder co-ordination, contributing to the development and operationalisation of frameworks that ensure equitable participation across beneficiary cohorts, with a particular focus on women and underserved groups.

This role combines inclusion expertise with strong data capabilities. The candidate will be responsible for tracking and synthesising progress against inclusion targets, while building the systems and evidence base needed to document and communicate the programme’s equity outcomes across states and implementing partners.

This is a stakeholder-facing role for someone who can navigate government and field contexts while bringing analytical rigour to their work. The ideal candidate is an inclusion practitioner with strong data and research skills, who can synthesise evidence, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and translate programme insights into clear, actionable outputs. The candidate will be placed within the Ministry that GxD hub is closely working with.

**Key Responsibilities**



**Inclusion Strategy and Implementation**

●     Develop and operationalise an inclusion strategy to ensure equitable participation across beneficiary cohorts, with attention to gender, geography, and socioeconomic status

●     Advise on accessibility standards for training content, digital platforms, and learning delivery mechanisms

●     Conduct periodic reviews and recommend interventions to address participation gaps across regions and demographics

**Monitoring, Data, and Evidence**

●     Establish inclusion metrics, monitoring frameworks, and reporting mechanisms for states and implementing partners

●     Ensure inclusion-related data is systematically collated, structured, and narrated consistently — building a coherent evidence base from the programme's earliest stages

●     Track and monitor progress on women's participation and other inclusion targets, and synthesise findings into regular reports and briefs for internal and external audiences

●     Support secondary data analysis and evidence synthesis to contextualise programme data within the broader landscape of digital inclusion in India

**Government and Stakeholder Coordination**

●     Coordinate with ministries, state governments, NGOs, and community organisations to improve outreach among underserved groups

**Minimum Qualifications**

●     Master's degree in Social Sciences, Gender Studies, Public Policy, Development Studies, Education, or a related field

●     Minimum 8 years of experience in inclusion, gender, accessibility, social development, or large-scale government or development programmes

●     Demonstrated experience working directly with central or state government counterparts in India — including in advisory, coordination, or embedded roles

●     Strong track record in data synthesis, evidence collation, and translating programme data into structured narratives for policy and funder audiences

●     Experience designing or operationalising inclusion monitoring frameworks, with hands-on familiarity with indicator development and reporting systems

**Strongly Desired**

●     Prior experience embedded in or advising large-scale government skilling, digital access.

●     Familiarity with India's digital ecosystem, including digital public infrastructure, and the policy landscape around AI and digital skilling

●     Experience working with government-commissioned research, and multi-stakeholder coordination across central and state bodies

●     Comfort with both qualitative and quantitative research methods, including primary data collection, field assessments, and mixed-method approaches

**Application Instructions**

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

**To apply, please email the below documents as a single PDF to**
**hr-lead@ifmr.ac.in**
**:**
