Gartner Consulting is looking for an Associate Consultant who will work with some of the world’s largest enterprises on their mission-critical priorities. The Associate Consultant will support consulting teams through structured research, quantitative and qualitative analysis, development of insights, and creation of high-quality client deliverables across digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model and enterprise transformation engagements.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Work as a collaborative member of consulting teams serving some of the world’s largest enterprises, supporting engagements focused on digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model, enterprise transformation and other mission-critical priorities.
* Develop broad consulting experience across industries and practice areas, while building foundational capabilities in research, analytics, problem solving, client communication and engagement delivery.
* Develop an understanding of client objectives, industry context and potential obstacles; structure assigned work to support engagement priorities and client deliverables.
* Execute primary research and information-gathering activities, including collecting, organizing and validating client data, conducting market research and using Gartner research and benchmarks.
* Perform clearly structured quantitative, qualitative and technical analyses with guidance, applying relevant Gartner methodologies, frameworks and best practices.
* Test hypotheses using available evidence, identify patterns and anomalies, and translate research and analysis into straightforward insights, conclusions and recommendations with guidance.
* Summarize analyses and observations for specific client deliverables or broader teamwork, clearly distinguishing facts, assumptions and areas requiring further validation.
* Prepare high-quality client outputs, including executive presentations, assessment findings, workshop materials, roadmaps, business cases and written recommendations, using clear storylines and effective data visualization.
* Participate in client interviews, workshops and working sessions; listen actively, ask relevant clarifying questions, document requirements and decisions, and support agreed follow-up actions.
* Manage and prioritize assigned activities effectively, deliver work products within agreed timelines, and proactively communicate progress, dependencies, issues and risks to the engagement team.
* Take ownership of the accuracy and quality of facts, data and analyses presented; conduct self and peer review, flag anomalies or concerns, and incorporate feedback before work is shared.
* Invest in self-development, seek and apply coaching, participate in Gartner learning communities, and contribute to internal knowledge and intellectual capital development when requested.

**What you’ll need:**

* 2–4 years of professional experience in consulting, strategy, research, technology, business transformation or a related field. At least 2 years of Technology strategy consulting experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to gather, organize and analyze qualitative and quantitative information and convert it into clear observations or insights.
* Strong structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down ambiguous questions, test hypotheses, apply strategy consulting frameworks and draw evidence-based conclusions with guidance.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate general and technical messages clearly and in plain language.
* Experience developing high-quality presentations, analytical outputs or written deliverables, with strong attention to accuracy, consistency and detail.
* Curiosity about business and technology trends and an interest in how digital, data, cloud, automation and emerging technologies can improve business outcomes.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with data analysis, visualization, research or AI-enabled productivity tools is an advantage.
* Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively with globally distributed and cross-border teams.
* A curious and inquisitive mindset, openness to feedback and new experiences, and the ability to learn quickly and work effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Bachelor’s degree required in engineering, technology, computer science, mathematics, statistics or a related discipline; an advanced degree in management is preferred.

**Who you are:**

* Self-starter and quick learner who takes ownership of assigned work and demonstrates intellectual curiosity and a commitment to client impact.
* Analytical thinker who approaches problems logically, asks relevant questions and uses evidence to develop sound conclusions.
* Clear communicator who can synthesize complex information into concise, audience-appropriate messages and high-quality deliverables.
* Collaborative team member who builds effective working relationships, responds well to coaching and actively incorporates feedback.
* Organized and dependable, with the ability to manage priorities, meet agreed timelines and proactively raise issues or concerns.
* Client-focused professional who listens actively, understands how assigned work connects to client objectives and takes responsibility for accuracy and quality.
* Committed to continuous learning, including developing awareness of Gartner methodologies, consulting best practices, business trends and the responsible use of approved AI-enabled productivity tools.

**What Gartner Consulting will offer you?**

* A world-class consulting environment.
* The opportunity to work on high-impact digital, technology strategy and enterprise transformation engagements with a tier one client portfolio.
* A competitive salary.
* Structured bonus based on individual and corporate performance.
* Opportunities for promotion with a clearly defined career development structure.
* Opportunity to participate actively in the development and future of Gartner Consulting.
* A dynamic but relaxed and supportive working environment that encourages personal development.

**About Gartner:**
Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT) is the world’s leading information technology research and advisory company. We deliver the technology-related insight necessary for our clients to make the right decisions, every day. We work with every client to research, analyze and interpret the business of IT within the context of their individual role. Founded in 1979, Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, U.S.A. – Visit gartner.com to discover more.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

description:
**Role:**
Senior Data Scientist

**Function:**
Data Science / Machine Learning

**Location:**
Delhi

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media

**About Company**

One of India's largest private FM radio networks, reaching 40 million+ listeners weekly. The company broadcasts across 49 cities, 1,000+ towns, and 50,000 villages.

It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu & Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.

The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740.

**Position Overview**

The company is building a next-generation media super-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for driving the data science behind content discovery, personalization, ranking, and audience intelligence at scale. The right candidate takes full ownership of ML systems — from problem framing and experimentation through to production deployment and ongoing model performance.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Own the full ML lifecycle for recommendation, personalization, content ranking, and search — from problem definition and feature design through model training, evaluation, and production deployment.
* Develop and iterate on models using behavioural, engagement, and content metadata signals across video, audio, and commerce surfaces.
* Design and build feature pipelines and reusable feature sets for ML training and inference, collaborating with data engineering on upstream data quality and availability.
* Run structured experiments (A/B tests, interleaving) to measure model impact on engagement, retention, and discovery metrics; translate results into product decisions.
* Enable continuous model improvement by designing feedback loops that capture live user interactions for retraining and evaluation.
* Explore and apply AI techniques across use cases including semantic search, content classification, audience profiling, content moderation, and generative AI-powered media experiences.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to translate business problems into well-scoped ML solutions and communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 7–12 years of hands-on data science or applied ML experience, with a track record of shipping models into production on consumer-scale platforms.
* Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of ML pipelines — from data preparation and feature engineering through model training, evaluation, and production deployment.
* Strong proficiency in Python for model development, experimentation, and data analysis.
* Deep experience building and evaluating models for recommendation, personalization, ranking, or search systems.
* Hands-on experience with ML experimentation frameworks and A/B testing at scale.
* Experience working with large-scale behavioural and event-streaming datasets to derive features and training signals.
* Demonstrated ability to deploy ML models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including monitoring model performance post-launch.

**Nice to Have**

* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, vector databases, or embedding-based retrieval systems.
* Familiarity with feature stores and MLOps tooling for managing model and feature lifecycle.
* Experience with NLP, speech, or audio/video understanding models.

**What We Offer**

* End-to-end IC ownership of ML models serving tens of millions of users across a greenfield media super-app.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation, with direct influence on product direction.
* Collaborative environment with engineering, product, and analytics teams tackling high-impact personalization and content intelligence problems.

title: Analyst
description:
**The Role**
As our Analyst, you'll be the analytical engine behind our online sales and paid acquisition. You'll track how every channel performs, find where we're winning or wasting spend, and give marketing, merchandising, and leadership clear recommendations. The role suits someone equally comfortable in a spreadsheet, a SQL editor, and a conversation with a media buyer.
  
  
**Compensation**
: Indian Rupee $70,000 - $100,000 montly
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own reporting on ecommerce performance (traffic, conversion rate, AOV, revenue, margin) and paid media (ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, CPM) across Google, Meta, TikTok, Amazon Ads, affiliates, and other channels.
* Build and maintain dashboards in [Looker Studio / Tableau / Power BI] that give teams a single source of truth.
* Analyze campaign and channel performance, and recommend budget allocation and bid, audience, and creative optimizations.
* Design, run, and read A/B tests on landing pages, site experience, promotions, and ad creative.
* Evaluate attribution across channels using platform data, GA4, and incrementality or MMM approaches where available.
* Analyze customer behavior, including cohorts, retention, lifetime value (LTV), repeat purchase rates, and LTV:CAC by channel.
* Support merchandising and promotional planning with product, category, pricing, and discount performance analysis.
* Forecast revenue and marketing spend for weekly, monthly, and seasonal peaks such as Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holidays.
* Audit tracking and data quality (pixels, UTMs, conversion APIs, GA4 events) with marketing and engineering.
* Present findings to non-technical stakeholders with clear, actionable recommendations.

**What You Bring**

* 2-4 years of experience in ecommerce, digital marketing, or retail analytics.
* Strong SQL skills and advanced Excel/Google Sheets.
* Hands-on experience with GA4 and at least two major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Amazon Advertising).
* Experience building dashboards in a BI tool.
* Solid grasp of performance marketing metrics, funnel analysis, and attribution concepts.
* Working knowledge of A/B testing and basic statistics (significance, sample size).
* The ability to explain complex data simply and turn analysis into a clear "here's what we should do."
* Attention to detail and a healthy skepticism about data quality.

**Nice to Have**

* Python or R for analysis or automation.
* Experience with Shopify, Magento/Adobe Commerce, or Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
* Familiarity with marketing mix modeling, incrementality testing, or tools like Northbeam, Triple Whale, or Rockerbox.
* Experience with CRM and email/SMS platforms (Klaviyo, Braze, Attentive).
* Experience with data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake) and dbt.

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.

**Tii Elements**

* **Curiosity:**
  Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:**
  Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal & external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self-Awareness & Impact:**
  Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**

* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.

* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.

If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

* Own end to end case delivery of Performance Improvement projects related to Procurement / Cost Transformation. This includes the following:

* Lead individual project work streams with the help of 1-2 directly aligned team members (analysts)

**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. title: Decision Analyst
description:
**Function: Data Analytics, Decision Science & Business Strategy**
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced analytics professional to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets, develop robust quantitative models, and deliver actionable recommendations to support strategic business decisions. The role involves working with multiple internal and external data sources, conducting scenario analysis, monitoring model performance, and implementing data quality and governance controls.
  
  
The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, influence business decisions, manage complex analytical assignments, and contribute to operational effectiveness, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Analysis & Insights: Identify, extract, and analyze relevant data from multiple internal and external sources to generate meaningful business insights.
* Quantitative Modelling: Develop, implement, and validate quantitative models to support decision-making across various business functions.
* Sensitivity Analysis & Scenario Planning: Conduct sensitivity analysis, forecasting, and scenario modelling to evaluate potential business outcomes and support strategic planning.
* Model Performance & Validation: Monitor existing models, assess their effectiveness, identify performance gaps, and recommend improvements.
* Data Quality & Governance: Establish and implement data quality checks, validation procedures, and control mechanisms to maintain data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
* Business Decision Support: Translate complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders and business leaders.
* Risk Management & Controls: Identify potential risks, strengthen control frameworks, and contribute to the development of policies and procedures supporting governance and compliance.
* Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with business units and specialist teams to address complex problems, align analytical outcomes with business objectives, and influence decision-making.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve analytical methodologies, operational processes, model effectiveness, and overall business performance.

Communication & Reporting: Present complex or sensitive information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences, including senior management.
  
  
**Leadership & Management Expectations**

* Lead complex analytical assignments and guide team members in delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Establish objectives, coach employees, evaluate performance, and support professional development where applicable.
* Provide expert advice on complex issues and support stakeholders in resolving escalated business challenges.
* Drive collaboration across business functions and identify opportunities to combine methodologies and specialist expertise.
* Promote accountability, operational excellence, effective risk management, and a strong control environment.
* For individual contributor roles, lead cross-functional projects, guide colleagues, and recommend new analytical approaches to achieve business outcomes.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong quantitative and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Experience in quantitative modelling, model validation, and performance monitoring.
* Ability to work with complex datasets from multiple sources.
* Knowledge of sensitivity analysis, scenario planning, and data quality management.
* Understanding of risk management, governance, and control frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex findings effectively.
* Experience leading projects, mentoring team members, or managing analytical teams, depending on the role structure.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to translate data-driven insights into practical recommendations.

**Key Success Factors**

* Deliver reliable, validated, and decision-oriented quantitative models.
* Improve data quality, analytical accuracy, and model performance.
* Provide actionable insights that support business strategy and operational effectiveness.
* Strengthen governance, risk management, and internal controls.
* Build effective cross-functional relationships and influence business outcomes.

Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute are on a mission to build the next generation of business leaders equipped for a digital and AI-first world. We bring deep expertise across eCommerce, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Product and AI, and are building technology-enabled learning experiences for higher education and enterprise learning.

As a Analyst, you will work at the intersection of Product, Data, AI and Learning. You will contribute to the training, evaluation and improvement of AI models that power learning and assessment experiences, while using product and learner insights to identify opportunities and drive better product decisions.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys working with data, solving complex problems, understanding user behaviour and translating insights into impactful product improvements.

• Work on the training, evaluation and improvement of AI models that power learning and assessment experiences across higher education and enterprise learning.

• Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that communicate product performance, trends and actionable insights to stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Content and Design teams to ensure seamless delivery of high-quality learner experiences.

**What We're Looking For**

• 1-3 years of experience in Product Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics or a similar analytical role.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable product insights.

• Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL.

• Strong understanding of product metrics, data analysis and experimentation.

• Ability to analyse user behaviour and product data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

• Strong interest in AI/ML, LLMs and AI-powered products.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

• High ownership, curiosity and attention to detail.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and cross-functional environment.

**Why Join Us?**

**• Build AI-powered Education -**
Work on AI-powered products shaping the future of higher education and enterprise learning.

**• High-Growth Learning Environment -**
Work in a fast-scaling organization where ownership, innovation and excellence are valued.

**• Cross-Functional Exposure -**
Work closely with Business, Product, AI, Engineering, Content, Design and Academic teams.

**• Accelerated Career Growth -**
Take ownership of high-impact projects and build expertise across Product, AI and Learning.

**• Make a Meaningful Impact -**
Contribute to products designed to improve learning experiences and outcomes for thousands of learners.

**About the Company**

Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.

Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.

The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception.

We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment.

We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

The Market risk team at LDC is responsible for producing quantitative market risk metrics along with qualitative assessment of potential risks to the company portfolio due to changes in market conditions. You will work closely with traders, risk managers, and other stakeholders to provide analysis, report risk metrics, and develop insights into market movements.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities:**

* Independently run and validate daily Market Risk calculations, including VaR and key risk metrics, ensuring data integrity, model stability, and timely delivery.
* Perform first-level analysis of VaR movements, identifying key drivers (price, positions, volatility) and escalating material changes with clear explanations to Management or Platform Risk Managers.
* Conduct deep-dive analysis on market exposures, linking risk movements to market fundamentals (e.g., price trends, supply/demand changes, basis movements).
* Generate and distribute daily risk reports to senior management, summarizing risk exposures, key metrics (e.g., Value at Risk (VaR), Margin Call Exposure), and historical trend analyses.
* Act as a key point of contact for various stakeholders, providing timely insights, challenging assumptions where appropriate, and supporting risk-informed decision-making.
* Continuously enhance and streamline risk reporting, improving transparency, consistency, and relevance to business decisions.
* Support and drive enhancements to risk tools, dashboards, and reporting frameworks, improving usability, efficiency, and data visibility across platforms.
* Contribute to enhancements in risk models and methologies (e.g. VaR assumptions, stress testing approaches)
* Explore and apply AI and data analytics tools to improve risk monitoring, anomaly detection, and reporting efficiency.

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics and Finance or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience; strong programming skills are highly valued.
* English (Fluent)
* Prior experience in financial analysis or related roles is preferred, with exposure to physical and/or derivatives markets considered an advantage. Familiarity with commodities trading and market risk is a plus.
* Familiarity with market risk concepts and metrics, such as Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, and exposure analysis, with the ability to interpret and explain risk movements.
* Exposure to risk systems, data analysis tools, or reporting platforms (e.g.,Python, Power BI, or similar) to support risk monitoring and reporting processes.
* Experienced in designing data modelling/analytics.
* Exposure to process improvement, automation, or data-driven initiatives (including use of analytics tools or AI-assisted workflows) to enhance risk reporting and monitoring efficiency.

Additional Information
  

* Strong understanding of statistical and financial risk models, including practical application in risk measurement (e.g.VaR, stress testing, scenario analysis) and interpretation of outputs in a business context.
* Strong Programming skills in data analysis and automation tools such as Python, SAS, Java, HTML or similar, with the ability to analyze large datasets, improve workflows, and support automation initiatives.
* Experience in data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI), with the ability to build interactive dashboards and translate complex risk metrics into clear insights.
* Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to detect discrepancies in data and systems, ensuring the reliability of risk assessments.
* Exposure to advanced analytics or AI-assisted tools to enhance risk monitoring, anomaly detection, or reporting workflows.

**What We Offer**
We provide a dynamic and stimulating international environment, which will stretch and develop your abilities and channel your skills and expertise with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the largest and most solid private companies in the world.
  
  
**Our Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Hybrid work available (not applicable to all roles)
* Pension contributions
* Access to Training and Development
* Access to Concierge Partnerships

**Diversity & Inclusion**
LDC is driven by a set of shared values and high ethical standards, with diversity and inclusion being part of our DNA. LDC is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion.
  
  
LDC encourages diversity, supports local communities and environmental initiatives. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply.
  
  
**Sustainability**
Sustainable value is at the heart of our purpose as a company.
  
  
We are passionate about creating fair and sustainable value, both for our business and for other value chain stakeholders: our people, our business partners, the communities we touch and the environment around us

title: Global Product Senior Specialist - FDP 360 Platform
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a
**Product Analyst**
on the Business Intelligence & Analytics Change Team, you will help integrate new Finance applications and analytical capabilities into BCG’s enterprise data warehouse and digital products, partnering with Business Intelligence & Analytics Change Team subject matter experts to understand business needs, reporting requirements, and the capabilities needed to support effective decision-making.
  
  
Once requirements are defined, you will work closely with Solution Architects and Developers and independently lead implementation through design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. A key part of your role will be testing and validating data in Snowflake and BI reports to ensure solutions meet defined business and reporting requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities Would Include**

* Partner with SMEs to gather, clarify, and document business and reporting requirements.
* Translate business requirements into technical requirements, data needs, and implementation plans.
* Lead implementation with Solution Architects and Developers, coordinating work through delivery.

* Test and validate data in Snowflake and BI reports, identifying discrepancies and ensuring solutions meet defined requirements.
* Analyze data anomalies and gaps in business logic, determine root causes, and coordinate resolution of BI reporting issues through the ServiceNow ticketing system.
* Support global users and partner with technical teams to troubleshoot and resolve data and reporting issues.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3–5 years of experience in business intelligence, Finance reporting, data analytics, or related work.
* Hands-on Snowflake experience querying, analyzing, testing, and validating data.
* Experience with SAP BusinessObjects or comparable enterprise BI and reporting solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to analyze complex data issues, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical requirements and working with technical teams through implementation.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills for working effectively across global, cross-functional teams.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a member of the Business Intelligence & Analytics Change Team, you will work closely with the Product Owner and subject matter experts to understand business and reporting needs, partnering with Solution Architects and Developers to translate those needs into scalable data and reporting solutions. You will also collaborate with Finance teams, Finance application owners, other Business Intelligence & Analytics teams, and global end users. As BCG’s BI environment evolves, you will work across existing SAP BusinessObjects reporting and emerging platforms, including Power BI and Sigma.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Impact Manager (Full-time / Remote)
description:
**About Generation:**

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have an 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

**JOB OBJECTIVES:**

The Impact Manager will strengthen Generation’s ability to measure, evaluate, and communicate durable impact across the global network. Reporting to the Lead, Impact Evaluation & Data Advocacy, this role will lead durability measurement and evaluation workstreams, deliver instruction and content for the Durability Academy, and serve as global D&I’s day-to-day counterpart on APAC and SAMEA.

This role combines research rigor, structured problem-solving, and the ability to teach and coach. The Impact Manager will independently own defined evaluation, research, and insight workstreams, manage vendor and research partner relationships, coach Durability Academy partner organizations, and produce high-quality materials for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders.

This is a remote position, based in the SAMEA region (India preferred).

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Durability & Impact Evaluation**

* Lead defined cross-country durability analyses (employment, earnings, job quality, financial health, and related metrics), from framing through final outputs
* Shape evaluation framing, research design, and methodological comparability across countries and program models
* Manage evaluations and research partnerships end to end, including scoping, vendor procurement, contracting support, data-sharing processes, and quality of deliverables
* Own evaluation briefs, synthesis memos, and funder-ready materials
* Ensure durability insights are grounded in consistent and reliable underlying data

**Durability Academy Instruction & Content**

* Co-facilitate cohort-wide Durability Academy sessions, taking ownership of selected modules over time
* Serve as a 1:1 coach for a portfolio of cohort partner organizations, guiding them through their theory of change, durability logframe, and measurement plans
* Maintain and improve Academy content between cohorts, including module materials, milestone documents, logframe templates, and facilitation guides
* Turn cohort work into reusable examples, case material, and practical guidance for future cohorts and the wider Durability Collective

**APAC & India Impact Priorities**

* Act as global D&I's day-to-day counterpart to Generation India and other APAC teams on evaluation, data, and impact priorities
* Coordinate regional evaluations and research partnerships, ensuring alignment with global methodology and standards
* Support regional teams on outcomes data, cost-per-learner and ROI inputs, and funder reporting
* Support onboarding and alignment of regional impact leads with global D&I tools and ways of working
* Surface regional insights and needs to D&I leadership to inform priorities and planning

**Structured Analysis & Insight Communication**

* Translate ambiguous leadership and funder questions into structured analytical approaches, and lead the resulting analyses
* Develop high-quality slide decks, workshop materials, and written summaries for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders
* Shape coherent impact narratives across decks, reports, and external-facing materials
* Contribute evidence, data, and methodology inputs to grant proposals and funder engagement

**Cross-Functional Delivery & Team Support**

* Manage timelines, deliverables, and dependencies across D&I workstreams, proactively flagging risks and reporting progress
* Partner with Impact Operations and Analytics colleagues to improve the clarity and consistency of core metrics (e.g., placement, durability indicators, income, living wage, ROI)
* Provide guidance and quality review for analyst-level work as needed
* Support D&I team operations such as recruitment and onboarding

**ATTRIBUTES (e.g. qualifications, knowledge, skills, and experience):**

***Required experience and skills:***

* 5+ years of experience in impact evaluation, monitoring & evaluation, research, analytics, consulting, policy, or related fields
* Track record of independently owning evaluation, research, or analytical workstreams from framing to delivery
* Experience managing external vendors, research partners, or academic collaborators
* Experience facilitating workshops, training, or coaching for professional audiences
* Strong structured thinking and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights
* Strong written communication and slide development skills, including materials for senior leadership or funders
* Comfort working with data (Excel required; SQL preferred)
* Ability to operate independently with significant ambiguity and manage multiple workstreams

***Preferred experience and skills:***

* Experience in workforce development, economic mobility, education, or related social sector work
* Experience working with teams in India or the wider SAMEA/APAC region
* Hands-on experience with survey design, research design, and impact evaluation methodologies, including quasi-experimental approaches
* Familiarity with adult learning principles or curriculum development
* Experience working with dashboards (e.g., Power BI) and interpreting metrics
* Fluency in additional languages beyond English

***Mindset:***

* Structured thinker who breaks down ambiguous questions into clear components and approaches, and helps others do the same
* Intellectually curious and motivated to understand the “why” behind outcomes, not just produce analysis
* Rigorous and practical, holding a high bar on evidence while keeping measurement useful for partners and programs
* Takes ownership, proactively flagging risks and proposing solutions
* Collaborative and low-ego, able to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders, cultures, and time zones
* Self-reflective and open to giving and receiving frequent feedback

title: Data Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
09
  
  
**Role Scope**
Data Steward is an individual contributor role responsible for executing core data stewardship activities that ensure the accuracy, integrity, and governance of enterprise data assets. The Data Steward manages end‑to‑end lineage monitoring, maintains high‑quality metadata, enforces policy and control compliance, and supports UAT for database changes and product distribution. Within the European Gas and Power Data team, the role supports the controlled transition of source data into internal databases and downstream delivery pipelines, ensuring raw data is validated, reconciled, transformed, and quality checked before it is made available to internal SMEs and external clients. The role performs detailed data validation, vendor data reviews, and works closely with Technology and Data Operations teams to resolve issues and maintain consistent data standards across systems.
  
  
Additionally, the Data Steward contributes to process improvement by driving standardization, enhancing documentation, and supporting the adoption of automation and AI‑enabled capabilities to improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and strengthen operational efficiency. We are looking for a process-orientated, methodological thinker with a keen eye for detail. Someone who enjoys dealing with large sets of data and problem solving.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)**
**Operational Delivery**

* Perform data validation checks, lineage tracking, and metadata updates to maintain data quality, integrity, and traceability.
* Execute data ingestion, validation, and integration activities in alignment with governance and control standards.
* Ensure consistent adherence to enterprise data policies and governance frameworks.
* Execute defined controls and compliance requirements to safeguard data integrity and lineage.
* Support vendor data reviews and onboarding through data quality assessments, validation checks, and issue resolution.
* Maintain data standardization, stewardship documentation, and process artifacts to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Execute medium‑complexity stewardship and validation tasks under established guidelines, escalating exceptions when required.
* Respond to client data queries, resolving issues and coordinating issue triage with Operations and Client Services teams.
* Collaborate with Technology teams on defect resolution, enhancement requests, and UAT for backend data and dataflow changes.
* Contribute to automation and AI‑enabled improvements that enhance efficiency and strengthen stewardship capabilities.
* Investigate, validate, troubleshoot, and support controlled updates to transformation scripts, data quality rules, and pipeline logic using Python, SQL and PySpark, ensuring automated processes continue to run to schedule producing accurate outputs.
* Support onboarding of new datasets required by SMEs by reviewing source structures, validating expected outputs, identifying data quality risks, and coordinating required pipeline or source data changes within the existing architecture.

**Process Excellence**

* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating data, coordinating test execution, and assisting with defect identification and resolution.
* Ensure adherence to governance, data management standards, and operating procedures by following defined controls and compliance requirements.
* Maintain high‑quality documentation by updating process flows, data definitions, data dictionaries, and other stewardship artifacts to ensure audit readiness and operational clarity.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Data Operations and Technology teams to support governance activities, quality controls, source amendments, validation outcomes and issue remediation while serving as a key liaison between governance expectations and day‑to‑day execution
* Support Product and Technology teams by assisting with data requirements, validations, and operational coordination throughout change cycles.
* Assist with vendor data reviews by conducting data quality checks, performing validations, and coordinating onboarding processes.

**How Impact Will Be Measured (Success Metrics)**

* Data accuracy and integrity - Maintain high accuracy rates through consistent validation, timely corrections, and adherence to defined quality thresholds.
* SLA and turnaround adherence - Meet or exceed service‑level timelines for data updates, validations, issue resolution, and stakeholder responses.
* Documentation completeness and currency - Keep process documentation, data dictionaries, lineage records, and stewardship artifacts up‑to‑date, audit‑ready, and fully aligned with governance standards.
* Pipeline quality and delivery - Ensure transformation scripts, database workflows, quality checks, and scheduled processes run successfully, with failures investigated, validated, resolved, or coordinated through to closure in line with operational priorities.

**For This Role You'll Need to Have (Skills & Competencies)**
**Technical Skills**

* Intermediate Python scripting skills, including the ability to investigate, maintain, debug, and support controlled updates to transformation logic, automation scripts, and data quality checks.
* Intermediate SQL capability to query, reconcile, transform, validate, and troubleshoot data across relational databases and pipeline outputs.
* Hands-on experience with PySpark or distributed data processing to support investigation, validation, reconciliation, and quality checks across large or complex datasets.
* Working knowledge of Databricks, including notebooks, jobs, clusters, and pipeline monitoring, would be advantageous.
* Understanding of cloud computing, preferably AWS.

title: Consumer Science Product Intelligence - Senior Scientist
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Consumer Science and Product Intelligence (CSPI) Wellness India Senior Scientist role is a strategic and operational role that ensures we put the Consumer First, Always in everything we do. The role leads consumer science and product intelligence for the Wellness portfolio in India, partnering across R&D, Category, Innovation and Commercial teams to develop, deliver and review innovations and in-market products so they win with consumers at the point of purchase and throughout the usage experience, delivering meaningful and noticeable superiority.
  
  
Critical elements of the role are:
  
  

* Provide insights and evidence that enable consumer-led Wellness innovations that deliver meaningful and noticeable superiority.
* Champion the “Consumer First, Always” approach for Wellness India from early insight and prototype development through claims support, launch and post-launch review.
* Lead consumer and product intelligence for Wellness India to guide product, portfolio, claims, communication and renovation decisions.
* Build a clear understanding of the India Wellness landscape, including competitors, product performance, consumer reviews, complaints, claims evidence and emerging format trends.
* Translate global category strategies into locally relevant India execution, while using local insights to influence global innovation decisions.
* Bring actionable local consumer and product insights to Category teams and wider R&D, partnering with CBIA where appropriate.
* Drive faster, better innovation using ideal product models and evidence-based product narratives through the stage-gate process.
* Ensure consumer testing in India is compliant, fit for purpose and aligned with agreed work processes.
* Partner with Category, Innovation, Commercial, R&D and Medical & Scientific Affairs to focus CSPI resources on high-impact opportunities and develop consumer-relevant claims, demos, visualisations and communications.
* Use evidence to support prioritisation and deploy Wellness India CSPI resources where they can most improve consumer choice, usage and repeat purchase.

**Key Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  
E2E Consumer Science for Wellness India
  
  

* Select and apply fit-for-purpose consumer science, product research and sensory methods according to each project’s decision, risk and value.
* Deliver consumer and product evidence to identify superiority, guide product design, support claims, and create compelling product stories and visualisations versus competition
* Develop and apply leading-edge testing methods, including AI- and digitally enabled tools, to improve decision speed and deliver noticeable, meaningful product superiority.
* Lead end-to-end consumer evidence delivery from early need definition and prototype learning through formulation lock, launch and post-launch optimisation.
* Validate non-clinical claims with consumers using robust qualitative and quantitative research.
* Conduct post-launch reviews, monitor complaints and use insights to improve India Wellness products.
* Track emerging trends through social listening, market signals and product intelligence to guide pipeline and portfolio decisions.

Integrated Product Experience and Insight Generation
  
  

* Integrate consumer research, product performance, complaints, reviews, commercial signals and competitor benchmarking into unified product intelligence that guides India Wellness decisions.
* Build understanding of what drives trial, usage, repeat purchase and priority product formats in India.
* Identify consumer jobs to be done, usage occasions and unmet needs with Category CSPI to inform superior product design.
* Partner with Sensory Scientists to integrate sensory-panel and consumer evidence into clear product-design decisions.

Product Intelligence
  
  

* Maintain a clear, evidence-based view of the India Wellness product landscape in partnership with Category CSPI.
* Lead product benchmarking to identify where Haleon products are superior, at parity or exposed versus competitors.
* Translate benchmarking into recommendations on where to renovate, defend, premiumise, simplify or avoid over-investment.
* Identify product and experience gaps that could improve consumer choice, usage, repeat purchase and business outcomes.

Capability, Governance and Collaboration
  
  

* Build and share Consumer Science & Product Intelligence best practices and capabilities.
* Champion consumer closeness and coach R&D colleagues outside CSPI in consumer-led decision making.
* Ensure consumer interactions comply with the Human Subject Testing Policy and all quality and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate directly with R&D, CBIA and Marketing teams to deliver decisions effectively in a matrixed environment.

**Why you?**
**Basic Qualifications:**
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* BSc degree or equivalent in an appropriate subject.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience, preferably within FMCG/CPG or Healthcare.
* Appropriate specialisations include Chemistry, Pharmacy, Pharmacology, Physics, Mathematics, Sensory Science, Food Science, Biochemistry or Biological Science.
* Preferred: MSc degree in an appropriate scientific discipline. Essential Capabilities
* Broad experience across consumer science, product research, sensory/product experience, claims evidence and product intelligence, with the ability to select fit-for-purpose approaches.
* Connect consumer science and product intelligence to clear business outcomes and growth.
* Lead through cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders.
* Turn complex priorities and evidence into simple, practical recommendations.
* Shape product, portfolio, claims and communication decisions with strong evidence and judgement.
* Apply commercial judgement and integrate multiple data sources into clear, actionable insights.
* Develop and embed novel methodologies that deliver business impact.
* Demonstrate strong analytical, strategic, communication and change-leadership skills.
* Experience across qualitative and quantitative research, consumer modelling, consumer need definition, product validation and claims substantiation.
* Commercially savvy, entrepreneurial and collaborative, with experience independently leading research programmes and solving problems in a matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Ability to problem solve
* Scientific expertise
* Project management experience
* Experience analyzing data
* Ability to influence others

title: Evidence Lead, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
description: About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M+ farmers with AI-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change. Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI-enabled clinical decision support to 20M+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low-resource settings, including direct-to-consumer (DTC) health interventions. We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.About 2AI India And EAII AdvisorsEAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. We are hiring a founding team: the first hires will shape the culture, establish the operating model, and own early wins before the organization scales.Roles And ResponsibilitiesThe Evidence Lead is 2AI India's primary engine for measuring whether our programs work and why. This is not a traditional monitoring and evaluation (M&E) role. The focus is generating insights that change program design in real time. Data collection for government reporting is a real but secondary function, roughly 20% of the role. The Evidence Lead is also expected to be actively applying AI and machine learning (ML) tools to evaluation.Evidence Generation and Program MeasurementMeasures the effectiveness of new programs and ideas, from early concept tests through scaled delivery, and defines what "working" means for each before it launchesIdentifies the right data sources for evaluation, including administrative data, program data, partner data, and primary collection, and making the tradeoffs between rigor, cost, and speed explicitDesigns and runs cost-effectiveness models, making the assumptions behind each result legible to the people making the callBuilds the measurement and feedback loops into program design from the start rather than retrofitting them after launchOwns the data collection and reporting obligations that come with government partnerships, roughly 20% of the role,Thought Partnership to ProgramsServes as a thought partner to the programs team on program design, ensuring programs are built to be measurable and monitoring and evaluation efforts measure what really matters. Translates findings into recommendations that program leads can act on, and is explicit about the confidence behind each oneAI and ML Applied to EvaluationApplies AI and ML tools directly to evaluation and data analysis work, and keeps that practice current as the tools changeBuilds the data and modeling infrastructure that lets a small team run rapid and purpose-built analysisExternal RepresentationPresents 2AI's evidence and data externally, with findings tailored to the needs of specific audiences: funders, partners, government counterparts, and the research communityTeam building and enablementFosters a strong, values-aligned culture as a leader across the organizationWillingness to roll-up sleeves and pitch in to the organization building activities required of a founding teamOvertime, hires and enables a team of strong monitoring, learning, and evaluation professionals committed to objectively assessing our programs and fostering their improvementDisclaimer: The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.RequirementsEssentials:Relevant professional background: 7-9 years of experience in M&E, impact evaluation, or applied research in global health or international developmentRigorous evidence environment: has worked in an organization where methodological standards were high and contested, such as academic research, a think tank, or an equivalent research labApplied AI and ML fluency: is already using AI and ML tools in evaluation and data analysis work todayCost-effectiveness modelling: experience building and updating cost-effectiveness analyses, and can explain the assumptions driving a result to a non-technical decision-makerAnalytical structuring: structures ambiguous problems, thinks analytically, and solves quantitative problems without waiting for a fully specified briefProgram collaboration instincts: experience working in close proximity to programs; The candidate will partner with global business leaders, Finance, FP&A, data providers, and technology teams to transform complex business requirements into scalable analytical products that enable executive decision-making. This role requires a unique combination of business acumen, technical expertise, product thinking, and team leadership capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own and manage executive-level KPI reporting across multiple business units, products, and regions.
* Design and implement scalable KPI measurement frameworks, reporting methodologies, and governance processes.
* Develop and maintain analytics solutions, dashboards, and reporting products using Tableau, Power BI, SQL, and Python.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and operational scalability.
* Lead finance automation initiatives that transform manual FP&A reporting packs into governed, scalable, role-based dashboards and financial intelligence layers.
* Partner with global stakeholders to gather requirements, define metrics, resolve reporting issues, and provide actionable insights.
* Monitor data quality, perform validations, and ensure accuracy of business-critical reporting.
* Lead cross-functional projects from conceptualization through implementation, commercialization, and business adoption.
* Translate complex business problems into data-driven and AI-enabled solutions for senior leadership.
* Evaluate, identify, and integrate GenAI and AI capabilities into existing products and business processes.
* Contribute to AI product roadmap planning by identifying opportunities for AI-driven features, automation, insights generation, and user experience enhancements.

* Mentor and guide team members on technical tools, analytics best practices, AI adoption, and business processes.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, prioritize deliverables, and ensure timely execution of strategic initiatives.

Job Requirements
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Product Analytics, Product Management, or related fields.
* Experience designing and managing enterprise-level KPI frameworks and executive reporting solutions with proven ability to build scalable analytics products and automate reporting processes.
* Experience automating finance or FP&A reporting processes, including revenue, expense, driver, budget, forecast, and P&L reporting, with strong understanding of financial data governance and validation.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, AI agents, and enterprise AI use cases.
* Experience evaluating, planning, and integrating AI capabilities into business products and analytical solutions.
* Understanding of AI solution architecture, data flows, API integrations, model governance, and deployment considerations.
* Ability to translate business requirements into product roadmaps and identify opportunities for AI-driven innovation.

* Demonstrated ability to lead projects independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, strategic thinking, and product planning capabilities.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Manager - Data Science
description:
**About noon**

We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, who can help us move even faster.

noon’s mission: Every door, every day.

**What you'll do**

* ***Applied AI, analytics automation and internal tools (must have***
  *)*

• Lead analytics automation by connecting LLMs to governed data: certified metrics, curated tables and semantic layers.

•Ensure AI-generated insights are accurate, explainable and secure, with clear evaluation, transparency and data governance built in from the start.

• Build internal tools and self-serve products that help teams answer their own questions and reduce ad-hoc requests.

• Spot opportunities nobody has asked for yet, and turn the best into solutions teams actually adopt.

* ***Data science***

• Build solutions that shape how customers discover, engage with, and buy on noon, from personalized recommendations to a smarter, more relevant app experience.

• Choose the simplest method that works, and measure models on business outcomes, not just offline accuracy.

* ***Product analytics and experimentation***

• Partner with PMs on what to build and how to measure it: North Star and guardrail metrics, funnels, cohorts, opportunity sizing and A/B test design and readouts.

• Own experimentation standards, from randomization, power and pre-registered metrics to novelty effects and clear ship/kill decisions.

• Push back when the data doesn't support a decision, and propose what to do instead.

* ***Lead and grow the team***

• Manage analysts and data scientists: hiring, goals, reviews, coaching and hard performance conversations when needed.

• Allocate capacity across squads and run a clear intake and prioritization process with Product.

• Raise the quality bar by reviewing analyses, test designs and models before they reach stakeholders.

* ***Communicate and influence***

• Turn complex data into clear recommendations and actionable stories for leadership.

• Build trust with Product, Engineering and Business by being direct, timely and right.

**What you bring**

• 7–9 years in product analytics, data science or growth analytics, ideally in e-commerce, marketplaces or consumer tech at scale.

• 2+ years managing analysts or data scientists as direct reports, including hiring, reviews and handling underperformance. Mentoring alone doesn't count.

• Strong SQL and Python, plus a cloud warehouse (Big Query preferred) and a BI tool (Looker preferred).

• Deep experimentation skills, including knowing when results can't be trusted.

• Production experience applying LLMs to analytics or internal tools, and the safeguards you added when things went wrong.

• Product thinking and clear communication with senior stakeholders, even when the answer isn't what they wanted.

* ***Nice to have***

• Text-to-SQL, RAG or agent workflows over a semantic layer or metric catalogue.

• Building internal data tools or self-serve analytics products.

• Recommendation systems, personalization or search ranking.

• Causal inference (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, uplift modelling).

• GCC or Arabic-language product experience.

description:

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance.
